title: BOUNTY: Full House
summary: This is a Wanted mission for heroes located in the East End GCPD. This is also available as a Bounty mission for villains located in the North Burnley Nightclub.

sections.title: Overview
items: This is a Wanted mission for heroes located in the East End GCPD. This is also available as a Bounty mission for villains located in the North Burnley Nightclub.

sections.title: Intro
items: Wanted! The GCPD seeks the removal of a malfunction android, Full House. Considered a serious threat: do not approach alone.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Locate and Defeat Full House in Gotham
Report to Officer Washburn in the Gotham's East End Police Station (Heroes)

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: For heroes, start this wanted mission at the wanted poster in the north west corner of the East End Police Station. Note that it shares this poster with other bounties.
Full House is exceedingly dangerous for low levels and for its own low level, as he could hit up to at least more then 1200 damage no higher
For high level players, Full House is a fairly simple kill, he does a stun every so often which isn't too bad as he is located in a fairly unoccupied area.
Other than that he has a stun which makes you dance, nothing really to worry about but you will find yourself using a lot of power to keep breaking out of this annoying stun.
Take a group of DPS's and burn him down, no real tank needed, healer would be useful but dps can just swap aggro and move out of range until he dies.

For soloers, dodging his ranged attacks would be worthwhile. Soloers or low levels in a team should stand on one of the rooftops in the area, as this completely nullifies his charge attack that hits up to at least 813.
Full House is very easily distracted by followers like the Robot Sidekick and Suppressor Turret. Summoning them would almost mitigate all damage for a soloer.

title: BOUNTY: Hawkman and Hawkgirl
summary: Wanted! The Society seeks the defeat of Hawkman and Hawkgirl. Considered a threat to criminal activity: do not approach alone.

sections.title: Overview
items: Wanted! The Society seeks the defeat of Hawkman and Hawkgirl. Considered a threat to criminal activity: do not approach alone.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Locate and defeat Hawkman and Hawkgirl.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: They can be located flying just above ground level near the front of the Old Star Building.
Fairly simple wanted mission, again a tank is suggested as you will be fighting 2 mobs at once.
Nothing major to worry about here, the damage is high but manageable, and no real stuns or knockbacks.
The tough part of this fight is that both of them need to die within about 10 seconds of each other or they will resurrect their fallen partner and the fight will never end.

Make sure to split the dps so they go down at roughly the same time and you'll be fine. However, high level players may do it by simply defeating one of them, beat the other (which leaves the original one with about 1/3 health) and go back to the first one.

title: BOUNTY: Kilowog
summary: Wanted! The Corps seeks the defeat of Green Lantern Kilowog. Considered a serious threat: do not approach alone.

sections.title: Overview
items: Wanted! The Corps seeks the defeat of Green Lantern Kilowog. Considered a serious threat: do not approach alone.

sections.title: Background
items: -Locate and defeat Kilowog in Metropolis

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Mission Found:
Midtown Night Club

Kilowog is a standard bounty kill. As he is high level expect to take a large amount of damage if you're the one "tanking" him. One of the most paintful moves is the weight drop, if you're not a tank or blocking, this will take off a good few 100 hp easily. He also uses the fan blowback and ground pound knockup/stun, both are easily breakout-able so just keep your cool.
Top tip is to kite him away from the other Lanterns near the city hall, just pulling him east across the road junction would do.
Suggested full group with healer and tank.
Good luck and have fun!

title: BOUNTY: Nepheritos
summary: WANTED! The GCPD seeks the removal of an angry Kahndaqian mummy, Nepheritos. Considered a serious threat: do not approach alone

sections.title: Overview
items: WANTED! The GCPD seeks the removal of an angry Kahndaqian mummy, Nepheritos. Considered a serious threat: do not approach alone
The Society seeks the destruction of the rogue Ancient Mummy known as Nepheritos! Target has a high threat level: approach in force!

sections.title: Background
items: Locate and defeat Nepheritos in Gotham

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Neph can be a tricky kill, things can go wrong very quickly.
Neph is located in the University grounds surrounded by wandering zombies.
If you're in a full group of 4 with a healer then these zombies wont pose too much of an issue, but they will constantly respawn during the fight.
Neph hits moderately hard, hard enough that a tank is suggested for this fight. He will also summon scarabs at random intervals that if left to run around will cause trouble.
His real threat is a massive AoE, I mean this thing will kill a DPS in 2-3 pulses.
As long as you can avoid the AoE and keep the adds under control he will go down slowly but surely.
Goodluck and have fun!

sections.title: Overview
items: BOUNTY: Power Girl is a bounty mission for villain players. The mission's task is to locate and defeat Power Girl.

Power Girl heavily prefers using interrupting Brawling combos, which makes her very vulnerable to block. Despite that Heat Vision, her primary ranged attack, is normally an interruptible ability, it is not the case for her.
Power Girl's performs her special attack by flying to a target location and rapidly fly around in circles, suspending all enemy players in the air for a few seconds.
Previously, Power Girl has another special attack in which she performs a charged punch that inflicts extreme damage, but will knock her down if blocked, which seems to have been removed.

items: Locate and defeat the Flash in Gotham

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Flash can be found in the Gotham Robinson Park near the Pillars of Hades.
Flash is a pain, he will randomly target party members so can't be reliably "tanked", so taking a healer with you will be much more useful.

He moves at very high speeds and teleports around the fight, meaning it's nearly impossible to hit him with melee weapons reliably. Ranged weapon users will find this much easier than any melee users. In fact, The Flash has very limited ranged options, so you can avoid most of his damage if you're a flier simply by hovering above him and attacking from range.
He produces a few knockbacks and stuns but nothing that will worry you, the main point of this fight is the frustrating movement and inability to hit him consistently.

sections.title: Speak to Officer Nulty
items: Follow the Navigation Diamond (if it's active in Settings > UI) to the southeast portion of Ace Chemicals, the Processing Vats area. Officer Nulty is on the bridge that leads to Arkham Island, protected behind a tower. Interact with him and he'll tell you what to do.

sections.title: Throw Vehicles Off Bridge + Defeat Enemies
items: If you don't have the Super-Strength Iconic Power, you'll have to interact with the robot crate near Officer Nulty to proceed (if you have spent 1 skill point in Traits > Iconic Powers > Super-Strength, skip this step). The crate will give you the Steelworks Power Suit, which grants you the ability to lift heavy objects. The suit will wear off after 5 minutes, but you can go back to the crate to activate it again.

Go to the road. The GCPD is fighting T.O. Morrow's lackies. Help them by killing 15 enemies (Chemoids don't count for the objective). While you're fighting you'll find cars with an orange icon above them - these are the cars you need to throw off the bridge, other vehicles won't count for the objective. Interact with and throw 8 cars to complete the objective.
Once you finish the 2 objectives, go back to Officer Nulty.

sections.title: Defeat Clownvanity
items: Go back through the bridge towards Ace Chemicals until you spot an oil truck, and you'll find Clownvanity on the top of it. He looks identical to Clownsanity, but only fights with his fists. Defeat him to finish the mission.

sections.title: Overview
items: " Was on my way to meet with a contact when a whole legion of those demonic bastards came outta nowhere and captured me. Can you imagine? Me, the great John Constantine, taken prisoner by a bunch of scruffy demonic hooligans? Detective Chimp won't let me hear the end of that, I can assure you! Thing is, demons can get right chatty at times. I overheard 'em talkin' about where Reckoning is holed up. She's in an old mausoleum out on an island nearby. We move fast, we just might get her!" — John Constantine

sections.title: Intro
items: The overflow of corrupted magic from Corum Rath has affected Beast Rancher Bobtaros's brine hulks. Go to him and help him bring them back to the pens.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Upon granted the mission, the player is sent to the farms at southeast of the second portion of Atlantis, where they must talk to a rancher. He will ask for help with placing the loose Brine Hatchlings back inside their pen. Players must place 6 hatchlings in order to complete the mission.

Various hatchlings are scattered across the farm. Once the player interacts with them, there are two possible outcomes: they'll either become hostile and attack the player, turning themselves unfitted for completing the mission, or they'll will be encased by a shield, which allows them to be picked up and carried around. Once picked up, a giant arrow will appear above the player character's head signaling where they must be placed.
Players must beware of the giant Brine Hulk at the south of the farm, as it can quickly knock them out if they're unaware.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Once a Brine Hatchling is encased, you can pick it up and smash or throw it like an object. It is labelled as "Encased Student" is combat messages, and smashing it may cause brief flashes of a H.I.V.E. encase model, suggesting old code from other content is reused for them. if the encasement of a Brine Hatchling is broken, it would not move, and retain its "pick up" icon but cannot be picked up or encased again, making it unusable for the mission. It is reset when you move far enough away from the stuck Brine Hatchling.

title: Clinical Strike
summary: Assist Clinic Doctors in treating fear gas victims and Hazmat workers scrubbing the air free of gas.

sections.title: Overview
items: Assist Clinic Doctors in treating fear gas victims and Hazmat workers scrubbing the air free of gas.

sections.title: Intro
items: Batman: Doctor Thompkins has finished synthesizing my antidote, but Scarecrow's gang is assaulting the area to keep the doctors and Hazmat from helping anyone. Protect the doctors and ensure as many citizens as possible get that antidote.

sections.title: Objective
items: Travel to Gotham Free Clinic
Speak to Detective Harvey Bullock
Assist Doctors in administering fear gas antidote to civilians x10
Protect Gotham Hazmat Senior Officers working to get rooftop air scrubbers operational x5
Defeat Scarecrow's Henchman x 20

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Follow the yellow arrow on the mini-map to the Free Clinic and speak to Harvey Bullock.

Travel around the clinic look for the doctors they will be standing next to a police officer. Talk to the doctor and some of Scarecrow's henchmen will attack you. Take them out and a hallucinating victims will run up to you. At this point you will be attacked again. Let the officer take the threat and you cure the victim. You will get 2 to 3 victims per doctor.
Once that is done head up to the top of the roofs and help the Hazmat Officers. Attack the henchmen and then press E on the Hazmat Officer.
" You don't scare easy, and I mean Harvey Bullock, not just the fear gas." — Oracle

sections.title: Overview
items: Cold Contender is a level 21 villain mission automatically started upon the completion of Frozen Assets.
Steal a crucial component of Mister Freeze's technology for the Joker inside Gotham's Mercy General Hospital.

sections.title: Objectives
items: " Here we are, the promised land! Mister Freeze's Ice chamber inside Gotham General! Now here's the plan. Mister Freeze's been working on his Cryotech for ages. Wants to resurrect the sick wife he's got stored in a giant ice cube or something. Well, wifey will have to wait - I need that deep freeze from some of the more, ah, alive ingredients of my new Joker toxin. I need you to get in there and upload the information from the main cold core. Thanks, you're a real pal." — Joker
" Now, upload the data to me! If Freeze sees you, you'll be an ice sculpture. His good nature only goes so far." — Joker
Defeat Mister Freeze and Retrieve the Diamonds; Go to Gotham Mercy General Hospital to Continue Your Mission

" Ah, there you are! Still room temperature, and diamonds intact! They may be a girl's best friend, but friends are overrated. As Mister Freeze has just learned. Ah well, he'll have plenty of time to brood over it when the SCU busts in to take him to Arkham... and now my dreams of Joker toxin over ice will finally be a reality. I call that a win! Ta-ta!" — Joker
Upon completion, Your Best Face Forward is automatically started.

sections.title: Intro
items: (Weekly) Darkseid’s top general is a formidable foe! With a little help from your friends and allies, Steppenwolf can be put in his place. He's been spotted near the open lot by the docks!

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Oracle-Bot can be found a short distance west of the docks (where players enter Apokoliptic Gotham). Steppenwolf is a bit further west, in the southwest corner of the map.
Steppenwolf uses two-handed weapon attacks.

Apokoliptic Agony: Warned by lethal attack icon. This is the main mechanic to avoid for players not being directly targeted. Suppression fields (white circles) appear randomly in the area, and being on one disables abilities and prevent weapon attacks. However, Apokoliptic Agony deals massive damage to all players in the area, and players must enter a field to negate the damage. The white circles are marked with light blue arrows while the attack is ongoing, so when they vanish it is safe to exit.
Lasso Taser: Steppenwolf drags a player towards him, stunning and damaging them.
Blast Wave: Steppenwolf marks a cone in front of him briefly before smashing the area.

Leaping Slam: Steppenwolf targets one player (red shield icon appears above them), and they must block to greatly reduce damage. Nearby players will also take massive damage (players must individually block). Despite the leaping animation, damage will still be dealt even though Steppenwolf does not physically reach his target. This attack ignores Shield Powers. Damage dealt indicates the source as the targeted player.
New God Axe: A large axe would autonomously perform Spinning Cleave as a roaming hazard on the floor.

sections.title: Intro
items: Saint Walker needs help rescuing lanterns from the large field of sorrow energy. He has instructed his Lantern Corps to set up recharge points throughout the field that will aid you in your mission.
"Greetings, friend. Your arrival is quite timely - I require assistance." — Saint Walker
"What do you need?" — [ Player character]
"There are Green Lanterns nearby. They were helping me protect the refugees... but they were overwhelmed with sorrow and have fell to the Gray." — Kyle Rayner
"Is there anything we can do?" — [ Player character]
"Search this Valley of Sorrow... find the Lanterns and place these transponders upon them. I will then transport them to safety." — Kyle Rayner
"What about the Gray Energy? There's a lot more of it out there!" — [ Player character]
"Some Blue Lanterns are within the Gray valley. Use their blue light as a beacon - go to them when your sorrow is great, and they will clear it from your heart." — Kyle Rayner
"Got it." — [ Player character]
"The Gray is strong there. Your movement will be impaired, and the potency of Sorrow will be great indeed. Work smart, and work fast, my friend." — Kyle Rayner

sections.title: Objectives
items: Go to Mournful Mogo and Speak with Kyle Rayner for more information

"Welcome back to Mogo. Sorry it couldn't be under better circumstances, but as you can see - things are getting intense around here, Mogo and your friend Luzia are spreading a field of sorrow over the entire planet, turning it from green... to gray." — Kyle Rayner
"That's unfortunate... but how is that a Code Red situation?" — [ Player character]

"Mogo was holding many Black Lanterns prisoner. His overwhelming grief weakened him, allowing them to escape. And when the Gray Wave hit, it was like a bomb. Some folks out there were overwhelmed with grief, but some can be helped." — Kyle Rayner
"That... is definitely a big problem. What can we do?" — [ Player character]
"We need to help people in need, and destroy the Gray Energy Constructs that are inflicting Sorrow upon them." — Kyle Rayner
"Got it. Let's Go!" — [ Player character]

sections.title: Trivia
items: For players who are unfamiliar with the Lantern Corps lore and the previous events of Light and Rain, Kyle Rayner will answer questions to fill them in via dialogue option:; Q: Tell me more about Mogo. A: Mogo's a sentient planet, and a member of the Green Lantern Corps... until recently. He's one of the most powerful Lanterns alive. We need to free him from the Gray and bring him back to the Green before it's too late. Anything else I can answer?; Q: What's a Gray Lantern? A: A Gray Lantern is powered by sorrow. They can spread that feeling to others, amplifying it to overwhelming levels... making them "go Gray". Some people who go Gray become Gray Lanterns themselves. Others are eventually consumed by their grief... completely. Everyone who goes Gray boosts the signal, exposing even more people to the energy of sorrow. Left unchecked, it could become a galactic pandemic. Anything else I can answer?; Q: Black Lanterns? Zombies?! A: Black Lanterns are the undead soldiers of Nekron, the Lord of the Unliving. They draw their power from darkness... from Death. They fill their ranks by making more zombies, and if we don't stop 'em, they'll eliminate every living thing in existence.

title: Daring Rescue
summary: Daring Rescue is a weekly mission for heroes and villains given by John Stewart in Frozen Mogo.

sections.title: Overview
items: Daring Rescue is a weekly mission for heroes and villains given by John Stewart in Frozen Mogo.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Daring Rescue resembles Assault on Fear from Fearful Day, but easier. It can be started by interacting with a turret firing at a barrier at the Red Lantern Facility, in the southwest corner of Frozen Mogo, which would take down the barrier after a 1 minute countdown.

The mission requires 6 progress, and you can secure terminals 1, 2, and 3 in order, giving 1, 2, and 3 progress respectively, adding up to 6 if you succeed the whole run, but it can be done in multiple runs if you fail partially. While the game does not label which is which, you are supposed to go clockwise; the entrance is in the northeast, terminal 1 is in the southwest, terminal 2 is in the southeast, and terminal 3 is in the northeast.

A Green Lantern engineer would go to terminal 1 and begin to secure it signified by a green bar filling, which takes about 100 seconds. When it is completely filled, it is reset to be filled again, while another engineer would go to terminal 2 and start filling that green bar as well, and so on. Red Lanterns of increasing number and strength would spawn to attack them, but if the GLs fall, simply revive them - it is fast and cannot be interrupted by damage. Once all 3 terminals are secured, the refugees are freed and the scenario is a success.

A red Lockdown bar fills quickly whenever at least 1 engineer are down. If it fills completely, the scenario fails instantly. Securing a terminal for the first time also resets it to empty. However, engineers at secure terminals can still be downed. Also, this appears to be currently bugged and the scenario fails at about 40% lockdown.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Upon release, this mission was bugged, before it was fixed on 30 January. The turrets were non-interactive and repeatedly displayed the error message "BlockedFX: GREEN_LANTE" (the message is cut off mid-letter) in pale yellow text. sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Talk to Esperanza Cavalera at the pub. She'll tell you that Voivode is M.I.A., and she suspects that one of Voivode's enemies captured her.
Question Terrified Thugs

Get back to the Town area indicated on the map. You'll find crouched Terrified Thugs who are trying to avoid the Demons. Talk to 2 of them, and they'll run away in fear. When you interact with the third one, a shield will appear above his head, and he'll be attacked by 4 waves of Demons. Defeat the Demons, and the Thug will recognize you from the events of the Murder in Kaznia: Witness Protection mission. He doesn't know about Voivode, but he saw John Constantine being taken away by Demons. Report back to Esperanza at the pub.
Disrupt Demonic Rituals

Esperanza will tell about a ritual the Demons are conducting, asking you to question them. Go to the Forest located north of the Castle grounds. You'll find various pentagrams surrounded by Demons. Take down the Demons and interact with the pentagrams, then defeat the Demon that'll appear next. The 5th ritual you disrupt will summon a Loose-Lipped Imp — defeat him, then talk to him before the timer runs out. He doesn't know about Voivode's or Constantine's whereabouts, but he'll tell you that some of the civilians in Town are actually Demons in disguise.
Find Entrance to Demon Hideout

To to the area in Town indicated on your map. You must spot a Suspicious Civilian and follow them. Notice the purple icon above their heads, it indicates they're paying attention to their surroundings; that icon will change to a red exclamation mark if you get too close, and they'll stop walking, Pay attention to where they disappear, and a portal to the Kaznian Cellar will appear (if it doesn't, go to the location where the Civilian disappeared and wait for a few seconds). Go inside, and you'll find the Suspicious in their Demonic forms; Constantine is tied up in a ritual circle and guarded by a Lesser and an Outrage Demon. Defeat the Demons, break the urns (as instructed by Constantine), and rescue him.
Constantine will open a portal that will take you both back to the pub. Enter it to begin the next mission.

Eavesdrop Civilians

Go to the Town area indicated on the map. You'll find duos of citizens talking to each other; approach them carefully and stick to the circle's limits to listen to their conversation in its entirety. Rescue Voivode's Friend

Voivode contacts you to report that Jack, her sidekick, asked for help, and Voivode thinks the culprit is the serial killer you're tracking. Interact with her to hear her final words: she was attacked by the Magents, and she's dies just as she was about to reveal their plans. John Constantine calls you back to the pub.
Help Local Heroes

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Pride can be found in southwestern Infernal Kahndaq. It can be reached quickly through the teleporter on the west side of the starting area. The battle against Pride is more dynamic than against Injustice and there are not many safer areas for non-tanks, although the damage is not as consistently heavy. Pride attacks with Staff.

Ring of Pride: Pride marks a huge yellow ring centered around herself; after a short delay, the ring deals massive damage at all players on it and knocks them towards the center (players inside the ring are not hit). Part of the ring can be hidden by the surrounding slopes (if Pride is not positioned right in the middle of the pit), and the ring does affect players high up in the air. If you are at the outer edge of the ring, it can hit you twice which can deal extreme damage.

Firenado: Pride conjures a static, massive fire tornado at her current location. They will pull nearby targets into them, juggle targets already in them, and deal moderate damage over time. They last for a long time and several can be active at once.
Battle Charge: Pride charges several times at random directions, damaging and knocking aside targets on her path.
Irresistible Pull: A single-target beam that pulls and stuns a target, dealing heavy damage.

sections.title: Intro
items: (Weekly) The dark magic that Corum Rath has released upon Atlantis has driven the Beastmaster's brinehulks insane, turning one of them into a giant coprrupted monster. Take him out before he destroys the city.

sections.title: Objective
items: Defeat the Giant Brine Hulk attacking Briny Farms

sections.title: Combatants
items: Brine Hulk

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The mission requires you to defeat the giant Brine Hulk in the farm in southeastern Atlantis. It has several attacks:

Goo Projectile: Sprays green spheres in that roll in all directions, trapping any players they hit which cannot be broken out of normally and you must spam the left mouse button to free yourself faster while it deals heavy continuous damage.
Toxic Spit: An unavoidable ranged attack that knocks you down and deals relatively low damage over time.

Melee Attack: A standard melee attack that nevertheless can do massive damage in each hit (up to at least 50000 at minimum defence). There is also a Lethal attack version that is a charging slam with the same name.
Sonic Stun: Stuns and deals moderately heavy damage to all targets in a huge area.

While obviously much easier with a team, it is conceivable to solo it in Flight (if you are standing on ledges and the Brine Hulk can't reach you, it will Evade and reset its health). Both of its more dangerous attacks, Melee Attack and Goo Projectile, can't hit you in the air, and it lacks a true grounding attack (both ranged attacks disables you, but can be broken out of normally). Sonic Stun is a bit more dangerous due to its higher damage and with no warning, but with pets it would spend most of its time using Melee Attacks and Goo Projectiles on them. With multiple Shield Powers they would be able to fully keep up with Toxic Spit's damage, and you will only occasionally take a spike hit from Sonic Stun.

Warning: Do not lure the Brine Hulk far away from its spawning point. There is a danger that it resets health and you need to start over. It can also charge at players or pets and get itself stuck in one of the nearby pens - if it can't reach players eventually it would also reset.

items: Go to any of the 4 turrets listed above. You must interact specifically with the Sentry Turret targeted by a saboteur (identified with a cog icon). If you can't find the turret, you can wait a little for it to respawn.

Once you activate the turret, a massive wave of 50 Possessed Prisoners will come to destroy it. You must protect it and defeat 40 of those prisoners to finish the mission. sections.title: Speak to HAZMAT Johnson
items: Follow the Navigation Diamond (if it's active in Settings > UI) to north from the main Ace building to the Chemical Storage Pool. Johnson is down there on a platform. Interact with him to proceed.

sections.title: Destroy Mutant Clusters
items: You must destroy 7 radioactive clusters, while fighting with Mutants, Mutant Giants, and Sludges. If you stay close to the clusters, you'll be turned into a Sludge yourself - reverse the mutation by washing at the shower behind HAZMAT Johnson (note that Sludges will become friendly and follow you around when you're transformed). Stay on the platforms if you want to avoid damage. Go back to HAZMAT Johnson when you're done and interact with him to unlock the next objective.

sections.title: Dealing with Sludges
items: Stay near any of the clusters and wait a few seconds to be mutated (you will lose you movement ability, but the transformation will wear off after 5 minutes), then go near the Sludges. They'll follow you around, so you can lure them back to the HAZMATs to be washed clean. You'll need to lure 12 of them in any order. title: Explore Mxyzptlk's Metropolis Haunts
summary: Explore Mxyzptlk's Metropolis Haunts is a mission unique to the 2011 St. Patrick's Day event, Mister Mxyzptlk's Mischief. It is added to a character's journal upon completion of the event's introductory mission, Mxyleprechauns!. This mission can only be completed while the event is active.

sections.title: Overview
items: Explore Mxyzptlk's Metropolis Haunts is a mission unique to the 2011 St. Patrick's Day event, Mister Mxyzptlk's Mischief. It is added to a character's journal upon completion of the event's introductory mission, Mxyleprechauns!. This mission can only be completed while the event is active.

sections.title: Background
items: Mister Mxyzptlk, an imp from the Fifth Dimension, is known for the pranks he's played on Superman, Lex Luthor, and other super-powered beings over the years. He's had numerous confrontations in the past, and the trickster takes a sense of pride in his accomplishments. Now, as part of his most recent mischievous plot, Mxyzptlk is ready to share some of him more grandiose exploits with the world's newest batch of heroes and villains.

sections.title: Summary
items: " Visit some of Mister Mxyzptlk's favorite Metropolis destinations."

sections.title: Objectives
items: Visit Superman Statue
Speak with Mister Mxyzptlk at Superman Statue
Visit Daily Planet
Speak with Mister Mxyzptlk at Daily Planet
Visit Metropolis City Hall
Speak with Mister Mxyzptlk at City Hall
Visit Metropolis Museum of Art
Speak with Mister Mxyzptlk at Metropolis Museum of Art

sections.title: Rewards
items: 25 Cash
8 Lucky Clover

sections.title: Trivia
items: In 2018, this mission awarded 4 Lucky Clovers daily.
Since 2020 this former daily mission is a weekly one. It yields 14 Lucky Clovers.

Since 2022 the narrations for the mission locations have been changed. Original narrations (prior to 2022):; Superman Statue (labeled Supergoof Statue): "Grand, isn't it?! The Superman Memorial Statue in Centennial Park! Otherwise known as beginner targeting practice for the city's pigeon population! Nyahahaha!! Mmm. Speaking of... I need to go look up ol' Super-CHUMP! If he's going to fight against Brainiac, that boy is gonna need a brain!"; Daily Planet (labeled The Daily Yawn): "Ahh, The Daily Planet Building. If you squint through that Brainiac-bottle haze, you can see the tiny, dark speck of Lois Lane throwing herself out the window, hoping that Superman will rescue her! I'm always waiting for the day he doesn't! Hasn't happened yet, but... I can hope!"; City Hall (labeled My Old City Hall): "Here we have Metropolis City Hall--the hub of municipal government for the city. Where you Earth tools have something called "laws." I myself was Mayor once! Everything was going great until I was forced to take extended leave back in the 5th Dimension. Rest assured that anytime you want to do community service for the greater good, ultimately Super-GOON will show up and RUIN IT!"; Metropolis Museum of Art (labeled Museum of Art): "It's The Metropolis Museum of Art! Too bad Brainiac decided to become an art collector and bottle the whole building. In the 5th Dimension, we don't hang art on the walls; it's used for a more, uhh... 'sanitary' purpose! KER-FLUSHH! Ha ha! But you Earth dopes seem to love the stuff! Saps.
Since 2025 the mission rewards only 8 Lucky Clovers instead of 14.

title: Eye Spy
summary: Fry Brother Eye's drones as they target likely subjects for the OMAC virus in Gotham's Otisburg neighborhood.

sections.title: Overview
items: Fry Brother Eye's drones as they target likely subjects for the OMAC virus in Gotham's Otisburg neighborhood.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Find Brother Eye Drone Incursion Zone

" This is Batman. The OMAC virus is a deadly threat. But there is more. The virus was unleashed by my own creation: the Brother MK I satellite. Now rogue, it calls itself Brother Eye. I believed it to be deactivated and destroyed. I must find why and how it has sprung to life. For now, I need you to destroy its spy drones and help any citizens it may be targeting." — Batman

" This is Lex Luthor, and we have an opportunity. The OMAC virus is a deadly threat that must be met with equal force. But the mind deploying the OMACs is a valuable resource. It's called "Brother Eye," and it's a downed satellite created by Batman to store data on superhuman threats. Information like that I can use. For now, take out the drones and steal their memory cores. Let's see what we can find." — Lex Luthor
Blind Drones attacking citizens in the area (0/20)
Assist Citizens hurt by the Drones (0/20) (heroes)
Retrieve Memory Cores from disabled Drones (0/20) (villains)
" Calculator will review those memory cores to see if we can retrieve anything valuable. But this is just scratching the surface of the information we may find." — Lex Luthor
" These Brother Eye memory cores are encrypted in a Batman-level code. It's like decoding a giant-size Batman computer mind. Now there's a scary thought." — Calculator

Access to this content is available to all players for free. This open world mission is available to all Level 20+ players — stat buffs will be applied as needed. The target stats are boosted to a Combat Rating of 174 or 209 dependent on if player's Equipped CR is respectively below or above 194 (the CR for enemies in this zone).

sections.title: Intro
items: Starro has mind controlled Iconic Heroes and Villains. Find them and free them from his mind-control!

sections.title: Objectives
items: Locate and Defeat an Iconic Hero or Villain mind-controlled by Starro.

sections.title: Combatants
items: Controlled Black Lightning
Controlled Kid Flash
Controlled Trickster
Controlled Weather Wizard

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Defeat either of the controlled iconics in the map. The mission will be completed automatically.
All of the characters use their usual abilities plus Starro Beam. Attacking them will attract other Starro's nearby.

sections.title: Spawning points
items: Controlled Black Lightning:; North of the western market, under the Mercury Communications Sign; By the tall building next to the S.T.A.R. Labs outpost, on the street leading to the Combines Arena; On the roof of the building west of Mera's dome.
Controlled Kid Flash:; Western roof of the Flash Museum; Across the street from the river bank, by the Bakery near Mera's dome'; By the Flash Statue at the Park.

Controlled Trickster:; At the intersection north of the Flash Museum; At the Hotel northwest of Flash Museum, under the Diane's Diamonds sign.; Northeast of Flash Museum, above the Central City Comics store.
Controlled Weather Wizard:; On the top of the tall building next to the S.T.A.R. Labs outpost; On the very top of the Flash Museum; On the top of the M* Bank building next to the LexCorp outpost.

title: Falling STARs
summary: Falling STARs is a level 17 villain mission started upon talking to General Grosha for Call of the Wild.

sections.title: Overview
items: Falling STARs is a level 17 villain mission started upon talking to General Grosha for Call of the Wild.
Recover Grodd's technology from STAR Labs.

sections.title: Objectives
items: " This is Lex Luthor. Gorilla Grodd is a member of good standing in the Society, which is why I'm humoring him in this endeavor. His plan to devolve humanity is absurd, of course, but we can still turn the situation to our advantage. After you recover Grodd's tech, destroy STAR Labs' containment devices. Show them that Metropolis is really more of a... LexCorp kind of town." — Lex Luthor
Get to the crash site at Centennial Park
Overload STAR Containment Units to Regain Grodd's Technology (0/10)
Neutralize STAR Labs Forces (0/20)

" Grodd's goal is to reclaim the planet for the apes for devolving them all to a primal state. *I* was going to reclaim it for the couch potatoes, but I just never got around to making the device." — Calculator

sections.title: Notes
items: Overloading the devices briefly transforms the player into a gorilla and they would not be able to attack. By summoning a pet like a Watcher or a Suppressor Turret, they would take the transformation instead.

sections.title: Background
items: Following the increase of magical forces both benign and malevolent, the Department of Metahuman Affairs announces that the Sentinels of Magic, led by master sorcerer Doctor Fate, will be combating villainous magic in Metropolis and beyond.

sections.title: Intro 1
items: " I am the Goddess Circe, and I am impressed. Not all of Brainiac's targets are strong enough to escape him. Turn your magic to my cause, and we will rule this planet with our power! The first step is destroying the strongholds Doctor Fate and his Sentinels of Magic have made in Chinatown. Show them they cannot stand against our might!" — Circe

sections.title: Objective 1
items: Go to Chinatown in Metropolis.

sections.title: Intro 2
items: " This area was built over powerful occult magics, which can tip either toward good... or evil. Doctor Fate has created a purifying ward in the hopes of trapping the demon lord Trigon in his dimension. His Sentinels of Magic think their pitiful enchantments can stop us. show them they are sadly mistaken." — Circe

sections.title: Objective 2
items: Punish Apprentices before they can cast protective wards (0/7).

title: Fear Itself
summary: Take out Scarecrow in his sewer lair, and rescue Batwoman from her nightmares.

sections.title: Overview
items: Take out Scarecrow in his sewer lair, and rescue Batwoman from her nightmares.

sections.title: Intro
items: " I've tracked Scarecrow's lair to the sewers beneath the east end. Batwoman has gone in - and she's out of comm contact. Not any good. Get in there and end Scarecrow's reign of terror." — Batman
skrrrt

sections.title: Objective
items: Help Batwoman defeat and arrest Scarecrow.
Neutralize leaking fear gas barrels x3
Transport leaking fear gas barrels x3

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: As you make your way through the sewers, you will get stunned and the Scarecrow will taunt you. However, don't move too fast at the beginning as when you get stunned some hallucination will spawn.
Continue down the sewer and attack the first group of hallucinations. Only the ones with a gun is real.

Then make your way to a large room but don't get too close. You need to carefully pull the henchmen to you. There are a lot of henchmen in this room. The henchmen will stun you and if you pull too many you'll get knocked-out.

After you have taken them out you can begin taking the gas barrels. Take each barrel from the room to the sewer ladder you need to press E. Then make your way back and a group of mobs will need to be taken out. This happens each barrels.
After the barrels when you enter the room you will face off against 2 mini-bosses Edward and Eddie. Simple take them out with your range attack.
Then continue into the next room. This is where you will have a multi-phase Scarecrow fight.
It starts with the cut-scene. Then you attack by 4 Scarecrow's. After this you will face one of the following 4:
This is random-
Herpetophobia the fear of reptiles
You face off against a group of Killer Crocs. When you knock them down press E or they get back up.
Astraphobia the fear of thunder and lighting
You battle Scarecrow while dodging lighting.
Protophobia the fear of betrayal
You battle against members of the Bat Family
Ballistophobia the fear of bullets
The Scarecrow shoots at you as you fight.
After each one of the above you will face a group of Terror Bats

When you have finished the last phobia and bats you will face Scarecrow himself and a group of henchmen. Focus on the Scarecrow first. If you are knocked out before you take him out you'll have to do the whole Scarecrow fight again.
There is also a treasure box in the back of the room.

sections.title: Result
items: Random mob dropped: Magnus Robotics Prototype Helmet
Edward and Eddie: Boots of Nightmare
Scarecrow: Fear Gas Diffison Tank
38 cash
Upon completion you will receive the feat - Fear - It's a Gas

sections.title: Notes
items: All the fears except Protophobia are really fears.

sections.title: Objectives
items: " Welcome, warrior. We will need your skills in this fight. The Atlanteans are invading and turning innocents into water-breathing slaves. We must find Aquaman and end this unjustified attack. Until then, act with force! Push them back, and free the enslaved humans!" — Wonder Woman

sections.title: Notes
items: Sentinel Carstairs, who starts the side mission Tidal Waves, could be found in the area.
The Suicide Slums is south of the Chinatown Police Station.
The Atlanteans attacking include Kitefins, Sandtigers, Threshers and Tiger Sharks. All of them count towards the mission. Watch out for Tiger Sharks' special attack that hits over 400.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This mission is very similar to Bestiamorph Havoc and possibly The Search for Wonder Girl. Both involves defeating an alien race, who convert humans which must be defeated to restore to normal, and even identical floating crystals. Both missions are also directed by Wonder Woman.

Tiger Sharks are notable for being extremely similar to Bestiamorph Berserkers, having very weak normal attacks and a strong charge attack, as well as being able to ground players when its peers cannot.
Despite what Wonder Woman and Oracle said might imply, Aquaman could still be found in the Magic Wing of the Watchtower during these missions, and the conversation is no different.

summary: Fun for Girls and Boys is one of three level 30 daily missions in the Toyman's Time Out set that could be started at the terminals in the Monitor Womb of the Watchtower or in the Sabotage Chamber in the Hall of Doom.

sections.title: Overview
items: " It's Oracle. Something crazy's going down and I think you're the one to restore order. We're talking some serious weird. And it's happening every day. Up for it? Because we could sure use you!" — Oracle
"" — Calculator

Fun for Girls and Boys is one of three level 30 daily missions in the Toyman's Time Out set that could be started at the terminals in the Monitor Womb of the Watchtower or in the Sabotage Chamber in the Hall of Doom.

sections.title: Intro
items: Toyman's attempt to break into Stryker's is more than just fun and games. Restore power to Stryker's defenses and send Toyman's toys to the trash bin.

sections.title: Objective
items: Locate Stryker's Island North Prison Yard
Use the Carging Stations to keep the Power Core charged while transporting it to the top of the Penitentiary to restore power
Find and grab hold of the Power Cores that keep Stryker's generators running
" Now that's what I call a nice clean job. I love when there's no paper work. (laughs) That's another computer joke ... * sigh* Ok, fine. One day I'll come up with a funny one." — Oracle
" You know, your confidence is starting to scare me. Just kidding! Who's my best bud? You Are!" — Calculator

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: This is actually a movement skill course. You need to carry a power core into the finish by jumping and moving through an obstacle course built from NPCs and inanimate objects without ever touching any obstacle or being touched by it. If that happens you will drop your package, though you might have enough time to pick it up again at least once. You only have limited time between the checkpoints (charging stations). If you time out, you need to start all over. The arrow above your head always shows you in which direction to move.
Of the three missions in the set this one is by far the hardest.

sections.title: Notes
items: After game update 20 the mission has been moved from the open world to an own instance to make room for the Home Turf episode content. Going to Stryker's manually does no longer work. The player has to go through the teleporter in the Monitor Womb (Watchtower) or the Sabotage Chamber (Hall of Doom) to start the missions.
Since game update 27 the mission is replayable. Resetting always costs 15 replay badges, no matter whether 1, 2 or 3 of the missions in the set are locked.

sections.title: Rescue Hostages on Third Floor
items: Go to the top floor, where you'll find Confused Prisoners attacking Prison Guards. When you come near them, the prisoners will tie the guard's hands behind their backs (turning them into Captured Prison Guards), and you'll have a limited amount of time to defeat the enemies nearby and free the guard. Rescue 5 guards to proceed to the next objective.

sections.title: Recover Device on Second Floor
items: Go down to the floor below, where you'll find devolved Crazed Prisoners the trapped security guards in chambers attached to the device you have to recover. Break the chamber, defeat the Prisoners and grab the device. You'll get an arrow above your head pointing to one of the upper circles of turrets. sections.title: Speak to Special Agent Wellumson
items: Follow the Navigation Diamond (if it's active in Settings > UI) to the north portion of Ace Chemicals. Agent Wellumson is on the middle of street, between two police vehicles. Interact with him and he'll tell you what to do next.

sections.title: Defeat Ace Lieutenants + Destroy Forklifts
items: Now that you know what to do, go into the Ace Chemicals grounds.
You must defeat 5 of the Lieutenants, the tallest security clowns wearing a dark purple suit. You can find them everywhere in the building.

The forklifts that you need to destroy can be found in a few locations, identified with white dots (if they're on the same level as you) or white arrows (if they're on different levels from you) on your minimap, and with a yellow lightning icon above them in the world, while the objective is active.
Their locations and numbers can only be estimated, as they take a time to respawn:
2 forklifts and 5 Ace Lieutenants on the ground level, southwest portion.
6 forklifts and 3 Ace Lieutenants on the ground level, southeast portion.
2 forklifts and 2 Ace Lieutenants on the ground level (1 of them on the stairs), northeast portion.
1 forklift on middle level on southwest.
2 forklifts and 1 Ace Lieutenant on the top of the building.
You can destroy them with weapon attacks (only a few superpower moves can destroy environment items). Destroy 8 of them to proceed.

sections.title: Speak with Special Agent Wellumson
items: Return to Agent Wellumson. Interact with him and so he can tell you that he received a distress call from one of the HAZMAT agents, and ask for you to check on him.

sections.title: Find Missing HAZMAT Officer
items: There are a few HAZMAT Officers in the area (marked with a white dot/arrow in the minimap). They're down and with a gear icons above their heads, which means you need to interact with them. Choose one to proceed.
After the interaction, he's no longer Hazmat Officer, but the giant Experiment 529. Defeat him to finish the mission and return to the Foreman to collect your rewards.

title: Hellspore Convoy
summary: Hellspore Convoy is a weekly mission for heroes and villains given by Black Canary in Apokoliptic Gotham City.

sections.title: Overview
items: Hellspore Convoy is a weekly mission for heroes and villains given by Black Canary in Apokoliptic Gotham City.

sections.title: Intro
items: (Weekly) Hellspores are being produced at the Clocktower in Apokoliptic Gotham City and then sent to Darkseid's stockpile in Apokolips. Let's not find out what he intends to do with them. Instead, intercept Hellspore Convoys as they leave the Clocktower and before they can be sent to Apokolips!

sections.title: Objectives
items: Intercept Hellspore Convoys in Apokoliptic Gotham City [0/100]
Return to Black Canary in Apokoliptic Gotham City

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The convoys always start west of the clocktower, and go on a fixed path towards northwest, disappearing through a boom tube east of the massive Apokoliptic structure in the northwest corner of the map.

Destroying one Convoy Transport carrying a hellspore is sufficient to complete the mission. The Convoy Transport cannot attack, nor can it be attacked at first. Players must kill the mobs following it to deactivate its red shield before it can be damaged. Normally, it takes about 3 minutes for the Convoy Transport to reach its destination; it disappears when it reaches the boom tube. Then, it takes about 4 minutes for a new convoy to appear at the starting point.
At some point before Patrol 4: Harley Quinn vs. Apokolips, the health of the mobs and the Convoy Transport is greatly reduced, making it easy to solo.

The easiest way to complete this mission is to intercept the convoy the moment it appears; players can knock/pull (e.g. with Engulf or Mesmerizing Lasso) the mobs into the Pool of Lava immediately east of the spawning location, which traps them, deals massive damage and kills them in seconds (take care not to fall in yourself as it will KO you too). This is easiest to do with flight. Even if you cannot damage the Convoy Transport fast enough to destroy it before it leaves, killing all mobs gives 26 credit towards the mission (out of 100), so it takes 4 times to complete the mission.

As the Convoy Transport has unit collision with players, it is possible to stall it significantly simply by standing in its way and gaining more time to take out the convoy and destroy the Transport. By standing in the middle of the boom tube, players can prevent it from leaving indefinitely.
There is an issue where the mobs would sometimes desert the Convoy Transport and run back to their spawn spot, forcing players to go back to kill them to make the Convoy Transport targetable.

items: (Weekly - 8 Player) Batmage is summoning demons on what used to be the steps of the Hall of Justice in Death Metal Washington, D.C. Send his brutal hoards back to Hell!

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You could choose to defeat 100 Shadow Batman Lesser Demons, or defeat the Giant Shadow Batman Demon boss to instantly complete the mission. It is the only out of the 3 weekly bounties in the episode to allow you to opt out of the boss, although the boss is also the easiest of the 3.
Giant Shadow Batman Demon uses Hand Blast.
Intimidating Bellow: The Demon roars at the sky, damaging and stunning nearby targets. Vulnerable to interrupt.
Spike Wave: Warned by lethal attack icon. The Demon marks a red cone in front of him before punching the ground, damaging anyone within and knocking them back.
Disintegration Beam: The Demon deals heavy damage over time to a single target with a beam attack. Vulnerable to interrupt.
Shadow Bomb: The Demon spins in place and flings dark purple projectiles.
At about 60% health, these hazard attacks would start to be used with voice lines from the Batmage.
Mystical Fire Field: "Hellfire upon you!" Purple circles appear an after a brief delay begin to burn targets within for moderate damage.
Mass Void Strike: "Chaos magic, bring an age of distrust!" Similar but larger and deeper purple circles with heavier damage.

title: Homecoming: Game On!
summary: Homecoming: Game On! is a daily mission for heroes and villains given by Raven on Homecoming: Titans Island during the Homecoming event.

sections.title: Overview
items: Homecoming: Game On! is a daily mission for heroes and villains given by Raven on Homecoming: Titans Island during the Homecoming event.

sections.title: Intro
items: Play Homecoming Games in Homecoming: Titans Island.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Play Homecoming Games in Homecoming: Titans Island [0/50]
Return to Raven on Homecoming: Titans Island

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Step on a platform and use the console to start a party game.

sections.title: Boulder Toss & Bowl
items: You have to hit targets of differing sizes with lava boulders. Your loadout will change during this game. Use the bowl power for targets on the ground and the toss power for targets in the air.
5 x 5 targets will appear with a short break inbetween. Targets will merely appear in front of you.

It's a good idea to shoot the targets in order (1-5). If the last two targets of a set are both in the same location - ground or air -, it will be impossible to shoot both in countdown order since powers have a short cooldown and the target timers are tight(er).

images.label: Party Game - Boulder Toss and Bowl

sections.title: Scooch Your Booty
items: The goal of this game to step on the green squares ("cool colors") while avoiding the red squares ("hot colors"). For better orientation there is a little wall showing the colors as well. During the game your movement mode will switch to Super Speed.

Colors will appear in three steps. The cold color cycle is purple-blue-green, and the hot one goes yellow-orange-red. Standing on a green square gives you credit towards the mission while a red square knocks you away. The color phases will get faster and more cold colored squares will appear.
Between rounds there is a short break with no colors. Use it to relocate to the middle in order to have short ways in all directions.

sections.title: Shooting Gallery
items: You have to shoot flying Titan Drones with a ballista. Your loadout will change upon entering the turret (you cannot be form changed). The first ability, Ballista Bolt, fires a bolt at your aiming direction. The second ability, Energy Blast, hits any Drones close by, and is the only way to hit drones directly above you due to the ballista's limited elevation angle. Both deal 2 million damage and destroys the Drone in one hit.

There are 5 launchers on the ground in a circle around the ballista, necessitating constant turning to find targets and aim. Drones are launched from them in a fixed sequence. 3 of the launchers will launch 1 Titan Drone (Tier 1) each, then 3 launchers launch 1 Titan Drone (Tier 2), until Tier 5 Drones, or 15 Drones in 5 waves. The whole set is launched 5 times, or 75 Drones in total. New drones make a soft sound when launched. Drones persist and fly around for a while before expiring, with higher tier Drones expiring faster and being smaller. Aqualad will says the game's almost over when all Drones have been launched.

Most points would be from Ballista Bolt, as Energy Blast has a limited range, and Drones, especially high tier drones, are rarely in range for it. Ballista Bolt has a very generous hitbox so it can hit Drones with its explosion even though it doesn't look like a direct hit. However, one Bolt can only hit one Drone even if they are very close to each other.

This is the only carnival game that is practically not possible to complete perfectly, due to how fast the Drones spawn and expire and the cooldown on your abilities. Instead, the Perfect Scores feat define a perfection completion has destroying at least 40 Drones.

summary: Hydra Havok is a weekly mission for heroes and villains given by Lieutenant Egeria in Patchwork Themyscira as part of the Wonderverse episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Hydra Havok is a weekly mission for heroes and villains given by Lieutenant Egeria in Patchwork Themyscira as part of the Wonderverse episode.

sections.title: Intro
items: Defeating all the leaders of the invading forces releases a rampaging Hydra from the Gates of Tartarus! Rush to defeat it before it overwhelms the Patchwork Themysciran defenses.

sections.title: Objectives
items: After all of the invading leaders have been successfully defeated in succession, the Rampaging Hydra will appear.
Return to Commander Adonia

sections.title: Combatants
items: Rampaging Hydra
Spartoi Warrior

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The Rampaging Hydra will only awake from her slumber if the bounty fights for Murk, Ares, Athena and Kalibak/ Steppenwolf have been successful.
Like all bounties in Patchwork Themyscira this is a timed fight.
While fighting the beast always try to be in a flanking position. Absolutely avoid facing her heads as she does devastating and far reaching attacks with those.
Avoid green or red ground areas. Green areas are ichor and will damage you heavily, red areas are an upcoming damage warning. Roll out of those.
When she loses teeth try to interupt the process of forming Spartoi Warrior by going there and using those while their timer is still running.
When the Wonder Women announce that they are ready to muscle the Hydra, go to one of them to initiate the lassoing. It will silence one head of the Hydra for a while.

Do not use Orbital Strikes on the Rampaging Hydra as that will make her lose many more teeth as usual which will develop into Spartoi Warriors. Too many spawned warriors will seriously hamper the opportunities to damage the Rampaging Hydra (unless crowd controlled).
Player characters can reenter the fighting area after being knocked out and having respawned. Use the teleporter in the mission hub after a respawn.
Apart from the weekly rewards 12 Empyrean Aether will drop for a successful defeat, 6 Empyrean Aether for a failure.

8 Source Marks
Wonderverse: Large Loot Cache

sections.title: Overview
items: I Beam You is one of the three possible missions for heroes and villains in the Wonder Woman's Missions set. It requires the Earth 3 episode and a combat rating of 150+.

sections.title: Intro
items: (Daily) Ultraman watches this world from the stars and incinerates anyone who says or does anything he doesn't like with his eye beams. He's a super powered spoiled brat who needs to learn that the people of this planet are not his toys and that he should play nicely with others. Until we can pound those lessons into Ultraman's thick skull, try to save people who foolishly provoke him.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Save civilians from being incinerated by Ultraman's heat vision strikes (0/6)
Return to Wonder Woman and let her know of your progress

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: You must move close to a Civilian with a magnifying glass icon above their heads, at which point they will say a line that is usually (but not always) inciting Ultraman's retaliation. In the former case, you must interact with them, which would push them out of the way of the incoming Heat Vision from the skies (occasionally they can become "stuck" in their original position, maybe because they are against a wall, but as long as you interacted with them it will work). You can Dodge the beam yourself, but it is unlikely to kill you.

sections.title: Intro
items: (Weekly) The Wizard Shazam has called from the Rock of Eternity to coordinate the assault against the most unfair of the Seven Deadly Enemies, Injustice, and thwart its attack an Infernal Kahndaq.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Injustice can be found in the pit at the very southern end of Infernal Kahndaq. It can be reached quickly through the teleporter on the west side of the starting area. Injustice attacks with Brawling combos.
Flightsnare: Single-target dark beam that grounds and pulls the target towards Injustice.

Burning Injustice: Starts to be used when Injustice falls below about 60% health. Massive black and orange flames blanket the arena, dealing constant damage to all targets within. This can cover a large area and obscure the screen significantly, but as Injustice and this attack are usually confined in the pit, players who don't want to be in melee distance can usually stand over the northern ledge to evade them as long as other players have Injustice's attention in the pit.

Flame Grenade: Warned by Lethal attack icon. Injustice knocks back and grounds all players (does not do damage) before flinging out numerous orange balls that erupt after a couple seconds, dealing damage to nearby targets. Often used at the same time as Burning Injustice.
Injustice additionally summons Flames of Injustice.
Fireball: Ranged attack that burns over time.
Flame Aura

Self-Destruct: Warned by a mid-screen message. If the Flames of Injustice were not KO'ed in time, they will fly a certain distance in a random direction before detonating, dealing massive damage to all nearby targets.

title: Journal
summary: The Journal is an interface that allows players to keep track of their current missions.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Journal is an interface that allows players to keep track of their current missions.
Missions are grouped into several categories:
Completed - Completed missions needing to be clicked to complete
Main Missions - Classic Game missions (See Hero, Villain and Mentor-based Missions)
Story Missions - Introductory missions meant to be played through the first time a player begins a new Story Arc ( Episode or Chapter)
Featured Story Missions - Story Missions from the three most recent Story Arcs
Daily Missions - Repeatable Daily Missions from DLC Story Arcs
Weekly Missions - Repeatable Weekly Missions from DLC Story Arcs
Seasonal Missions - Missions tied to Seasonal Events
Side Missions - Classic Game Side Missions, Randomly assigned Story Arc Missions from a Mission Set, Exploration and Bounty missions
Instructional Missions - Missions that teach players a new location, game process, or equippable upgrades.
On Duty Missions - Classic Game Tier 1 Alerts missions
Miscellaneous - Classic Game PvP Bounty/Wanted missions, Arena PvP Arenas missions

Players can single-tap the mission to view its content, which includes the description, objective(s) and reward(s). Double-tap the title or click the Track button on the lower right corner to track the mission, which will display the objective on the mission track reminder and trigger a communicator delivering message from a related character when appropriate. The mission track reminder can be turned off in the UI settings.

When a mission does not disappear upon completion, players would need to press the Complete button to remove it from the journal. If such action does not perform the described function, it could be that the inventory requires reorganization, or the mission has more than one reward to choose from, in which the player needs to pick their option under the Rewards banner to proceed.

sections.title: Gallery
items: Another glitch that causes the player to appear in where the face of Batman/ Oracle should be. Also shows the merged missions glitch - this time, the upper one is the correct message for Logic Loses but the lower one belongs to Lethal Pod-Cast.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Many missions, especially while leveling up to level 30, do not have a taskmaster and will automatically appear in the journal, triggered either by the completion of a previous mission, reaching a specific combat rating or during a certain time ( Events).

Game Update 168 added "Warp to Mission" functionality to the Journal. Players leveling through Metropolis and Gotham City content (levels 1–30) can now teleport directly to their active mission's location straight from the Mission Journal, making navigation faster and more accessible for new and returning players alike.

At sometime in early summer 2026. many early Classic Game leveling missions have had the final mission in the story arc mission chain revamped to replace concluding the mission by returning to the Safe House and interacting with a character, to receiving a Message from the character and interacting via the messages dialog system.

sections.title: Mission-set location context
items: Story Missions are listed under the category of the same name in the player's Journal. They will appear there either automatically, or after visiting the open-world zone for the first time via the Orrery of Worlds Teleporter in House of Legends, via Warp from the Events menu

sections.title: Summary
items: Lady Shiva is determined to prevent Ra's al Ghul from turning the League of Assassins into an Earth-cleansing army. Speak with Lady Shiva in the Archive of Victory aboard the House of Legends and conspire with an additional ally in the power struggle against the Demon's Head.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Lady Shiva is determined to prevent Ra's al Ghul from turning the League of Assassins into an Earth-cleansing army. Speak with Lady Shiva in the Archive of Victory aboard the House of Legends and conspire with an additional ally in the power struggle against the Demon's Head.
After speaking with her, use the Custom Play section of the On Duty Menu to queue for the Alert [Tier 1]: League of Assassins Stronghold.

" Heroes, villains. These words mean nothing to me. All that matters is the battle. Ra's al Ghul is the Demon's Head, leader of the League of Assassins. His obsession with cleansing the Earth has turned him away from honorable combat. He must be forced to? re-evaluate his priorities. Talia has a personal interest, she will tell you more when you arrive." — Lady Shiva

sections.title: Trivia
items: As of February 2025, the text from the Summary and the Objetives sections are the same.

In the original version of this mission:; CR required was 53.; The Summary and Objective used to be "Lady Shiva requires your presence."; For heroes, Oracle used to have the following intro line: " This is Oracle. I have a slightly unusual request...from Lady Shiva. She's looking for someone to take on the League of Assassins. I'll warn you, if she hadn't called in a personal favor, I'd never have let her into the Watchtower. Be on your guard."; For villains, Calculator used to have the following intro line: " Calculator here. You know, a lot of our female villains are really hot. Incidentally, Lady Shiva is in the Hall of Doom looking for warm bodies to throw into a Lazarus Pit. Or something like that - I got a little distracted when she was talking. She can tell you more in person."
Although Lady Shiva can be found in both Watchtower and Hall of Doom, speaking with her in those locations will not count for the mission since the House of Legends update.

sections.title: Intro
items: (Weekly) Darkseid created Brimstone to rid our planet of super-powered beings who oppose him. Brimstone failed. Darkseid doesn't accept failure. Brimstone's punishment is to stand guard over their magma extracting machine in Gotham. Find some friends and help Brimstone fail even more.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The Huntress is located on the rooftop near Brimstone, next to the teleporter. Talk to her to begin your mission.

Defeating Brimstone alone only grants 90 points out of the 100 needed to complete the mission. Each Lava Fiend found near lava pools around the map, including the ones that spawn during the fight against Brimstone, grants 1 point each.

Unlike other bounties, Lava Fiends defeated by other players during the bounty fight won't count for every player fighting him (unless they're in a group). Only players who directly engaged with the Fiends in some way will receive points upon defeat.
After reaching 100 points, talk to Huntress again to collect your prizes.

title: Logic Loses
summary: Logic Loses is a level 30 mission started upon the completion of Emergency Response.

sections.title: Overview
items: Logic Loses is a level 30 mission started upon the completion of Emergency Response.
The Watchtower lost contact with security in the Containment Facility. Hawkman and Hawkgirl went in to investigate and have not reported back. Find the missing heroes and bring security back online.

sections.title: Objectives
items: " I've received reports of a troubling situation in the Watchtower's Containment Facility. Can you check in with security there? You may need to assemble a team for this one." — Oracle
Assemble a Team and Enter the Watchtower Containment Facility to Investigate the Disappearance of Hawkman and Hawkgirl
Restore Watchtower Containment Facility Security
Report Back to the Watchtower Security Guard

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Enter the Containment Facility at the east end of the lowest floor of the Magic Wing. Go past several broken robots. The door opens when the player approaches.
After the corridor is several Security Guards and three turrets apparently hacked by Brainiac. The turrets cannot be attacked.

The guards are difficult, but not impossible, for a single player to defeat. However, the player must interact with the security terminal at the other end of the room to proceed. As there are three turrets and their attacks interrupts the process, the player must have three other players to distract them while they work on the terminal. While crates briefly block their attacks, they don't last nearly long enough.

" Emergency! I'm showing a strong Brainiac presence near the reactor core! This prison break was just to slow us down while they sabotaged the Watchtower's power supply! If the core goes, the Watchtower goes with it. Hurry!" — Oracle
After defeating many hordes of Brainiac bots, freeing Hawkman and Hawkgirl and securing the Reactor Core, exit the facility and talk to the security guard to the south.

" [exhale] Man. Well. The core's been salvaged, and you managed to limit the damage Brainiac's done. Oh, and saved everyone in the Watchtower. I'd call that a good day's work. Head back and let the security forces know it's safe to come in and clean up. I'll start patching our security defenses. And - thanks." — Oracle

items: Cash: $125
Shielded Nth-Metal Helmet
Mark of Triumph

sections.title: Trivia
items: For some reason, even though the player enters the facility from the Magic Wing of the Watchtower, leaving to their "last position" would lead them to outside the Chinatown Police Station.

sections.title: Overview

Mechanical Mech is one of the daily missions for heroes in the Secure Stryker's Island set from the Home Turf episode. It requires a combat rating of 60+.

sections.title: Intro
items: The perimeter of Stryker's Island is compromised and in desperate need of attention. Steel will contact you to explain how you can bolster the exterior's resistance.

sections.title: Objective
items: Use the terminal in the Processing Area near the Forman to activate the Steelworks Construction Robot
Use the Steelworks Construction Robot to seal Bulkhead Breaches on the Northern or Southern Exterior Wall [0/4]
Find the downed helicopter and secure its black box before the prisoners can get to it
Return to the Stryker's Island staging area and speak with the Steelworks Communication Foreman

sections.title: Combatants
items: Nuclear Winter Recruit
Nuclear Winter Leader
Prison Saboteur

sections.title: Sealing the Breaches
items: For this objective, you'll need to activate the terminal to assume the form of a Steelworks robot. It'll give you the Agile basic movements, the Martial Arts basic attacks and the following superpowers: Pneumatic Fist, EMP, Energy Detonation, Blast Cone, Repair Routine, and Revert Form. The transformation will wear off after a while, and you'll have to return to the terminal to transform again.
There are 4 sets of doors around the penitentiary:
Set of three doors in the southeast corner
Set of four doors in the southwest corner
Set of four doors in the northwest corner
Set of three doors in the northeast corner

Get close to the doors and wait. Prison Saboteurs will break down the doors, and you'll need to fix that. You can only interact with the doors as a Steelworks Robot. You can revert back to your normal form once you're done (the sixth power in the Ability Tray).

sections.title: Finding the Helicopters
items: The helicopters can spawn in many places across the island, including (only 2 at a time):
Southwest next to the penitentiary's outer doors.
Southeast on the lower levels, close to the ocean.
North on the lower levels, close to the ocean.
Northeast near the penitentiary's outer doors.
Northeast, surrounded by large rocks.

Defeat the Nuclear Winter Recruits attacking the helicopter and the Nuclear Winter Leader that comes out of it to stop you from getting the black box, then interact with the black box to complete the mission. Both the helicopter and the box will auto-destroy once you're done.

title: Mentor-based Missions
summary: Selecting a Mentor in DC Universe Online doesn't just determine your starting area, it also determines the Mission lines you follow throughout the game.
