sections.title: Overview
items: Selecting a Mentor in DC Universe Online doesn't just determine your starting area, it also determines the Mission lines you follow throughout the game. Each Mentor provides a mission from their main story arcs at level 5, level 15, and level 30 for their New Heroes or New Villains. As levels and renown increase, the player character's skills are solicited by other senior members of the JLA or Secret Society via missions from other story arcs or Miscellaneous Missions, forming the player's Mission Chain. Some of these missions are unique to Morality (hero or villain), some parallel the opposing morality and tell a story from either the hero or villain perspective.
Concluding the Level 15 through Level 17 Missions set is required for:
Accessing the On Duty menu for Instance content in Casual difficulty mode
Level 20+ characters accessing both Events content as well as Story Arcs open-world zones via the Orrery of Worlds teleporter in the House of Legends.

sections.title: Meta ( Superman)
items: Main Article: Meta Hero Storyline
Meta Heroes choose Superman as their Mentor.

They begin in Metropolis's Little Bohemia, where Gorilla Grodd has invaded and is transforming citizens into gorillas. It is up to the new Hero, fresh off the Brainiac Harvester Ship to stop him (with a little guidance from Superman).

At level 15, Superman provides his Heroes with a new quest. Metallo is in the S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility while Lex Luthor has invaded a STAR Lab Secret Facility and is stealing their Exobyte research. Superman asks for the Hero's help in bringing him to justice. Superman and the Hero fight side by side, but Lex Luthor escapes.

Leading up to level 30, the Hero receives their most important Mission yet, to find Superman and beat Metallo, Cheetah and finally Lex Luthor once and for all in the Hall of Doom. The Meta story line culminates at level 30, when the player character gets to meet with Superman in person at the House of Legends for a kind bit of praise.

sections.title: Tech ( Batman)
items: Main Article: Tech Hero Storyline
Tech Heroes choose Batman as their Mentor.

They begin in Gotham City's East End, where Scarecrow has been releasing Fear Gas into the streets. It is up to the new Hero, fresh off the Brainiac Harvester Ship to stop him (with a little guidance from Batman).

At level 15, Batman provides his Heroes with a new quest. Joker has developed a new toxin and is planning to use it on the Gotham City Special Crimes Unit while they are all off duty at the East End Regal Hotel. Batman asks for the Hero's help in bringing him to justice. Batman and the Hero fight side by side, but Joker escapes.

Leading up to level 30, Batman gives the Hero their most important Mission yet, to stop Joker's plans once and for all by bringing down the source of his toxin, T.O. Morrow. The Tech story line culminates at level 30, when the player character gets to meet with Batman in person at the House of Legends for a moment of solemn recognition.

sections.title: Magic ( Wonder Woman)
items: Main Article: Magic Hero Storyline
Magic Heroes choose Wonder Woman as their Mentor.

They begin in Metropolis's Chinatown, where Felix Faust has invaded and is stealing citizens' souls. It is up to the new Hero, fresh off the Brainiac Harvester Ship to stop him (with a little guidance from Wonder Woman and help from Zatanna in the final battle).
At level 15, Wonder Woman provides her Heroes with a new quest : preventing Circe from stealing magic exobytes at her headquarter Chinatown Cafe with a little help of Wonder Woman and her Amazons.

Leading up to level 30, you head to the Oblivion Bar to help Wonder Woman and Circe in stopping Brainiac from invading the realm of magic. The Magic story line culminates at level 30, when the player character gets to meet with Wonder Woman in person at the House of Legends for a special honor fitting of a warrior.

sections.title: Meta ( Lex Luthor)
items: Main article: Meta Villain Storyline
Meta Villains choose Lex Luthor as their Mentor.

They begin in Metropolis's Little Bohemia, where Lex Luthor is developing a method to take down the new super heroes by transforming them into copies of Parasite. Luthor needs the help of the new Villain, fresh off the Brainiac Harvester Ship, to help him finish the tests and prevent Power Girl from stopping them.
At level 15, Lex Luthor provides his Villains with a new quest to steal exobytes research from the Old Star Labs installations, in two instances where you fight Steel and Superman himself.

Leading up to level 30, villains will fight against Steel, Zatanna, and Superman himself in The Watchtower: An Opportunity before concluding the Meta story line at level 30 by meeting the big boss Lex Luthor in person on board the House of Legends for a special promotion.

sections.title: Tech ( The Joker)
items: Main Article: Tech Villain Storyline
Tech Villains choose The Joker as their Mentor.

They begin in Gotham's North Burnley, where a gang war has erupted. New Villains are first enlisted to aid the Falcone Mob who are under siege by the Gotham Police Department. During the conflict they assist Catwoman in robbing a warehouse, despite interference from Huntress.

At level 15, The Joker has his Villains lead a group of his men to attack the Gotham Police at a meeting in the East Regal Hotel, after driving the Police back they find The Joker locked in a fight with Batman who they distract long enough to allow The Joker's escape.

Leading up to level 30, Tech Villains team up with The Joker to fight against Brainiac who has taken control of a satellite owned by the traitorous T.O. Morrow. The Villains manage to save The Joker and Harley Quinn from a modified form of their own toxin as well as an assault from Batman and Robin. With The Joker incapacitated they assault the satellite singlehandedly and save The Joker once again from a robotic duplicate of himself. The Tech story line culminates at level 30, when the player gets to meet with The Joker in person at the House of Legends for some heartfelt thanks and a hand shake.

sections.title: Magic ( Circe)
items: Main Article: Magic Villain Storyline
Magic Villains choose Circe as their Mentor.
They begin in Metropolis's Chinatown, where they battle the Sentinels of Magic, eventually confronting Doctor Fate alongside Brother Blood.
At Level 15, Circe will call on Magic Villains to help her drive off Wonder Woman and the Amazons trying to recover the magic based exobytes she's collected.

Leading up to level 30, Circe will call on Magic Villains to help save the magical planes from Brainiac. In the Shadowlands, after helping you drive off Brainiac's forces with Wonder Woman, Circe will turn on her, only to be trapped by her Lasso. Villains will have to defeat Wonder Woman and free Circe, only to threaten her by trapping her in the Shadowlands unless she recognizes you as more than a tool. The Magic story line culminates at level 30, when at last the player will be able to adore Circe in person on board the House of Legends.

sections.title: Accessing Secret Bases
items: The only way to access some of the Secret Bases within a mission from a mentor other than your own is to join a team with someone who has access and let them enter the instance first, although some locations are also available as On Duty instances to all players. Mentor exlusive instances that are not available through On Duty are:
JSA Metropolis Wing and Daily Planet Building for Meta characters
Gotham City Sewer, GCPD Special Crimes Unit, and T.O. Morrow's Hideout for Tech characters
Chinatown Electronics and C.A.O. Dam for Magic characters

sections.title: Trivia
items: Before the revamp and adjustment of all missions, each Mentor provided a mission at level 1, level 15, and level 30 for their Heroes or Villains.

title: Message in a Bottle
summary: A player fighting a group of Brainiac's robots.

sections.title: Overview
items: Message in a Bottle is a level 30 meta hero mission in the Watchtower the player could start once JLA in Trouble? is started. Doing so completes the latter.

images.label: A player fighting a group of Brainiac's robots.
A giant and unsurprisingly unfriendly robot.
The battle against the Mechabyte and the pesky repairbots.
Jump in, what could possibly go wrong?

sections.title: Background
items: The moment Brainiac bottled the Daily Planet, Superman teleported in to save Lois Lane. However, communications are lost, and Supergirl is very worried about her cousin, so she sends a new hero after him.

sections.title: Summary
items: Enter the Daily Planet and track down Superman.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Discover Superman's Teleport Location in the The[sic] Daily Planet

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Talking to Supergirl again reveals Oracle set up a teleporter aimed at the bottle. It is found at the west end of the Meta Wing. Use the teleporter to enter the Daily Planet Building.

" This is Superman! Oracle, can you hear me!? I'm trying to get everyone to the teleport site but Lex Luthor is - [sounds of fighting] what are you doing, you madman?! No! You fool, you'll leave all these people trapped - [mechanical teleport noise, fades out]" — Superman

" What just happened?! Ok, good news, we can get a teleporter working out of here, but bad news - Where did Lex Luthor teleport Superman?! Get to the teleport site so I can find out where he's gone!" — Oracle

In the first occupied room, there are several minions of Brainiac, including Brainiac Subjugator MK-IVs and Brainiac Destrobits. They should be fairly easy. An explosive barrel is on the left right before the stairs down. After defeating them, the player could free the trapped Meta-Powered Student.
Two Brainiac Spark MK-II patrols the corridor. They are annoying with their frequent knockbacks, but should be no problem as long as the player don't go into the robot-packed next room at the moment.

The next room is literally filled with guards, so kill them off one by one at the edge of the corridor. This way, even as the last of them swarm up, it is quite easy. Keep some soder cola handy just in case, there are two destrobits hiding behind low walls.
After defeating another Spark, the player finds Lois Lane and a non-interactive Jimmy Olsen. When talked to, the former says she saw Luthor sending Superman through a teleporter.

" You're closing in on the site. I'm reading residual energy, I can send you wherever Luthor sent Superman. Except, and this is probably not news, Brainiac's forces seem to really want to keep you here..." — Oracle
To the left of Jimmy is a safe containing some cash and possibly Giant Gemstones which is ironically Vendor Junk.

The Mechabyte resides in the next chamber. It is not extremely difficult by itself, with fairly low health for a high level mission boss, and only hits up to 200s which could be dodged. However, once sufficiently damaged, it summons Brainiac Repairbots, and more as its health reaches critical. While players should have a much larger damage input then the healing of the repairbots, they are annoying as they keep flying in front of the Mechabyte causing the player to hit them instead. Hit Tab at the start of the battle to lock on the Mechabyte to prevent that. The Mechabyte also seems to have a rarely used special attack that could drain most of the player's power almost instantly.
Once the Mechabyte is defeated, the mission turns into Superman's Doom.

sections.title: Intro

sections.title: Speak to HAZMAT Ollig
items: Follow the Navigation Diamond (if it's active in Settings > UI) to the southeast portion of Ace Chemicals' Processing Vats. HAZMAT Ollig is behind the Ace Chemicals sign, near the ground. Interact with him to proceed.

sections.title: Collect Security Cards
items: You need to collect security cards to help Ollig hack T.O. Morrow's system. They drop from defeated Ace Lieutenants (the tallest goon wearing dark purple suits) in the form of a "?" (question mark). Defeat 5 Ace Lieutenants proceed.

sections.title: Disable Security Terminals
items: Now, you have to use the cards to hack into Morrow's terminals in order to disable them. The terminals you need to hack look like Vault Circuitries, and they are scattered across the Ace building (as indicated by a white dot/arrow in your minimap). Interact with 5 terminals, then go back to HAZMAT Ollig and interact with him to learn the next objective.

sections.title: Hack Main Terminal
items: You must download Morrow's notes using the Main Terminal located at the Ace Chemicals Tower, the highest level of the building. You'll find a terminal turned sideways. Interact with it. Once you're done, a T.O. Morrow Robot (it uses the dual pistols weapon) will appear to protect it. Defeat it to finish the mission.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Talk to Voivode at the pub. She'll tell you that some of her superpowered friends - including Jack - had decided to go after the Exobyte Killer, and she haven't heard from them since. She asks you to look for them.
Rescue Local Heroes

The Local Heroes look the same as the other Kaznia citizens, but they're fighting cultists. You must help them defeat the enemies. They'll tell you about how some of those cultists said they're avenging their dead by attacking the heroes. Rescue 6 Local Heroes to complete the objective.
Rescue Voivode's Friend

Voivode contacts you to report that Jack, her sidekick, asked for help, and Voivode thinks the culprit is the serial killer you're tracking. Go to the place indicated on the map and you'll find Jack agonizing. Interact with her to hear her final words: she was attacked by the Magents, and she's dies just as she was about to reveal their plans. John Constantine calls you back to the pub.
Commune with Spirit of Voivode's Friend

John Constantine tells you he's going to be away chasing a lead, and gives you a book with an enchantment that'll allow you to speak with the dead. Go back to Jack's body and talk to her spirit. She warns you that the Magents are stealing souls, and asks you to meet her in the graveyard.

Murder in Kaznia: Crime Scene Investigation is the first part of the Murder in Kaznia story mission for the Day of Reckoning, the first chapter in the Light and Rain story arc. It automatically appears in the player character's Journal while part of the latest releases.

sections.title: Intro
items: For the events that led to this story, see Story Blogs: Light and Rain.
Strange murders have been reported in Kaznia City. They sound similar to deaths discovered in Gotham City. Visit the crime scenes and investigate these crimes.

sections.title: Objectives

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Teleport to Kaznia City and enter the portal to the Laughing Hound Pub nearby. You'll find John Constantine inside. Speak to him and he'll send you to the Village. Go to the area pointed on the map to continue.
Find and Examine Crime Scenes of Murders

Once you arrive at the area, you must talk to the Witnesses. Some of them will say they don't know about the murders, and others will lead you to a crime scene with footprints and a pile of remains that you can interact with. You must follow 5 witnesses and analyse 5 crimes scenes to complete this objective. The answer Witnesses give and random, and different Witnesses can lead to the same crime scene. Go back to Constantine once you're done to proceed.
Speak with Locals in the Pub

Now, you can talk to the patrons in pub. The one that will progress the mission is a dark-skin woman with short hair wearing a dark Stylish Streetwear Jacket Combo Shirt and a light Stylish Streetwear Pants with white Stylish Streetwear Shoes (her name is Jack, but the game only mentions her name later in the story). She'll tell you to speak to Voivode, who's in the back of the pub - talk to her then return to Constantine to start the next mission.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Return to the Village and speak to Zatanna. She's performing a magic trick to the civilians near the pub, and she'll ask you to interview some people in the area.
Local Detective

The Detective a tall, strong guy in a suit who's fighting zombies. Help him defeat them and then talk to him. He'll introduce himself to you and tell you the story of how his partner was killed, while he was spared.
Local Heroes

The Local Heroes look the same as the other Kaznia citizens, but they're fighting cultists and zombies. You must help them defeat the enemies, then speak to them before timer runs out. They'll tell you about how those cultists arrived recently, and that they might be behind the murders. Speak to 4 Local Heroes to complete the objective.
Enhanced Thugs

You can find the Enhanced Thugs chatting with another thug. Talk to them and they'll become hostile, while the powerless thugs will run away. After defeating them, pick them up. They'll tell you that only the exobyte-enhanced thugs are being targeted, while the powerless ones are spared. Speak to 4 Enhanced Thugs to complete the objective.
Once you're done, go back to John Constantine in the pub to start the next mission.

sections.title: Intro
items: Batman: I've given Dr. Leslie Thompkins an antidote for the gas, but that's not enough to stop Scarecrow's thugs. We have to get the fear gas barrels off the street. Get to their supply depot by the chemical factory. No matter what you see- don't let the effects of the fear gas scare you off.

sections.title: Objective
items: Travel to the supply depot in the Malone Improvement District
Protect Hazmat Officers and transport their sealed fear gas barrels to safe zone x5
Defeat Scarecrow's Henchmen x15

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Follow the yellow arrow on your mini-map to the Malone Improvement District. Then look for a white pillar of light. This is the Hazmat Bogue. Talk to him and get another side quest One of Us. Move around this area and attack Hallucinations. They will either turn into a Hazmat Technician or one of Scarecrow's thugs. As a general rule, two haluncinations in close proximity, such as side by side, will be two thugs, the Hazmat Technicians are always solo. Attack the thugs for Night Terrors and press E on the Hazmat Technician for One of Us. Then look around for the fear gas barrels. Pick them up and bring them to the area near Hazmat Bogue.
" The Hallucinations get stronger the more you're exposed to the gas. Hang in there. Once we take out Scarecrow, the nightmare will end. For everyone." — Oracle

title: Once More With Rockets!
summary: Once More With Rockets! is one of three level 30 daily missions in the Toyman's Time Out set that could be started at the terminals in the Monitor Womb of the Watchtower or in the Sabotage Chamber in the Hall of Doom.

sections.title: Overview
items: " It's Oracle. Something crazy's going down and I think you're the one to restore order. We're talking some serious weird. And it's happening every day. Up for it? Because we could sure use you!" — Oracle
"" — Calculator

Once More With Rockets! is one of three level 30 daily missions in the Toyman's Time Out set that could be started at the terminals in the Monitor Womb of the Watchtower or in the Sabotage Chamber in the Hall of Doom.

sections.title: Intro
items: Toyman's newest toy experiments are definitely unsafe for all ages. Time to break their warranty.

sections.title: Objective
items: Locate the Front Gates of Stryker's Island Penitentiary
It's toy time when you hijack Toyman's Radical Rocket Randy from atop Stryker's aerial defense platforms
Pilot Radical Rocket Randy and take out Toyman's Air Rocket Squad forces (0/20)
" Now that's what I call a nice clean job. I love when there's no paper work. (laughs) That's another computer joke ... * sigh* Ok, fine. One day I'll come up with a funny one." — Oracle
" You know, your confidence is starting to scare me. Just kidding! Who's my best bud? You Are!" — Calculator

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: After an update, the process of launching Rocket Randy is greatly simplified. The player now could go to an upper floor of Skryker's and find them ready to launch. Directly attacking Toyman's air fleet would not work, the robots cap damage at 1 and self destruct in a few hits.

While as Rocket Randy, both left and right click fires some sort of Heat Vision which eliminates the targeted robot in one hit. Click 1 to unleash a flame wave to destroy all nearby robots. Click 2 to heal and 3 to exit the robot.

sections.title: Rewards
items: Cash: $360
Mark of Victory

sections.title: Feats
items: Fun For All Ages - Complete 10 daily Toyman missions (10 Points)
And You Have a Date With Death! - Complete 25 daily Toyman missions - 10 Points
They're Not Dolls, They're Actions Figures - Complete 50 daily Toyman missions - 10 Points
To Infinity and Beyond - Complete 100 daily Toyman missions (25 Points)

sections.title: Notes
items: After game update 20 the mission has been moved from the open world to an own instance to make room for the Home Turf episode content. Going to Stryker's manually does no longer work. The player has to go through the teleporter in the Monitor Womb (Watchtower) or the Sabotage Chamber (Hall of Doom) to start the missions.
Since game update 27 the mission is replayable. Resetting always costs 15 replay badges, no matter whether 1, 2 or 3 of the missions in the set are locked.

Of the three missions only this one really changed with the move into an own instance. Previously, the player had to use one of the launch pads at Stryker's front yard. They would shoot the player into the sky, where a launch pad on a platform shoot them higher and the process must be repeated for four times. There the robot doll to take over could be found. The player had to be in their movement mode (e.g. Flyers must be airborne) to be shot far enough horizontally to reach the next platform.

sections.title: Overview
items: Outbreak is one of the daily missions for heroes in the Ace Chemicals Clean Up Effort set from Home Turf episode. It requires a Combat Rating of 60+.

sections.title: Intro
items: It was only a matter of time before the Ace Chemicals area would become ground zero for a toxic outbreak. Help Steelworks and Envirotech contain the mutant outbreak at Ace Chemicals!

sections.title: Objective
items: Locate and speak to HAZMAT Daniels
Pick up the Cleanse Rifle
Use the Cleanse Rifle to eliminate mutant growths [0/6]
Locate and speak to HAZMAT Daniels; Use the Cleanse Rifle to cure infected civilians [0/8]; Find and defeat mutants near Ace Chemicals [0/8]
Search for and defeat the source of the mutant outbreak at Ace Chemicals
Return to the Steelworks Communication Foreman near Ace Chemicals

sections.title: Combatants
items: Cured Civilian
Dog
Envirotech Cleaner
HAZMAT Daniels
Infected Civilian
Mutant
Mutant Giant
Mutant Gorilla
Noxious Dog

sections.title: Speak to HAZMAT Daniels
items: HAZMAT Daniels is located at the processing area next to one of the Gotham HAZMAT trucks. He'll tell you that T.O. Morrow's experiments caused a mutant outbreak in the area.

sections.title: Pick up the Cleanse Rifle
items: You must interact with the suit next to Daniels and get the Cleanse Rifle to proceed. You'll get the basic rifle melee attacks, a water jet range attack and the following new powers:
Grenade Launcher
Cleansing Spray
Cryo-foam
Bunker Buster
Revert form
Note that you can now get rid of the suit any time by using the Revert form power, but the rifle will wear off after 5 minutes. If you lose the rifle, go back and interact with the suit again.

sections.title: Eliminate Mutant Growths
items: Go west to the Processing Vats. You'll find slimes similar to the Demon Pod - Inert base item, all marked with lightning icons. You need to destroy 6 of those growths using the Cleanse Rifle, then go back to HAZMAT Daniels to learn what to do next.

sections.title: Cure Infected Civilians + Defeat Mutants
items: Go to the north until you get to the outbreak itself. You must use the rifle's range attack (water jet) to cure the Infected Civilians without killing them. If your precision stats are too high, briefly tap the range attack button (right mouse button on PC, triangle on Playstation, Y on Xbox). You may remove some gear if you want, but that will drop your health too, leaving you vulnerable to attacks.

Cure 8 Civilians and defeat 8 Mutants to proceed. You don't need to be carrying the Cleanse Rifle for the Mutants to count, so you can use your own weapon to finish this objective if you lose the rifle.

sections.title: Defeat the Source of the Outbreak
items: Once you're done with the previous objectives, the source of the outbreak will spawn in the area: a Mutant Gorilla. The gorilla is very aggressive, it will attack you on sight. Defeat it to finish the mission.

sections.title: Rewards
items: 581 Cash
Daily Reward Box
Soder Cola Extreme

sections.title: Feats
items: Ace Chemicals Ace: In the Ace Chemicals, complete each of the following exterior missions (10 points):; Toxic Trouble; Outbreak; Morrow's Notes; Sea Change; Proportional Response; Dirty Job; Weird Science; Random Sample; Hazardous Material; Bridge to Nowhere
Waste Disposal: In the Ace Chemicals, defeat 100 enemies (10 points), grants title the Exterminator

sections.title: Trivia
items: You can use the Cleanse Rifle to cure the Noxious Dogs. Once cured, they'll follow you around and help you in battle.

One of T.O. Morrow's lines that can be heard at Ace Chemicals references this mission: "Morrow here. Has anyone seen a large, angry gorilla anywhere? I fear he's escaped the lab. Try not to let it cough on you..."

Primal Propaganda is one of the daily missions for heroes in the Secure Stryker's Island set from the Home Turf episode. It requires a combat rating of 60+.

sections.title: Intro
items: Gorilla Grodd has taken control of some of the prisoners, and is using them as emissaries to spread his rage across the prison yard and beyond. Keep them from proselytizing - Grodd's influence must be contained!

sections.title: Objective
items: Find and defeat Grodd's Emissaries on Stryker's Island [0/4]

Return to the Stryker's Island staging area and speak with the Steelworks Communication Foreman

sections.title: Combatants
items: Grodd's Emissary
Grodd's Projection

sections.title: Defeat Grodd Emissaries
items: For this objective, you need to find and defeat 4 Grodd Emissaries. They are scattered across the island (except for the processing area), and don't spawn in groups.

sections.title: Defeat Grodd's Projection
items: Grodd's Projections spawn across the island, only 2 at a time. They can be found on the penitentiary's upper levels and around the walls. Defeat one of them to complete the mission.

items: 581 Cash

sections.title: Speak to HAZMAT Higby

items: Go to the Ace Chemicals building and look for Large Freon Tanks scattered across the area. You need to interact with 5 of those tanks to complete the objective.

items: Go southwest, you'll find the Saturated Chemoid near the bridge and surrounded by 3 Short Reactor Lab Vats. sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Spawn points surrounded by a black swirling energy circle are found at crossroads within the mission area. When a player approaches, shadow demons will begin to spawn at the outer edge of the circle and walk towards the central beam. If they reach it, they are absorbed, and if 3 shadow demons are absorbed, a large Shadow Demon Archon will form.

Players can defeat the Archon directly, although this is far more difficult as the Archon hits as hard as Beast Taming bosses. An easier way is defeating approximately 10 adds without letting 3 touch the beam, which will cause the circle to disappear and count towards the mission.
Archons always spawn directly (without the circle phase) around the bridges in the open world zone.

title: Radio Star(fish) (Heroes)
summary: Radio Star(fish) is a weekly "hidden" bounty mission for heroes in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone as part of the Deluge episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Radio Star(fish) is a weekly "hidden" bounty mission for heroes in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone as part of the Deluge episode.

The mission is connected to the Fallen Stars mission. It will unlock only if you have managed to defeat all four controlled iconics ( Controlled Black Lightning, Controlled Kid Flash, Controlled Trickster and Controlled Weather Wizard) roaming in the Central City Starro Deluge Zone at least once in the previous week.

Access to this content is available to all players for free. This open world mission is available to all Level 20+ players — stat buffs will be applied as needed. The target stats are boosted to a Combat Rating of 174 or 209 dependent on if player's Equipped CR is respectively below or above 194 (the CR for enemies in this zone).

sections.title: Overview
items: Random Sample is one of the daily missions for heroes in the Ace Chemicals Clean Up Effort set from the Home Turf episode. It requires a combat rating of 60+.

sections.title: Intro
items: Help Steelworks and Envirotech with their research by gathering toxic material samples at Ace Chemicals.

sections.title: Objective
items: Escort the Envirotech Biologist to the first sample
Signal to Envirotech Biologist then escort him to the next sample

items: Ace Lieutenant

sections.title: Escort Biologist to First Sample
items: Follow the Navigation Diamond (if it's active in Settings > UI) to the Processing Vats at the northeast side of Ace Chemicals. You'll find the Envirotech Biologist on the ground, hiding in a corner from the enemies in the area. Interact with him to proceed.

The Biologist will ask you to escort him to the upper levels. He will walk towards the enemies to the nearest door, located under the catwalk. You must engage the enemies and defeat them before the can knock out the Biologist. If you fail to protect him, the objective will restart. He will get inside and ask you to meet him on the second floor.

sections.title: Escort Biologist to Second Sample
items: Go to the door directly above the one the Biologist entered. Clean the area from enemies, then interact with the door. The Biologist will come out of it and go up the catwalk towards the main building. If you fail to protect him, the objective will restart. He will enter the next door.

sections.title: Defeat Nearby Goons
items: You must defeat 5 enemies to proceed. Only Ace Lieutenants, Mad Scientists, Ace Security Guards, and Ace Slashers will count. When you're done, go back to the door and interact with it.

sections.title: Escort Biologist to Third Sample
items: The Biologist will come out of the door, then go to the top of the catwalk, and enter the nearest door. Keep protecting him.

sections.title: Protect Samples
items: Go to the door on the roof above you and interact with it. The Biologist will come out and place a container on the middle of the roof, and 3 waves of goons will come out of the door to attack you. After the second wave, a stronger goon named Chuckles will arrive. Defeat all of them while still protecting the Biologist. When you're done, a black Steelworks Robot will arrive to collect the container and the Biologist will thank you and go back inside. Go back the Steelworks Communication Foreman to finish the mission.

sections.title: Background
items: Circe sends new magic villains to aid Cult of Trigon. They fight Sentinels of Magic and stop them from casting protective wards.

sections.title: Intro
items: " An excellent start. Now, the Sentinel base is guarded by a protective spell which only grants access to... the pure of heart. [scoffs] Find Brother Blood's Cultists, they'll give you something to bypass the spell." — Circe

sections.title: Objective
items: Speak to Brother Blood's Cultists in Chinatown
" You Circe's new spellslinger? This will suck the good right out of pure hearted civilians. Don't bother on using it on anyone else. Have fun." — Blood Cultist

images.label: Draining the essence of a citizen.

sections.title: Intro
items: " Now, use that gem to drain essence from the innocent. Enough essence, and you can enter the Sentinel base - and steal the demonic Eye of Sin." — Circe

sections.title: Objective

Rough up civilians in the area and drain essence from the innocent (0/3)

sections.title: Intro
items: " Enough, you have all the essence you need to enter the Sentinel's base. Go there now and take what is rightfully ours!" — Circe

sections.title: Objective
items: Find the Eye of Sin inside the Sentinel of Magic Base
Find the Eye of Sin
Defeat Guards

Steal Eye of Sin
" The Eye of Sin is protected by three Flames of Containment in the nearby antechambers. Reposition the Flames to steal the Eye." — Circe

sections.title: Outro
items: " Just so you know, the Eye of Sin is not Trigon's actual eyeball. In case you were wondering." — Calculator

sections.title: Location
items: The mission zone for the second part of the mission is a block east of Sentinels of Magic Base, while the third part takes place in the Sentinels of Magic Base instance itself. The Villains get into the instance by passing through the ward.

items: Sentinels of Magic; Initiate; Sentry; Vanguard; Lightkeeper

sections.title: Continuation

sections.title: Notes
items: Vanguards are among the stronger sentinel members, being about to knock back and occasionally stun, but still fairly weak.
Cultist Gorge, who starts the side mission Protection Money, can be found near the Blood Cultist.

Certain types of citizens always resist draining, and could only be fought. Ignore them and drain others. It appears that those citizens are used instead in Protection Money as "arrogant residents". It is possible that their arrogance prevents their essence from being pure.

To steal the Eye of Sin, the player must transport three flames of containment which are found in three side chambers, to pits in the main chamber. The Flame in the southern chamber is found in the floor below (take the staircases down anticlockwise) which can be confusing because the spiral stairs cause the map marker to appear in the main chamber (it is actually beneath).

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Flames are known as "Artifact Containment Urn" in combat messages.
Previously, the Flames have a different model, and have three unique colours for each flame (red, dark red, and green). They must also be manually extinguished after being transported.

There are a number of Citizens in the Sentinels of Magic base that will flee at the sight of you. They would run and exit at the entrance and do not need to be fought, although they can still be attacked. One unique NPC that does that is named Maitre D', likely a corruption of maître d'.

title: Research & Development
summary: Research & Development is a level 16 mission that serves as an introduction to the Research and Development system.

sections.title: Overview
items: " You're doing a great job out there, but as your challenges get more difficult you'll want to do some R&D to modify your equipment or even create some support items. The Lords of Order, Project Cadmus and Magnus Robotics have stepped up to offer a hand. [Magic Origin] Since you've got a knack with magic, why don't you go chat with the Phantom Stranger in the Magic Wing. He's not much into chit chat but he can give you the 411 on Research and Development. / [Meta Origin] Why don't you go chat with Mickey Cannon in the Meta Wing. He's the director of Project Cadmus and can give you the low-down on how to get an edge with Research and Development." —Oracle

" So, kudos to you, you're not dead yet. You've already exceeded expectations. But as your exploits get trickier you'll want to do some R&D to beef up your equipment or even make some support items. The Lords of Chaos, the Agenda and Oolong have set up shop in the Hall of Doom. They can help you figure out how to modify your gear. [Magic Origin] Since you seem to have a knack for black magic, you should go speak with Tala in the Magic Wing, she can instruct you on Research and Development. And I'm sure she'd be pleased to see someone with your power." — Calculator
Research & Development is a level 16 mission that serves as an introduction to the Research and Development system.

sections.title: Heroes
items: Oracle has asked you to talk to Phantom Stranger in the Magic Wing / Will Magnus in the Tech Wing / Mickey Cannon in the Meta Wing. He's got information about the parts and labor involved with R&D.

sections.title: Villains
items: Calculator has asked you to talk to Tala in the Magic Wing. She's got information about the parts and labor involved with R&D.

sections.title: Heroes
items: Speak with Phantom Stranger / Will Magnus / Mickey Cannon in the Magic / Tech / Meta Wing to learn about R&D

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The player must talk to the respective director of their faction, all found on the Hall of Doom or the Watchtower.
Magic heroes must talk to Phantom Stranger of the Lords of Order. He is found at the north area of the Magic wing.
Meta heroes must talk to Mickey Cannon of Project CADMUS. He is found at the east area of the Meta wing.
Tech heroes must talk to Will Magnus of Magnus Robotics. He is found at the south area of the Tech wing.
Magic villains must talk to Tala of the Lords of Chaos. She is found within the Armory.
Meta villains must talk to Dabney Donovan of the Agenda. He is found at the south side of the Power Core.
Tech villains must talk to Doctor Sivana of Oolong. He is found within the Hangar.
Talking to one of the other faction's director will not work.
After a short explanation of the Research and Development system, the mission is complete.

The mission can be started by picking it up from a console in the safe zone.

sections.title: Intro
items: (Weekly) Help clean up Gotham on Earth 3 and shine a light amid the darkness that plagues this universe

sections.title: Objective
items: Take out criminal, corrupt cops, robots, and anyone or anything else in Earth 3 Gotham associated with the Crime Syndicate (0/303)

sections.title: Combatants
items: Any hostile NPC in Earth 3 Gotham

sections.title: Rewards
items: 2999 Cash
8 Source Marks
Earth 3: Large Loot Cache

sections.title: Deprecated
items: 4850 Cash
8 Marks of Victory
8 Ultrabucks

sections.title: Trivia
items: Player characters not meeting the episode CR requirements will be buffed to combat rating 150.
Enemies in Earth 3 instances do not count, only those in the Earth 3 Gotham open world zone do.

Despite saying "anything" in the description, targetable security cameras do not count towards the mission. Neither do cars that can be interacted with, with a blue glow, that is only possible after defeating the two mobs guarding them (which do count).

title: Ring in the Holidays (Heroes)
summary: Ring in the Holidays is a mission automatically appearing in the player journals once the open world mission of the winter holidays event has been finished.

sections.title: Overview
items: " Larfleeze wasn't content to steal just presents this Holiday season. He's escalated to stealing Power Rings from fallen Green Lanterns near the conflict in Metropolis! The more rings he gets, the more powerful he becomes. And that's not good for anybody. The rings have left an enormous energy signature and I'm tracing it now...[typing] I've pinpointed his location! He's holed up at a secret research facility. l'm adding the location to your On Duty tab... Head there and I'll contact you onsite!" — Oracle
Ring in the Holidays is a mission automatically appearing in the player journals once the open world mission of the winter holidays event has been finished.

sections.title: Intro
items: Larfleeze's greed knows no bounds. He has stolen Green Lantern Power Rings from defeated Lanterns fighting the Sinestro Corps in Downtown Metropolis. Open your On Duty tab, queue up for the Secret Research Facility event, and Ring in the Holidays by saving those Power Rings!

sections.title: Objective
items: Queue for the Secret Research Facility Event in your On Duty Tab
Recover the stolen Power Rings from Larfleeze

sections.title: Trivia
items: In order to get this mission and its extra reward, the player needs to have completed the open world mission Season's Greedings. Just queueing into the Secret Research Facility via the On Duty Menu and skipping the open world mission will not grant this mission's reward. Players are limited to receiving this once per day as there is no way to reset rewards for this.
This mission used to reward players with 6 Holly Leaves. This was changed in the 2025 edition of the event.

sections.title: Intro
items: Help Steelworks and Envirotech stop T.O. Morrow from polluting the beach at Ace Chemicals.

sections.title: Objective
items: Locate and speak to HAZMAT Harding; Defeat the goons that are dumping chemicals [0/8]; Defeat the chemoids on the beach [0/3]; Tag the floating chemical containers for pickup [0/4]

sections.title: Speak to HAZMAT Harding
items: Follow the Navigation Diamond (if it's active in Settings > UI) to the southwest portion of Ace Chemicals. HAZMAT Harding is across the street, near the water. Interact with him to proceed.

sections.title: Defeat Goons and Chemoids
items: Follow Harding's gaze until you reach the place where waves of goons are throwing radioactive substance containers to the water. You'll also find Chemoids wandering around the area. You need to defeat 8 goons and 3 chemoids. Have in mind that the goons won't attack you on site, but will fight back, while the chemoids are hostile.
Note: The game doesn't differentiates the enemies in the mission area from the ones on at the main building, so all of the goons and Chemoids in the Ace area count for the mission.

sections.title: Tag Floating Containers for Transport
items: Go to the west towards Arkham Island until you spot mutagen containers floating in the water. Interact with them to fire a flare, then a black Steelworks Robot will come to take them. Interact with 4 of them to complete the objective.

sections.title: Speak to HAZMAT Harding
items: Once you defeat 8 goons and 3 chemoids, and finish with the containers in the water, go back to HAZMAT Harding and interact with him again.

sections.title: Defeat Lockjaw
items: Go north from Harding and go down to the beach. You'll find a big alligator that attacks on sight called Lockjaw. It has 3 types of attack: Slime Toss (ability), and bite and tail strike (both tagged as melee attacks). Defeated it to finish the mission.

items: An otherworldly entity has infiltrated the Intergang crime syndicate. One of the worshipers of the Crime Bible has succumbed to this powerful spirit. Find the Possessed True Believer and remove the spirit!

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Go to the Temple of Crime walk-in in Burnley (across the river from Gotham Freight Yards) and complete the instance. If your Combat Rating is too high, be careful when fighting Bruno Mannheim - if you defeat him right away, the instance will get bugged and you won't be able to complete it. Make sure you don't have much precision or might (you might want to remove some of your gear and/or reset your skill points). Defeat the cultists next to Bruno, then hit him carefully until he summons the shape-shifters and The Question arrives. Defeat the shape-shifters, then defeat Bruno.
Once you heal Batwoman, the Possessed True Believer will spawn in front of the altar. Defeat him to complete the mission.

title: Spectral Embrace
summary: Spectral Embrace is a level 29 mission automatically started upon the completion of Here for the Reaping.

sections.title: Overview
items: Spectral Embrace is a level 29 mission automatically started upon the completion of Here for the Reaping.
Work with Green Lantern and Green Arrow to rejoin the Spectre with humanity Eclipso has stolen from him.

images.label: The room where many spirits would appear and attack.

sections.title: Objectives
items: " Now you must do the impossible: return the spirit of God's Vengeance to his link with humanity. Green Lantern and Green Arrow will join you to face him in the Courthouse he has taken for his own. Perhaps they can appeal to The Spectre's memories. Or, failing that, help you bring him down." — Wonder Woman
Restore Spectre's Humanity
Upon completion, The Fates Aligned is automatically started. Doctor Fate would send you an email with a reward, Belt of Memory attached.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Enter the Lair of the Spectre located in the mission area of Here for the Reaping. Fight through the Vengeful Spirits, Magistrates, Accusers and Souleaters. There are some possessed souls floating around that could not be attacked but may turn to one of above when approached, so be careful and try to limit the amount of spirits attacking - a room full of max level angry spirits will kill you very quickly.

After finding and defending Tom from two Vengeful Spirits, be ready to be assaulted by many spirits at once in the next room - gate's locked behind you. Save the Supercharge, wait for the Soder Cola and Trinkets timer to finish counting.
After a short cutscene, spirits appear outside the "cage" and phase inside. Defeat them all, and continue. Checkpoint reached.

When you see Green Arrow and Green Lantern, talk to the latter. He will reveal that he was once the host of the Spectre, and a human host is requires for Spectre to maintain humanity - otherwise he goes crazy. Talk to him again, and go on to find the Spectre apparently insane. Hal Jordan distracts him while the player and Green Arrow destroys four crystals affecting the Spectre.
Spirits guards the crystals. Green Arrows does very little damage. He will revives the player if they are knocked out, but it is better to flee for full health and power.
After some time, the Spectre would become more collected and starts attacking Hal Jordan. While this could hit the player, it doesn't deal much damage and there is no reason to get in the way.
Each crystal is guarded by two spirits, and there are four extra spirits before the last crystal. They should not be difficult after the dozens of spirits before.
After all crystals are destroyed, Spectre would reject such emotions. Talk to Hal Jordan.

Players could let the Spectre knock them out after defeating the last spirits but before destroying the crystal. This ensures full health and power, and progress is not reset, but it is reset if the player is knocked out during the battle with the Spectre. The player is locked in combat mode (i.e. no natural healing) while any spirit is not defeated. After defeating the last spirit, the player could wait and heal before talking to Green Lantern.
" My vengeance would be both just and terrible."

The Spectre possess Green Arrow, and then Green Lantern. Defeat both forms - it is surprisingly easy. After that, Eclipso appears and Spectre possess the player. Eclipso is even easier, dealing little damage and the two other heroes make quick work of him.
After securing Eclipso and the final cutscene, leave the building.

images.label: Something tells me that attacking God's spirit of Vengeance is a very bad idea...
Clicking 1 as the Spectre to unleash a deadly special attack.
"My vengeance would be both just and terrible

sections.title: Rewards
items: Cash: $121
2800 xp for defeating Eclipso
2801 xp upon completion

sections.title: Trivia
items: The crystals looks exactly like the Sisyphean Stones destroyed in A Shard of Hope.
When the Spectre is found, he is in giant form. When he possesses Green Arrow and later Hal Jordan, he is in human size. However, when he possesses the player, he is back to his giant form.
When possessed by the Spectre, the equipment screen would show the player as usual but enlarged. Players could also use emotes as the Spectre.
There is sometimes a glitch that causes Hal Jordan to attack the air where the Spectre originally was rather than the Spectre.

images.label: The player meets Green Arrow and Hal Jordan.
One of the runic formations flying around the Spectre.
The Spectre unleashes a barrage of blasts.
Spectre's Compassion - without it, how can one judge?
Spectre's Reason - without it, the innocent would be found guilty.
Spectre's Hubris - to find satisfaction in judging, one must be certain with his judgement.
Spectre's Empathy - without it, it is only an excuse for the weak to escape judgement.
The player dancing as the Spectre.

title: Story Arcs (Classic Game)
summary: For the DLC story format with the same name, see Story Arcs (DLC).

sections.title: Overview
items: For the DLC story format with the same name, see Story Arcs (DLC).

The Story Arcs of DC Universe Online are early game missions where player characters interact with established and iconic DC Universe heroes and villains. Each story arc is made up of various missions and quests, with some of the arcs stretching to include certain alerts or raids. Below is a summary of the story arcs and a list of missions involved in each story arc. Completing Story Arcs rewards feat points.

sections.title: Arkham Unleashed
items: Main article: Arkham Unleashed

This series of mission arcs relate to Arkham Asylum escapees Mr. Freeze, Poison Ivy, and Scarecrow. Each villain plots a crime that fits their individual (iconic) characterizations, and once caught launch a deadly takeover of the Asylum. Expectedly, the missions take place in Gotham City and the Arkham Asylum instance.

sections.title: Beginning of the End
items: Main article: Beginning of the End

Brainiac has taken control of some of Earth's most dangerous technology. With the HIVE under his thumb, and apparently in full control of the reactivated Brother Eye satellite, Brainiac is poised to take over the planet not by force, but by technological prowess. This story arc takes place in Metropolis, Gotham City, the HIVE Moon Base, Watchtower and Hall of Doom Alerts, and all the parts of the Batcave Raid instances.

sections.title: Dying of the Light
items: Main article: Dying of the Light

This series of missions relate to the Green Lantern and Sinestro Corps war. The power rings of the Corps are fading and a disturbance has been tracked to Earth. While the Green Lanterns investigate, the Sinestro Corps launches an offensive, blaming the GLs for their woes. The missions take place in Metropolis, and so far encompass a single story arc and repeating PVP event.

sections.title: Gotham's Gang War
items: Main article: Gotham's Gang War

The Joker, using the emergence of the new Exobyte powered heroes and villains, starts up a gang war in Gotham City to cover his own tracks. Quickly it takes on a life of its own, throwing Gotham's criminal underworld into chaos. This story arc takes place in Gotham City, and includes the Two-Face mission included in Update 2.
Villain Missions

sections.title: Hearts of Darkness
items: Main article: Hearts of Darkness

Circe, the treacherous goddess, seeks to promote the rule of magic over humanity. To complete her conquests she has manipulated other magical societies and even launched a direct attack against Amazonian defenders in the world of man. This story arc takes place in Metropolis and tied into the Update 1 Valentine's Event.

sections.title: Legacy of Krypton
items: Main article: Legacy of Krypton

Lex Luthor's hatred of Superman has the criminal mastermind to ever more desperate measures. Continuing his plans to destroy the Man of Steel, Lex has many different projects underway, all with one goal: Kill Superman. This story arc takes place in Metropolis, and ties into the Area 51 and Smallville Alert instances.

sections.title: Punchline
items: Main article: Punchline

Joker is on the loose and experimenting with a new version of his infamous (and deadly) Joker Toxin. This time though, he appears to have help. A mysterious benefactor is giving Joker access to tech not normally in the Clown Prince of Crime's arsenal. But is Joker as in control as he appears? This story arc takes place in Gotham City, and ties into the Oolong Island, Blüdhaven, and Ace Chemicals Alert instances.

sections.title: Sins of the Father
items: Main article: Sins of the Father

The demon Trigon, father of Raven, has begun the steps necessary to make his way to Earth. At first unleashing his energy through his daughter, and then through Brother Blood and his evil Cult, Hell on Earth is approaching. This story arc takes place in Metropolis and Gotham City.

sections.title: Survival of the Fittest
items: Main article: Survival of the Fittest

Gorilla Grodd has launched attacks against humanity, seeking to transform everyone into apes under his psychic control. Meanwhile, the Ultra-Humanite has also resurfaced, attempting to destroy humanity. This story arc takes place in Metropolis and the Gorilla Island and Stryker's Prison Alert instances.

sections.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
items: Main article: 'Til Death Do Us Part

Black Adam has had enough of mourning the loss of his wife Isis, and has enlisted Felix Faust to find a way to revive her. However, Faust has plans of his own, and is attempting to use Adam's grief and rage as his key to the power of SHAZAM! and the Flame of Life itself. This story arc takes place in both Metropolis, Gotham City, and the Khandaq Raid instance.

sections.title: Exploration Adventures
items: Booster Gold, in one of his more intelligent schemes has licensed his voice (and wit) for a series of sight-seeing kiosks situated throughout Metropolis and Gotham City. In each classic safehouse, one such kiosk can be used to begin Booster Gold's tours for fun and knowledge.

sections.title: Miscellaneous
items: In addition to the main storylines presented here, there are a few other missions in the Classic Game that don't quite fit so neatly.

sections.title: Wishful Thinking
items: Main article: Wishful Thinking
Catwoman has learned that Gotham University has unearthed a trove of jeweled cat statues. She intended on liberating them, but something went wrong in the University's Warehouse.

title: Story Missions
summary: Story Missions are introductory missions meant to be played through the first time a player begins a new Story Arc ( Episode or Chapter). In many cases they need to be completed before recurring Daily or Weekly Missions will become available via taskmasters.

sections.title: Overview
items: Story Missions are introductory missions meant to be played through the first time a player begins a new Story Arc ( Episode or Chapter). In many cases they need to be completed before recurring Daily or Weekly Missions will become available via taskmasters.

Story Missions are listed under the category of the same name in the player's Journal. They will appear there either automatically, or after visiting the open-world zone for the first time via the Orrery of Worlds Teleporter in House of Legends, via Warp from the Events menu
The Featured Story Missions category in the Journal includes Story Missions from the three most recent Story Arcs.

sections.title: Requirements
items: The Combat Rating or CR listed with each mission is reflective of the Tier for the Story Arc to which the missions belongs. However, the CR listed is not a requirement for the mission. As most of the Story Missions are in open-world zones, the only requirements are that the player character is Level 20+ and has completed their Mentor-based Missions through Level 17―which unlocks the Orrery Teleporter and the Events menu for travel to these zones.

title: Superman's Doom
summary: Upon the defeat of the Mechabyte, another Teleporter Rift opens up in th Watchtower.

sections.title: Overview
items: Superman's Doom is a level 30 meta hero mission started once the player defeats the Mechabyte during Message in a Bottle.
Fight to free yourself and Superman from the Hall of Doom.

images.label: Upon the defeat of the Mechabyte, another Teleporter Rift opens up in th Watchtower.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Save Superman

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Step through the Teleporter Rift in the Watchtower or at the end of the Daily Planet Building instance.
The player arrives as the Hall of Doom, the headquarters of supervillains. Calculator's coding prevents Oracle from getting coordinates of the lair.

" Well. This is bad. This is - the Hall of Doom. And I cannot lock onto any sort of coordinates thanks to Calculator's coding. From that trail of fire, Superman is here. And it's up to you [sic]get him out! Good - [breaks up, falls out]" — Oracle

The player first encounters Metallo. He is fairly easy, but the player could hack the controls near him to turn the EMP Combat Orbs he summon against him. The orbs don't do much damage and they respawn endlessly when defeated, so focus on Metallo.
" Metallo is down, repeat, Metallo is down, station alert!" — Calculator
A swarm of level 15 Security Bots, Security Androids and Security Mechs appear. They are very easy, with only the Mech being a slight threat being able to stun and charge-punch a player.
" Sivana, you and I are going to have a little word about your freaking useless security bots." — Calculator

Enter The Pit at ground floor. Do not use supersonic when approaching Cheetah - it can cause you to keep moving and get locked into a chamber behind her during the cutscene, making you stuck other than by logging out or warping via the event interface.
Defeat Cheetah. She is also quite easy, just get out of the way when she is "enraged".
" Great, Cheetah is down. Could someone please go to the meta wing and stop this fool." — Calculator

Two large waves of Security Bots and a Security Mech are summoned. While the player may be knocked out, they could simply return and resume. Operate the controls next to the doors to the Meta Wing. Super-Strength is very useful here; the player could pick up the piece of large machinery in Metallo's Chamber and wipe out a whole wave of bots with a single well-aimed throw at the middle of the mob.
The Overlord and two bots are behind the door. They are another pushover battle, defeat them and continue.
Lex Luthor and Superman are found on the upper floor of the next room.

Luthor is surprisingly easy, no particularly hard hits, but with pretty large knock backs. With the healing barrels around he shouldn't be too hard. Evade him when he generates a green sphere around himself, as damage dealt against him is greatly decreased. Watch out when he shouts "Fool!" as he fires a barrage of rockets. Dodge this by being out of the same height with him as he could only fire it horizontally.
" No...your power...too much for me...how? I am Lex Luthor!" — Lex Luthor

" Yes! Take THAT, Calculator! I'm back online for the moment - oh no, get Superman out of that kryptonite cage, I'll teleport you both to the Watchtower! And - when you get there, let Supergirl know Superman is alive. She's been ringing my ear off this entire time." — Oracle
Free Superman. Watch the headline, then escape through the teleporter. The mission changes to A New Day Dawning.

items: While Superman being teleported to the Hall of Doom may serve as a suitable plot twist, it is completely spoiled by the journal message.

sections.title: Intro
items: Intergang is taking advantage of the situation at Stryker's Island, and attempting to smuggle out prison supplies and technology. Help out the Warden and stop their smuggling racket.

sections.title: Objective
items: On Stryker's Island, recover supply crates from the prisoners and transport them to a safe area [0/4]

items: Intergangster

sections.title: Recover Supply Crates
items: On the front of the island, you'll find Skullcracker Enforcers carrying crates from the entrance of the penitentiary to the docks for Intergangsters to pickup and carry them to the yachts. You must disrupt this process by taking those crates away. Once you grab one, you'll have to take the nearest turret circles. They're usually being attacked by Prison Saboteurs, so you may have to deal with them before proceeding, unless you wait for them to move away after destroying the turret their fighting. You must deliver 4 crates before proceeding.

sections.title: Subdue the Skullcracker Gang
items: Notice that some crates lying around that couldn't be picked up now have cog icons above them. You must attract as many Skullcracker Enforcers and Skullcracker Leaders as you can to one of them, then interact with it. sections.title: Overview
items: Take Pride is a bounty mission for Heroes in the Gotham Wastelands. Target is Raven's Evil Soul Projection who can be found on the west side of the Mausoleum Grounds in the center of the Wastelands.

sections.title: Summary
items: (Weekly) For her entire life, Raven has been torn between good and evil. When she arrived in the Gotham Wastelands, the influence of her father, Trigon, caused her soul-self to fracture. Both good and evil Soul Projections have manifested, and battle for control of Raven. Wonder Woman believes that defeating Raven's Evil Soul Projection will allow her to regain control of herself.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Find and defeat Raven's Evil Soul Projection at the Mausoleum Grounds

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Periodically in battle Raven's Soul Projection will summon 3 small duplicates of her to assist her. When her health drops to 50%, she will cast a shield (she cannot be hit nor will she attack during this period) and summon either the Teen Titans (Villains) or the Fearsome Five (Heroes) to attack the players. Normal combat with her resumes only after they are all defeated.

She has a Lethal attack, Soul Rift, which after a few seconds of charging, Raven holds both hands in front of herself and casts a broad ring on the ground around her; this deals massive continuous damage to anyone standing on the ring, but you are safe as long as you are outside it, or being close enough to Raven to be inside the ring. During this time, she can be attacked as normal but she will not attack normally.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Awakening, also sometimes referred to as It's A Big Scary World Out There, is the common mission first encountered by all characters beginning the game. Brainiac has been gathering new heroes and villains in order to harvest their exobyte data. As one of these captives, players break free from containment to find themselves on a Brainiac Harvester Ship, and must fight their way to freedom.
If the player logs out during the mission, they would be returned to the first chamber.

sections.title: Background
items: Escaping one of the containment pods in a Brainiac Harvester Ship, players must fight their way to safety with the aid of Oracle and Superman (heroes) or The Calculator and Lex Luthor (villains). After destroying some debris blocking the door, follow the long corridor and defeat various Brainiac enemies.

Superman/Lex Luthor is practically invincible and can take out any enemy in a few hits, so it should be easy as long as you don't go too far ahead on your own. The tutorial would guide you through weapon attacks and abilities. Furthermore, green barrels with a + sign scattered on the ship will restore health and power when destroyed (this would work against you if enemies destroy one, healing them instead). Other than attacking directly, you can press E to pick up a barrel, then left click to smash it or right click to throw it. You can also press 7 to drink a Soder Cola that would instantly restore a large amount of health and power with a 1 minute cooldown.

Green Lantern (Hal Jordan) and The Flash (heroes) / Sinestro and Professor Zoom (villains) would show up to help, although they would have to leave afterwards to destroy the ship's main gun. Along the way, it is revealed that the ship contains an invasion force awaiting deployment; players must destroy the ship before completing their escape.
Destroy the central AI core while Wonder Woman and Batman (heroes) or Circe and The Joker (villains) fend off the mobs. Brainiac himself would then appear. Upon defeat, he will teleport away.
Upon completion, one of these missions would start automatically, depending on origin and morality:
Panic Attack (Tech hero)
Party Crashers (Tech villain)
Gorillas By The Sea (Meta hero)
Rush Week (Meta villain)
Heart and Soul (Magic hero)
Fateful Demise (Magic villain)

sections.title: Background
items: While S.T.A.R. Labs and the heroes of Metropolis fight Grodd's gorilla army in the Little Bohemia district, the Flash managed to locate the simian mastermind's command post. He infiltrated Grodd's Lab, but communication with the Flash has since been lost. He may need a hand in order to put a stop to Grodd's plans for the city.

sections.title: Summary
items: " This is Superman. We're not going to let Grodd win this one. If you can find the Flash inside his base, the two of you can take down Gorilla Grodd" — Superman
Break into Gorilla Grodd's hidden Lab to rescue The Flash and take down Grodd.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Go to Gorilla Grodd's Lab to Continue Your Mission
Defeat Gorilla Grodd
Gorilla Grodd Defeated

sections.title: Notes
items: If the player leaves the lab, all guards respawn. They don't, however, if the player is knocked out, because they escape to the entrance without leaving.

When you talk to The Flash, the door locks behind you. You cannot smash the controls before talking to him. If you try to get near Grodd before freeing The Flash or defeating Grodd's wave of devolved citizens, his energy shield would throw you away.

Grodd would first summon several devolved citizens to attack while he remains within the shield. Players are strongly recommended to hang back near the locked door - the devolved citizens may not notice you and only chase The Flash, who would eventually defeat them all. This is extremely helpful as players may lose half their health against them if attacking head-on, which is detrimental to the chances of beating Grodd.
Any items brought into Grodd's chamber vanishes when the fight starts.

Grodd attacks with powerful melee attacks and energy beams that draws the players in. He would sometimes use a "Rage" attack and launch a number of purple energy balls that may trap the player if they come into contact while dealing small, rapid damage. Grodd is invincible while using the Rage attack, so devote your effort to avoiding the purple projectiles. "Charge" attack knocks the player down, and may ground a flying player.
If the player is knocked out during the fight, they flee to the entrance of Grodd's lab and have to start all over.
Rarely, the Grodd would knock out the player but The Flash would continue to battle Grodd. In this case, simply wait for The Flash to finish him off.

sections.title: Rewards
items: Oracle: " Nice work! Head back to the police station and talk to the Flash. Trust me: he's going to get there first."

sections.title: Overview
items: The Lost Collection is a one-off mission for heroes and villains in Doomed Metropolis. It can be started by talking to Ambush Bug, who is located on a roof top pretty much in the middle between the hero and the villain safe zone.

sections.title: Intro
items: Ambush Bug has lost some of his most important Superman comic books in Doomed Metropolis. Lucky for you he knows the general idea of where he was when he lost each issue.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Locate Superman #14 in Doomed Metropolis
Locate All Star Superman #10 in Doomed Metropolis
Locate Action Comic #252 in Doomed Metropolis
Locate New 52 Action Comic Vol. 1 in Doomed Metropolis
Locate Action Comic #419 in Doomed Metropolis
Locate Crisis on Infinite Earths #7 in Doomed Metropolis
Locate Action Comic #684 in Doomed Metropolis
Locate World Without a Superman in Doomed Metropolis
Locate Action Comic #1 in Doomed Metropolis
Return to Ambush Bug in Doomed Metropolis

table.caption: Walkthrough
rows: Superman #14: "Concerts of Doom" is a Golden Age classic, featuring an iconic cover of Superman holding a bald eagle and standing in front of a star spangled shield background.

All Star Superman #10: "Neverending" was written by Grant Morrison and details the last day in the hectic life of a terminally ill Superman, attempting to prepare the world for his inevitable passing.

Action Comics #252: This Silver Age classic, features the first appearance of Supergirl. This type of comic cover can be found often during the Silver Age, revealing a weird or new character with little indication of their intentions.

New 52 Action Comics Vol. 1: "Superman and the Men of Steel details a new origin story for Superman. It shows an adult Kal-El fighting crime in the "S" clad t-shirt and blue jeans with his signature indestructible cape.
Action Comics #419: "The Most Dangerous Man an Earth" is a classic early Bronze Age tale of the Man of Steel, which includes pencils by Curt Swan, inks by Murphy Anderson and a script by Cary Bates.

Crisis on Infinite Earths #7: "Beyond the Silent Night!" contains one of the most iconic Superman covers in history, featuring the Man of Steel holding the body of his tattered cousin, Supergirl after her heroic and tragic death at the hands of the Anti-Monitor.

Action Comics #684: This story served as a prelude to the original Death of Superman event, precluding the final battle between the two. Interesting piece of trivia, every page of Action Comics #684 consists of just three panels.

World Without a Superman: This trade paperback compiles the final moments of Superman in his first battle with the rampaging alien behemoth, Doomsday and the fallout that takes place as the world comes to terms with the loss of one of its greatest heroes.

Action Comics #1: This is the first appearance of Superman and is considered by most collectors as the most sought after and treasured comic in the world. Currently there are very few original copies left in existence.

sections.title: Summary
items: Circe and Brother Blood were successful in releasing Trigon from his dimension, but the Sentinels of Magic were not unprepared. This spell trapped Trigon between the two worlds, resulting in the creation of the Gotham Wastelands, a hellish version of Gotham City -- an inferno of torture, burning with sin. Travel to this prison realm, and assist Wonder Woman in preventing the Sons of Trigon from releasing their father.

title: The Super-Plan
summary: The Super-Plan is the third mission in the level 30 final mission series for meta villains.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Super-Plan is the third mission in the level 30 final mission series for meta villains.
Defeat Superman and show Lex who's boss up in the Watchtower.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Deal with Lex Luthor

After defeating Steel, go south through the Watchtower Meta Wing there is a spot where there is a portal with "Enter encounter", but this locks you between two doors, and you are stuck in combat preventing you from warping. This occurs when you did not defeat all the security bots before - doing so causes Zatanna, the second boss, to appear as intended. You can escape with the warp option in the events menu (which can be used even in combat) and return.

Shevla'nuhur Kyramud, the third boss, has another possible bug where a glitched yellow-and-pink wall blocks access to him - you can reset the scenario by logging out and back in. Make sure you kill all the mobs.

sections.title: Overview
items: " Well, Halloween in Gotham City is rarely uneventful, and it seems this year is no exception. Someone, or something has played a hell of a trick on the people of Gotham. Trick-or-treaters are being terrorized in the streets by spooky Masked Apparitions. We're not sure who's behind it yet, but the Phantom Stranger is waiting for you in the East End Police Station with more details." — Oracle

sections.title: Background
items: New magic heroes destroy the Soul Wells that are draining the souls of the local citizens and stop Felix Faust's Magents from carrying Soul Globes to their master. Circe threatens new magic heroes that Faust serves her purpose and demands obedience, while Wonder Woman tries to warn Faust that the Flame of Life is not for mortals and to abandon his quest, before he gets burned.

sections.title: Intro
items: " Faust has retreated to this theater to begin his foul ritual. Zatanna has him cornered inside, but he is protected by his Magents, and she is alone. Join the battle to fight at her side and end Faust's vile plot!" — Wonder Woman

items: Find and Defeat Felix Faust

items: Heroes

" This is Oracle. We should have known when Gotham University unearthed those cat totems from their archives that Catwoman would come calling. But this isn't her usual snatch and grab. Anyway, her heist has gone south and there's an opportunity for some grand theft. Willy the Snitch in Otisburg can fill you in." — Calculator

sections.title: Overview
items: Toxic Trouble is one of the daily missions for heroes in the Ace Chemicals Clean Up Effort set from the Home Turf episode. It requires a combat rating of 60+.

sections.title: Intro
items: Due to the extreme environmental hazards in the area, the Ace Chemicals facility itself is at risk. Help Steelworks and Envirotech clean up the toxic waste and safeguard against additional spills.

sections.title: Objective
items: Locate and speak to HAZMAT Williams
Put on the provided HAZMAT Suit
While wearing the HAZMAT suit, find and patch holes in the pipes [0/8]; Eliminate Volatile Chemlings that walk on the pipes [0/5]
Locate and speak to HAZMAT Williams
Pick up the Cleanse Rifle
Find a way to get on top of the large northern pipes
Use the cleanse rifle to clear out mutated birds [0/12]
Locate and defeat the giant mutated bird known as Chemicrow.
Return to the Steelworks Communication Foreman near Ace Chemicals

sections.title: Combatants
items: Chemicrow
HAZMAT Williams
Mutant Bird
Volatile Chemling

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: This mission can be separated in two parts.

sections.title: Speak to HAZMAT Williams
items: Follow the Navigation Diamond (if it's active in Settings > UI) to the southeast portion of Ace Chemicals, the Processing Vats area. HAZMAT Williams is on the roof right behind the giant Ace Chemicals sign. Interact with him and he'll tell you what to do.

sections.title: Grab HAZMAT Suit
items: Once you interact with the suit next to Williams, you'll be turned into a HAZMAT yourself. Keep in mind that you'll lose all of your special movements - you can only run and jump. The transformation will wear off after a while (approx. 5 minutes), and you'll have to return to the terminal to transform again.

sections.title: Holes in Piping + Volatile Chemlings
items: Now, you must walk on the pipes nearby and stop the leaking. You must wear the HAZMAT suit to able to interact with and patch the holes. Beware the Chemlings up there, they're only attack is to explode, which will very probably knock you out from the pipes. Patch 8 holes to proceed.

The Volatile Chemlings can be found everywhere in the highlighted area for this objective, but you can find the 5 you need to proceed along the pipes. You needn't the suit for the eliminations to count.
If you fall from the pipes while wearing the suit, you can't transform back, but there's a way back up: there are crates strategically placed near HAZMAT Williams that you can use to reach him again.
When you finish, go back to HAZMAT Williams and interact with him so he can tell you what to do next.

sections.title: Grab Cleanse Rifle
items: Interact with the other suit near HAZMAT Williams to acquire a new weapon: the Cleanse Rifle (if you're not wearing the HAZMAT suit anymore, you'll acquire it again, with all its limitations). You'll get the basic rifle melee attacks, a water jet range attack and the following new powers:
Grenade Launcher
Cleansing Spray
Cryo-foam
Bunker Buster
Revert form
Note that you can now get rid of the suit any time by using the Revert form power.

sections.title: Large Northern Pipes
items: Now, go to the North portion of Ace. There isn't a way to get to the objective without facing any enemies. If you revert back from the suit you'll get there faster, and there's another suit crate in the area that you can use to transform again. If you wish to keep the suit, follow the pipes to the North, then go down to the ramp; go up the ramp and you'll get there.

sections.title: Clear Out Mutated Birds
items: In order to complete this objective, you must use the rifle's range attack (water jet) to knock 12 mutated birds from the large pipes without killing them. If you lose the Cleanse Rifle and HAZMAT suit, use the suit crate on the pipe, next to the ramp.

If your combat rating levels are too high, the water jet will kill the birds in one hit. To complete this objective, remove all of your gear and any artifacts and augments that improve your precision and/or might status. If that's not enough, check your stat points; if you spent a large number of skill points on damage status, go and reset your skill points using any Respec Station (use a base amenity or the one at the Training Room in the House of Legends), then go back to Ace Chemicals to finish the mission. You'll be able to revert the changes using your Armory.

sections.title: Defeat Chemicrow
items: On the other end of the pipes at the Chemical Storage Pool, there's a larger bird, called Chemicrow. Get to it and defeat it. You don't need to be wearing the HAZMAT Suit nor the cleanse rifle to complete this objective. Kill Chemicrow to finish the mission.

Toyland is one of three level 30 daily missions in the Toyman's Time Out set that could be started at the terminal in the Stryker's Island: Lockdown open-world zone.

sections.title: Intro
items: Toyman plans to turn Stryker's into his own private dollhouse, using his toys and a powerful new prototype. Show him you're no plaything - shut him down.

sections.title: Objective
items: Travel to the South End of Stryker's Island
Break crates full of wrapped toys to find the missing part Beautiful Betty needs to function
Transport the missing doll part back to Beautiful Betty - and activate your very own living doll!
Use Beautiful Betty's Temper Tantrum attack to blow up Windup Wally dolls (0/15)
" Now that's what I call a nice clean job. I love when there's no paper work. (laughs) That's another computer joke ... * sigh* Ok, fine. One day I'll come up with a funny one." — Oracle
" You know, your confidence is starting to scare me. Just kidding! Who's my best bud? You Are!" — Calculator

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: First, the player needs to break crates, not the big presents. Five small presents would burst forth once a crate is broken. Stick to the south end - the Toyman robots are not extremely dangerous for a level 30, but the player still must limit the damage. Interact with them results in a Toyman robot, which attacks, a useless toy car, or a robot part. Bring one part to the indicated Beautiful Betty robots on the second floor.

While inside the giant robot, left click does a basic melee attack and right click does a running click. Oddly, neither seem to do damage. There are three unique actions. Click 1 to use "Temper Tantrum", which lasts for a few seconds and when finished instantly destroys all Windup Wallies in range. Click 2 to use "Fix Boo Boos", which heals for 1428 health after a few seconds. Click 3 for the self-explanatory "Self Destruct". Note that when the robot's health reaches zero, the player is knocked out. The robot also expires after a while, with the same results as self destruct.
