title: Trigon's Blood (Heroes)
summary: For the mission for villains, see Trigon's Blood (Villains).

sections.title: Overview
items: For the mission for villains, see Trigon's Blood (Villains).
Trigon's Blood is a level 17 mission in Midtown Metropolis started automatically upon the completion of Wrath. It begins the Walk-in Solo, Ellsworth Memorial Hospital.
Stop the demon Trigon from rising from Brother Blood's evil pools of ichor.

sections.title: Objectives
items: " This is the source of the evil. Brother Blood is barricaded inside, and his vile ritual will bring Trigon to this plane unless we can stop him. Zatanna, Doctor Fate, and Raven will join you inside. Fight for all our souls!" — Wonder Woman
" Yuck. All these demons in here cannot be sanitary. They all feed Blood's ritual, so take them out and drain his power!" — Oracle
Defeat Brother Blood

images.label: The magical barrier blocking the way.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Enter the hospital through the door on the roof. The player would first meet Sentinel Carter, who offers the Sample Of Sins side mission.

Further down the path is Zatanna battling several Minion of Lust. The player do not need to fight, as they could wait till she defeats all of those, and this is recommended for low levels. There would be a second wave of minions, so do not follow her (stay near the entrance instead) when Zatanna ask you to if you are low level. They are fairly easy except for their special attack - more dangerous in the second wave because they would all start charging it up when they reach the player. It hits over 140 and knocks the player back. Blocking would be helpful.

After defeating the second wave of Minions of Lust, Zatanna takes down the barrier, knocking the henchmen of Brother Blood out. She tells you to go down the elevator shaft and vanish in a puff of smoke.
At the bottom of the shaft is several Gluttonous Citizens, Minions of Glutton, Minions of Greed, a Doctor and an Embodiment of Sin.

After fighting through them, the next room contains a Paladin and a Priest, along with many unconscious Sentinels of Magic that the player cannot help. When the player enter, several Minions of Sloth and two Embodiments of Sin attack. Fortunately, Raven arrives, and she makes quick work of the Minions and defeats the Paladin and Priest. She then teleports away leaving the Embodiments of Sin to the player.

The next room has several Minions of Greed, a Minion of Gluttony and a Doctor. After that, one Minion of Wrath, Greed, Gluttony, a Doctor and an Embodiment of Sin. Note that the barriers to the next room only seem to open after all mobs have been defeated.

Finally, you will arrive at a large room with several strange devices and some more members of Cult of Trigon and Brother Blood will arrive once you enter (follow the map, the glass blocks the other way).

Doctor Fate, Zatanna and Raven would teleport in, and after a short cutscene the fight starts. After defeating the Cult, Brother Blood would summon several waves of minions and more powerful exarches. In between waves, he would attempt to drain Doctor Fate, Zatanna, then Raven twice. Damage him sufficiently seems to stop that, but he does drain their health rather quickly. It appears that Doctor Fate heals you and Raven gives you power, so staying alive shouldn't be too difficult.
Near the end of the fight, Brother Blood would claim that Raven belongs to him as his wife and will reign on the throne of blood, but she defies him. Finally, the player may defeat Brother Blood.
While the player is prompted to talk to Doctor Fate, they could complete the mission right after defeating Brother Blood.
Doctor Fate would tell you that Brother Blood would attempt to raise Trigon away, but Raven assures him that she is always ready.
After the Sin Don't Win headline cutscene, leave the building through the portal to the north. Fratricide would be started.

sections.title: Overview
items: Unstable Technology is a side quest that is designed to be part of the chain of Metropolis General Hospital quests provided to low level Meta Heroes; although, It is not necessary to have completed any quests in the Metropolis General Hospital chain to get it. Unstable Technology is provided by Doctor Irvine, who instructs the Hero to collect 20 Power Cells from LexCorp Gladiators. The reward is $12 and 2 Soder Cola Classics. The quest is one of four required for the Solos Feat, Meta-ticulous.

sections.title: Background
items: LexCorp has been providing 'free' healthcare to new Meta Heroes, who have been given their powers by Brainiac's Exobytes. Recently a group of the patients have revolted and are battling LexCorp security. The patients are stating that LexCorp has been doing illegal tests on them to try and figure out their powers. The LexCorp Gladiators are power armored LexCorp security assigned to quell the rebellion. According to Doctor Irvine; however, the suits are powered by highly unstable cores. sections.title: Overview
items: This article is about the mission. For the mob, see Vengeful Spirit.
Vengeful Spirits is a level 29 mission started automatically when the player talks to Doctor Fate for Fateful Omen.
Confront the Vengeful Spirits the Spectre has raised in Downtown Metropolis.
In a fit of madness, the near-omnipotent Spectre created many spirits to pass harsh judgement on souls, based on the belief that, according to Lightkeeper Lyta, living is a crime.

sections.title: Objectives
items: " Welcome to the battle, we need warriors of your caliber for this threat. The Spectre has the power of God's vengeance to judge guilty souls, but here he has lost all mercy. I fear Circe's foul touch has turned the Spectre completely mad. Bring peace to these spirits!" — Wonder Woman
Speak with Lightkeeper Lyta in Downtown Metropolis
Banish Vengeful Spirits (0/25)
Return Torn Souls to Citizen's Bodies (0/20)
" The Spectre is supposed to judge individual souls. For him to be assigning spirits to pass sentence for him means something is badly wrong." — Oracle
Upon completion, Reaping Evil would automatically be started.

sections.title: Notes
items: Although it says Vengeful Spirits, Souleaters count although they are stronger. Watch out - while the Vengeful Spirits' normal attacks are weak, they could telekinetically slam anything up to and including buses into the player. Super-Strength is an advantage here, as players could use the abundant cars to smash them before they could do the same. It is possible to grab hold of a car just as they start to use telekinesis.
There is a Reaper in the area that cannot be attacked at this point, but will hit the player for 300s, so steer clear of it.

Heroes: *Report to Officer Field in the Metropolis Little Bohemia Police Station Villains: *Report to ???

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: ( Please note that this walkthrough was written when this mission still was level 13.)
Players could either defeat Bizarro once and automatically get the mission again or go to a wanted poster to start it straight away.
Bizzaro hits like a truck, for a mob of this level he hits disproportionally hard.

Tank is advised during this encounter. He will use his freeze vision (most dangerous attack, hits up to at least 401 and grounds players, unavoidable and very long range) and heat breath (which he does after visibly sucking in air, hits rapid 40s but easily dodged), but no real stuns to contend with, just large spikes of damage that you either have to heal or try and burn through before he kills you all.

Bizarro tends to lock onto a target for some time - it might be beneficial to stay in melee range, or else he would spam freeze vision repeatedly, dealing very high damage that not even a healer could come close to fully mitigate. He is also rather persistent and players should expect to be hit with freeze vision at least twice more as they attempt to escape.
His heat breath is not as deadly due to warning, relatively low damage and slow attack speed, and one heat breath is almost two fewer freeze visions.

The patients and security guards will see him and automatically attack him, but dealing no real damage while being killed in a couple of hits. The security guards can still attack you when you are fighting Bizarro.

Unlike most opponents, he does not seem to recognize a Clown Box as an opponent, meaning that even if he is chasing a player, when the player hides within a Clown Box he would go after someone else instead, making it ineffective against him.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Look for an " Odd-Looking Joker Goon" in the middle of the clowns near Von Gruenwald Tower, he is located in the North-West corner of the effected area (the 2nd 4-way intersection west of Poison Ivy's Greenhouse). He walks from West to East on the North-West corner of that section. Once approached, he would turn into Clayface.

The battle against Clayface is quite similar to Solomon Grundy. Both mainly use melee, leap large distances, do powerful stomps, and have hard Knock Backs. They also hit in the similar range, up to the high 400s.

title: WANTED: Doctor Light
summary: WANTED: Doctor Light is a bounty mission for heroes, which can be done weekly. It requires War of the Light Part II DLC and a combat rating of 106+.

sections.title: Overview
items: WANTED: Doctor Light is a bounty mission for heroes, which can be done weekly. It requires War of the Light Part II DLC and a combat rating of 106+.

references.label: War of the Light Part II

sections.title: Intro
items: Doctor Light has confronted the Green Lantern Corps in Metropolis's Historic District. The war effort can't afford any distractions. Find Doctor Light and take him down!

sections.title: Objective
items: Find and defeat Doctor Light in the Historic District

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Doctor Light uses Hand Blast.

Photon Burst: Doctor Light project a cone of light in front of him for several seconds that inflicts extreme damage and stuns all targets within. During this time, he cannot use other attacks or move from his location, but he can turn quickly. Photon Burst only has a moderate range, so it is most easily avoided by keeping your distance and hitting him with ranged attacks with impunity during this period.

Light Bolt: Doctor Light shoots multiple orbs of light in random directions. Damage is heavy but it is unlikely to hit more than once, especially due to its vulnerability to interrupt (you can actually knock him down twice in rapid succession if you interrupt this attack).

sections.title: Overview
items: Wanted: Minotaur is a bounty mission for hero players, accessible via the Wanted Poster in the MPD 5th Precinct safe house. The mission's task is to locate and defeat the Minotaur, a member of Circe's Beastiamorph army.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Locate and Defeat Minotaur in Metropolis (1136 xp)

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Its long-ranged attack consists of it throwing a large axe at the player, and hits fairly hard and also grounds, but this is reasonably avoidable. However, the attack does not necessary be at the same place of the axe's graphics, so be careful. It also have a charge special attack, but it does not seem to change directions before charge, making it very easy to avoid.
Note that when the player is actively attacking the minotaur, it turns around at the player rapidly every attack; this happens even if it is targeting another player.
It is possible to attract the attention of nearby members of the Bestiamorph Army, but this is rather rare and shouldn't be a concern as long as you don't stray too far.
Sometimes, a player slays the minotaur and even gets the feat for it, but the Bounty remains incomplete.

title: WANTED: Solomon Grundy
summary: WANTED: Solomon Grundy is level 30 bounty for heroes.

sections.title: Overview
items: WANTED: Solomon Grundy is level 30 bounty for heroes.

sections.title: Summary
items: WANTED! The GCPD seeks the removal of the brutal magical being Solomon Grundy. Considered a serious threat: do not approach alone.

sections.title: Background
items: The undead Solomon Grundy is under the effect of Poison Ivy' spores, who order him to protect her plants.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Locate and Defeat Solomon Grundy in Gotham
Report to Officer Washburn in Gotham's East End Police Station
A group of players taking on Solomon Grundy.

images.label: A group of players taking on .

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Start this wanted mission at the wanted poster in the north west corner of the East End Police Station. Then head to the Giordano Botanical Gardens. You'll find Solomon Grundy at the northern part of the Gardens, near a Booster Gold Exploration Adventure Kiosk. Advanced characters will be able to defeat Grundy with a few hits and won't take significant damage from his attacks, while characters in relevant level need to group up to defeat him.
Grundy will only attack players who attack him, or if the plant people turn into combat mode while his near. He'll cease his attacks if players cease theirs.

sections.title: At Relevant Levels
items: Solomon is an average difficulty bounty kill.
He hits quite hard, up to at least 495 damage, but a level 30 fire tank is possible to outheal his damage and solo him.

The main issue with this fight is the large knockback he does, this can send you very far into multiple mobs within the botanical garden causing some serious issues. You can obviously breakout of this knockback to cut it short, but you'll find yourself with very little power if you do.
Also, Grundy could knock back so hard that he walks too far and his health reset when hit, and the fight had to be started again, so watch out for that.
Barring the massive knockback this fight is pretty standard.

Scrappy Leggings (only for first completion)

title: WANTED: The Judge
summary: Wanted! Considered a serious threat: do not approach alone.

sections.title: Overview
items: Wanted! Considered a serious threat: do not approach alone.

sections.title: Background
items: This is a Wanted mission exclusively for heroes, located in the Midtown MPD.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Locate and Defeat The Judge in Metropolis

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: A full party is recommended to defeat The Judge, healer, and tanks are definitely required.
This guy hits hard, has seriously annoying knockbacks and big AoE dmg but at a fairly short range.

The Judge is surrounded and actively patrols through other quest mobs, meaning you'll have to fight your way to clear a path and will find yourself knocked into more mobs constantly. This is complicated by the fact that the Vengeful Spirits could telekinetically slam players with cars, throwing them around violently.
Possibly try to kite him into a corner with a tank class and stick close to the walls to avoid too much knockback.

title: Watchtower Containment Facility
summary: Watchtower Containment Facility is a Tier 1 Alert in the base Classic Game where Heroes prevent the escape of prisoners and stop the Watchtower's reactor from exploding.

sections.title: Overview
items: This article is a stub.
Watchtower Containment Facility is a Tier 1 Alert in the base Classic Game where Heroes prevent the escape of prisoners and stop the Watchtower's reactor from exploding.
Access to the Alert requires Level 30.
It is also available as a 4-player Alert in Legends PvE.

sections.title: Background
items: The Watchtower Containment Facility is used by the Justice League of America to hold captured criminals. Its entrance is located at the east side of the bottom level of the Magic Wing of the Watchtower.

Brainiac has hacked the Watchtower's Containment Facility, releasing several prisoners including warriors loyal to the H.I.V.E. and Gorilla Grodd. Players must re-capture the escaping prisoners and stop Brainiac from overloading the Watchtower's power core.

sections.title: Story
items: The Watchtower's Containment Facility is on full alert as prisoners erupt from their cells — and a countdown begins on the main reactor. The Justice League needs you to contain the danger.

sections.title: Overview
items: " People of Earth, I am Starro. Resist me no longer and submit to your conqueror!" — Starro Conqueror
Weekly Bounty: Starro Conqueror is a weekly bounty mission for heroes and villains in Central City Starro Deluge Zone as part of the Deluge episode.
To start the mission, a console must be used near the helicopter landing pad of the 7 News building in Central City.

Access to this content is available to all players for free. This open world mission is available to all Level 20+ players — stat buffs will be applied as needed. The target stats are boosted to a Combat Rating of 174 or 209 dependent on if player's Equipped CR is respectively below or above 194 (the CR for enemies in this zone).

items: Weird Science is one of the daily missions for heroes in the Ace Chemicals Clean Up Effort set from the Home Turf episode. It requires a Combat Rating of 60+.

sections.title: Intro
items: Help Steelworks and Envirotech in their efforts to subdue the Chemoids at Ace Chemicals.

items: Locate and speak to HAZMAT Smith; Locate and defeat Pyro Chemoids [0/2]; Locate and defeat Cryo Chemoids [0/2]; Locate and defeat Shock Chemoids [0/2]

The Chemling is unstable and must be subdued

items: Chemling

sections.title: Speak to HAZMAT Smith
items: HAZMAT Smith is located next to the ambulances at the processing area. Interact with him, and he'll ask you to test his hypothesis that the Chemoids' colors are somehow related to their behavior.

sections.title: Defeat Chemoids
items: You must defeat 2 Chemoids of each type: Shock (yellow), Cryo (blue), and Pyro (red). They are scattered across the main Ace Chemicals building and the back area at west. Once you're done, go back to Smith and interact with him, so he can tell you what to do next.

sections.title: Inject a Green Chemling with Mixture
items: Go back to the main Ace Chemicals building, and look for a green Chemling. It spawns anywhere above ground level. Defeat it then interact with it to inject the mixture.

sections.title: Subdue Unstable Chemling
items: As soon as you're injecting the mixture, the Chemling will turn into an Unstable Chemling, acting chaotically and very aggressively. Defeat it and - surprise! - it'll turn into a Friendly Chemling, proving HAZMAT Smith's hypothesis true. Mission complete!

sections.title: Overview
items: Orcale

" Oracle here. Great news! All your good work has made a difference. YOU are invited to the Watchtower! The Justice League officially invites you up to our satellite HQ. Get to the nearest teleporter, and I'll show you around." — Oracle
Welcome to the Watchtower is a level 12 mission for heroes.

sections.title: Summary
items: The Justice League has given you access to the Watchtower, where the world's heroes unite in the fight against villainy. Report to the [depends on mentor] Meta/Tech/Magic Wing immediately!

sections.title: Part 1
items: Use the Teleporter in the nearest Police Station to report to the Meta/ Tech/ Magic Wing in the Watchtower

sections.title: Part 2
items: Locate the War Room below the Meta Wing entrance
Access the Console in the War Room

Access the Console in the Reactor Core
Exit through the side entrance in the Meta Wing and locate the Aquacultural Area
Access the Console in the Aquacultural Area

Access the Console in the Hangar

sections.title: Part 3
items: Return to the Meta/Tech/Magic Wing

sections.title: Part 3
items: R&D Scanner

sections.title: Notes
items: This mission is not required for access to Watchtower.
Players are not required to use the Teleporters - they could use the "Warp HQ" option on the map interface.
While it is possible to access the consoles before, it must be accessed at the point of the mission to count.
Players are not required to use banks, just enter the area. Note that the banks are in floor below the consoles.

Accessing the console in the Monitor Womb and the Aqua grants 627 xp each. Exiting the Aquacultural Area grants 2867 xp - it also automatically completes the mission without need of reaching Teleporters.

Sometimes (for the reactor core part, for example) the X mission marks does not mark the location where you should go, but rather a mid-way point - it is likely made to prevent new players getting stuck due to a straight direction.

title: What's In The Box?
summary: What's In The Box? is a side mission accessible once the level 13 Lunatic Fringe is started.

sections.title: Overview
items: What's In The Box? is a side mission accessible once the level 13 Lunatic Fringe is started.

This missions is started by talking to Detective Preston at the door after the hallway, along with Sergeant Reeves who starts Cops Behind Bars. Finishing it is required in order to get the Oh, I Get It feat which is worth 25 Points.

It take place in the Joker's Funhouse. The objective of the mission is to save the police officers inside the presents inside the Funhouse on your way to Harley Quinn to save Robin which is your main quest. Be careful because police officers are not the only thing that can come out of the presents. Sometimes, if and when you're unlucky, you'll get an explosive Jokandroid or a Joker Dawg instead, with the former being especially dangerous.

title: Labyrinth of Lost Souls
summary: Labyrinth of Lost Souls is a Tier 3 Raid in the Amazon Fury Part II Episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Labyrinth of Lost Souls is a Tier 3 Raid in the Amazon Fury Part II Episode.

In the depths of Tartarus, you must journey through the Labyrinth of Lost Souls. If you can overcome the deadly contraptions and creatures within, you will prove to Hades that you are a force to be reckoned with.
Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Raid under Expert Tier 3 of the 8 Player Tab.
Combat Rating requirement: 100

" There you are! Did you hear that voice? That was Hades - he must've diverted your path, sending you deep into Tartarus. I was able to stay on Ares' heels, and was taken directly to the palace grounds - not far from his uncle's throne room. You however, are in the Labyrinth -- created by Daedalus to house the Minotaur. Expect the unexpected, and be prepared to navigate his traps and devices. If you can get through this maze, we should be able to regroup." — Wonder Woman

" There you are! Did you hear that voice? That was Hades, Lord and Master of the underworld. While you were dawdling, he must've diverted your path, deep into Tartarus. I, however, was able to stay an Ares' heels, and was taken directly to the palace grounds - not far from his uncle's throne room. You, are in the Labyrinth -- created by Daedalus to house the Minotaur. Be prepared for any number of traps and devices. If you survive the maze, you may rejoin me." — Circe

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: As you make your way through the Labyrinth, you will fight several bosses interspersed with puzzle rooms, which you can only unlock the path to the next when solved. One requires you to pick up boulders to block entrances of shades, and another require you to pick up water barrels to douse flames.

However, a trickier one is the room with the Gorgon idols. When one of the idols are activated, after a short delay, it shoots out white waves that cause any target (both shades and players) facing it to turn into stone. Therefore, you must avoid killing the shades and lure them to an idol, activate it and immediately face away, so the shades would be turned to stone while you would not. Then, quickly pick up the petrified shades to block the 5 vents on the ground.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Confront Ares and Hades in the latter's throne room, where Hippolyta's soul is held.
You must defeat Ares, who will summon an Essence of War, and waves of Warring Shades. While the Essence is alive, Ares take only 1 damage from all attacks.

In Elite, this is considerably harder as the Essence of War is healed when it is hit by any attack, except that done by a tank player (and their pets, Snow Devil and Brick Golem; non-tank specific pets like Robot Sidekick will heal the Essence even if summoned by a tank), or Wonder Woman. Even Ares and Warring Shades will attack it to heal it. Therefore, two tanks is generally needed. One would corner the Essence (preferably at the throne, away from the gates where Warring Shades spawn) and kill it, while the other keeps Ares and the Shades' attention. All players other than the Essence tank should focus on killing Shades as quickly as possible.
After defeating Ares, defeat Hades' three judges, and then Hades himself.
Blissful Lamentation: Applied on a player who will damage nearby players over time (displays source player name).
Paintheon: Hades burns, stuns, and teleports a random player into a side chamber, where they must defeat a single Shade Guard to open a portal back to the main room.
Reflective Shield: Hades spins his staff, damaging any players who hit him.
Upon defeat, Hades ask for Ares' help, but Ares betrays him and strikes him down. Circe offers an alliance with Ares, who accepts. They escape with Hippolyta's soul.
Wonder Woman furiously declares she would move heaven and earth to get her mother back. (Heroes)
Circe traps and teleports Wonder Woman away. (Villains)

summary: Corrupted Zamaron is a Tier 3 Duo released in Episode 15: Bombshell Paradox & Corrupted Zamaron together with The Bombshell Paradox. It requires a Combat Rating of 100+ and rewards 2 Source Marks and Loot items.

sections.title: Overview
items: Corrupted Zamaron is a Tier 3 Duo released in Episode 15: Bombshell Paradox & Corrupted Zamaron together with The Bombshell Paradox. It requires a Combat Rating of 100+ and rewards 2 Source Marks and Loot items.
It is also available as a Tier 7 Flashback Duo RN Flashback: Corrupted Zamaron in Raging Night during chapter events.

"The Black" has re-emerged in the universe and has targeted the Predator entity inside the Central Power Battery on Zamaron. Because of this threat, Indigo-1 of the Indigo Tribe has now joined the War of the Light. Players must help Carol Ferris defend Zamaron from the Black Lanterns and will purge the Black Lanterns' Corruption from the Battery.

sections.title: Story
items: In War of the Light Part I, Lanterns of all colors lost connection with their Emotional Spectrum’s entities and strange mists descended upon Metropolis, affecting all the citizens’ emotions. This caused four Corps (Green, Blue, Sinestro, and Red) to converge on Earth to find out what happened, which led to the War of the Light happening on Earth, in the center of Metropolis, as well as on nearby sentient planets, Mogo and Ranx.

Throughout the war, Green Lantern Hal Jordan and Sinestro discovered that the other corps were likely not the enemy, and an uneasy alliance was formed. The fate of the Emotional Entities hangs in the balance in War of the Light Part II, when Carol Ferris and the Star Sapphires and Larfleeze's Orange Lanterns journeyed to Earth to restore their own entities at any cost.
With help from YOU, the sparks in the lantern batteries were reignited and the balance of the emotional spectrum was restored. But the War of the Light did not end there…

Now it's time to head BACK to Zamaron, the homeworld of the Star Sapphires, to continue this story. The Black Lanterns have invaded, and though Carol Ferris is doing what she can to fight them, she won't be able to do it alone. It's up to you to head to Zamaron, target the Predator entity inside the Central Power Battery, and purge its corruption.

title: Oa Under Siege
summary: Oa Under Siege is a walk-in solo mission in Episode 16 released on September 2nd, 2015.

sections.title: Overview
items: " This is Hal Jordan. Oa has been invaded by Black Lanterns! I need immediate assistance from anyone who gets this message!" — Hal Jordan
Oa Under Siege is a walk-in solo mission in Episode 16 released on September 2nd, 2015.

The Black Lanterns’ deadly hunger was not satisfied from corrupting Zamaron. They’ve now set their sights on Oa’s Central Power Battery! Black Lanterns are invading Oa and the Green Lanterns need your help! If they manage to corrupt Oa, it could be too late for the rest of the universe. Help Hal Jordan to repel the Black Lanterns before the Corruption spreads!
Access to Oa Under Siege requires 100+ Combat Rating. Enemies have a Combat Rating of 138.
Oa Under Siege is part of Episode 16 sold together with Desecrated Cathedral, but is now free for all players.

sections.title: Story
items: The War of the Light began when Brainiac disrupted the emotional entities of the various Lantern Corps (Green, Blue, Sinestro, and Red). What began as a battle in Metropolis, quickly spread to outlying sentient planets. As the Corps – with your help – formed an uneasy alliance to combat the disruptions in the center of the emotional spectrum, the control over the influence of the edges of the spectrum weakened. Thus began the War of the Light Part II, with the arrival of Larfleeze’s Orange Lanterns and Carol Ferris’ Star Sapphires.

After traveling to Zamaron and restoring some balance, Hal Jordan and Sinestro explain to Carol Ferris that the greatest threat to the Corps is still coming. That threat arrived in Episode 15: Corrupted Zamaron with the emergence of the Black Lanterns. As the Black Lanterns corrupted the Star Sapphires home planet of Zamaron, Indigo-1 rallied to help purge the corruption. No one knew how severely the corruption had spread until it was revealed that even Hawkgirl had become a pawn under the control of the Black Lanterns’ power.
After the Black Lanterns were defeated on Zamaron and the Power Battery was restored, it seemed like things might be under control. Until they turned to Oa.

Now, Black Lanterns have invaded Oa, Hal Jordan has fallen, and the universe once again turns to you to assist the Green Lanterns before the Corruption spreads. In order to save Ion and Hal Jordan, a new member of the Indigo Tribe, Munk, Indigo-1’s second in command, arrives to assist.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The mission initially appears as Hal Needs Help! in your journal. Go to Downtown Metropolis Battlezone, where a console (in the respective safe zones for heroes and villains) would give you the mission Oa Under Siege. A portal to the Oa Central Power Battery instance then unlocks next to it. ( Hal Needs Help! only appears the first time you do the mission, afterwards you must start the mission at the console yourself.)

Black Lanterns are attacking Oa. One of the hardest parts of the mission is near the very beginning, where after defeating a single Black Lantern there is a large group of them in your way that can easily overwhelm inexperienced players. Afterwards, you find your way to the Central Battery barred by a black energy wall, try to breach it and you would fail. Hal Jordan battling Black Lanterns on the other side of the wall tells you to go get Munk.

Munk is found at the Downtown Metropolis Battlezone and tells you that you need to repel the invasion in Metropolis first. Defeat more Black Lanterns and prevent them from recruiting falling lanterns (they would turn into Black Lanterns if the mobs are not defeated quickly enough, or if they are not revived quickly enough afterwards).

Once you're done, talk to Munk and you would both return to Oa. While other lanterns hold off more Black Lanterns, you must fight your way back to the Central Battery where Munk would dispel the barrier.
The final boss is Corrupted Hal Jordan, who fights with Brawling combos.
Flowing Corruption: The most dangerous effect in this fight, black energy storms randomly appear in the area (multiples can exist at once), dealing massive damage over time if you are in it.
Dark Cage: Hal traps a target in a cage, stunning them and dealing moderate damage.

Explosive Corruption: Hal spins in place, knocking back and stunning targets while dealing a heavy hit. Warned by Lethal attack icon, and since he is not immune to crowd control, they can interrupt this attack.

There are three Black Lanterns in the room, initially inert. When Hal Jordan fall to roughly 75%, 50%, and 25% health, one, two, and three Black Lanterns would become active respectively. Whenever they are KO'ed, they can be banished by interacting with them, or they would revive at 50% health.
Once Hal is defeated, he returns to normal and Munk cleanses the Central Battery. However, he senses a presence behind the corruption - and Hal refers to it as Nekron.

items: Oa Under Siege is preceded in the War of the Light storyline by Corrupted Zamaron, and is followed by Blackest Day.

Oa Under Siege is often mistaken as a Challenge. It is the only piece of solo content during the small episodes era (episode 15 to 25) that is not a challenge, unlike Deep Desires, The Science Spire, and Iceberg Lounge (Challenge). It is mechanically a repeatable solo mission, being tracked in the journal (and not On Duty) and is locked after completion unless replay badges are used, but narratively structured like a Challenge with two boss fights, or an Operation since it involves multiple locations (including an instance and an open world zone). However, it does not award guaranteed Source Marks like On Duty instances do.

title: Desecrated Cathedral
summary: Not to be confused with Ruined Cathedral or DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum.

sections.title: Overview
items: Not to be confused with Ruined Cathedral or DoR: Desecrated Mausoleum.
Desecrated Cathedral is a Tier 3 Alert in Episode 16 released on September 2nd, 2015.

Brother Blood's schemes for ultimate power reach a new level as he uses Raven and the Sons of Trigon to collect even more power. In this four-player Alert, players will return to the cathedral in the Gotham Wastelands at the request of Raven, Trigon's daughter, to investigate the disturbance in the levels of sinful energy there and stop whatever Brother Blood has planned.
In the Elite version of the Alert, take on the Cathedral under even more challenging terms – limited revives, new mechanics, and more difficult enemies – for even greater reward.
Access to Desecrated Cathedral requires a Combat Rating of 100 and rewards 5 Source Marks.
Desecrated Cathedral is part of Episode 16 together with Oa Under Siege.

sections.title: Story
items: In Sons of Trigon, the Teen Titans discovered that Trigon had escaped his dimension thanks to a blood ritual, but the Sentinels of Magic held him at bay by trapping him between his dimension and our own. Still, his newly revealed sons were able to assist him in wreaking havoc across the Gotham Wastelands.

Trigon's release and the actions of his sons led to both Circe and Wonder Woman rushing to battle – one in search of power, the other in search of peace. Trigon is defeated, but it's not a clean victory… Circe manages to siphon off some of Trigon's power, keeping it safely hidden away for a time when he may be summoned again. Still, Trigon's sons' plans are foiled, and an unsteady peace resumes. Though Circe and Wonder Woman still have unfinished business, which comes to a head in the Amazonian civil war.
Now, Raven has sensed a great disturbance coming again from Gotham Wastelands, and she needs help to stop Brother Blood from trying to unleash Trigon again.

sections.title: Overview
items: Unholy Matrimony is a Tier 3 8 player Operation in Episode 17 released in October 2015. It also features an elite version.
Access to the Unholy Matrimony Operation requires a Combat Rating of 110.
The Unholy Matrimony is part of Episode 17 together with the Flash Museum Burglary Duo.

sections.title: Story
items: The Trigon storyline introduced in Episode 16's Desecrated Cathedral continues with Unholy Matrimony. In this 8-player Operation, players will battle alongside Raven as she confronts her father, Trigon, who has escaped from his otherworldly prison. Players must locate and defeat Trigon to stop him from gaining power enough to destroy the mortal world.
In the Elite version, players will have the chance to complete their Elite gear sets and unlock powerful new Affinity Bonuses.
This will be the first time players will have the opportunity to fight Trigon in storyline content, so all bets are off.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: This raid requires good communication between players. PUG groups will likely have a tough time.
1) Avatar of Sin and Teen Titans
The Avatar has a red bubbly AOE that he will put in two random spots in the area. Roll out immediately as contact with it causes heavy damage over time.
Cyborg is easy. When you see him kneel and go into his ball, lunge him.
Starfire will drop aggro from time to time and fly towards someone.
Superboy's laser can be dodged.
Wondergirl has a golden AOE burst on the ground that you can just walk out of before it goes off.
If you have problems here the use of two tanks can help. Split the Teen Titans from the Avatar.
2) Brother Blood and Sons of Trigon

The Sons of Trigon have to be freed from their red bubbles by going to them, best one by one. After being freed, they need be brought near Raven and put down. After about 20-30 seconds of fighting a brother Raven will teleport him away and the next one can be freed.

From time to time red blood-like AOE will appear on the floor. Everyone needs to get out that AOE as soon as possible since getting in contact with it is a trigger to spawn adds. If too many adds spawn, a DPS should touch one of the totems which appear at the border of the area and use their first ability to one-shot all the adds. The DPS will die, pick them up and continue.

After all Sons of Trigon are gone now target Brother Blood. He will randomly(?) take away the (loadout) powers of a group member. To regain the powers, the player character without powers has to use one of the totems which appear at the border of the area. What can make this phase crucial is that several group members will lose their powers, but there will always be only one totem spawning at a different location. Thus the group will need to communicate who is most important to regain their powers: Tank always first, then healer, then controller and last, but not least the DPS.

When Brother Bloods shields himself - it looks like the medic's shield from FOS3 - stop attacking. It works like a reflect that damages the entire group even if just one person attacks. If he starts shooting a blood beam at people, lunge him.
Again if you have problems here the use of two tanks can help. Split Brother Blood and the Sons of Trigon.
3) Trigon
The approach most used is Trigon being tanked where he spawns since that way the tank can grab the adds that spawn right there.
When the Hell's Hatred spawns it must be brought down ASAP or you may lose your tank.
Trigon's pull cannot be broken out from, thus block it out then roll away when you get the chance.
From time to time Trigon will spawn large lava balls. Avoid being hit by those. Also, there is a mechanic where Trigon puts something on someone and it damages your teammates nearby.

When Raven is corrupted everyone should pay attention to the purple pentagrams that will appear on the floor. For this reason, the group should be spread out and surround Trigon to have players cover every area of the map. Standing on a pentagram for a few seconds will make it disappear and once you have hit them all Raven will go back to normal. Also, every player can only do one pentagram without dying and will be down after doing a second one. Carefully evaluate which is more important, especially when doing the elite version.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Demon's Pit is a Tier 3 Duo in Episode 18 released on November 4th, 2015.

Continuing right where The Flash Museum Burglary left off, your allies have continued to investigate just what the League of Assassins' real motive is, but a blunder has turned their fact-finding mission into a rescue operation, and it's up to you.
Access to the The Demon's Pit Duo requires a Combat Rating of 100. The Duo rewards 2 Source Marks. The Demon's Pit is part of Episode 18 together with Blackest Day.

sections.title: In-Game History
items: The League of Assassin's sudden interest in Central City has drawn the concern of both the Justice League and the Society. items: Sinestro
" Ranx and Qward are both under attack. And even I cannot be in two places at once, therefor you will find Lyssa Drak and assist her in defending Ranx. I will head to Qward immediately." — Sinestro
Blackest Day is a Tier 3 8 player Operation in Episode 18 released on November 4th, 2015. It also features an elite version.
Access to the Blackest Day Operation requires a Combat Rating of 100.

The War of the Light storyline is rocketing toward and epic finale. In Blackest Day, the players have appeared on the board and Black Hand is revealed, in his attempt to further the spread of The Black to Ranx and beyond. Sinestro calls for any assistance possible, and the rest is up to the Heroes and Villains.
Blackest Day is part of Episode 18 together with The Demon's Pit.

sections.title: Story
items: And so begins the penultimate episode of the War of the Light saga. An epic finish to an epic story begins now.

The stars grow dim as the Black Lanterns spread across the universe. Oa and Zamaron are still reeling from the attack, but the Corruption hasn't stopped there. Black Hand, herald of Nekron, has finally revealed himself by attacking the Sinestro Corps' sentient city, Ranx! He aims to turn Ranx into a dangerous Corruption-spreading machine that could wipe out not only Mogo and Earth, but the rest of the universe as well. Sinestro conscribes every last one of you to help prevent Ranx from falling into the enemy's black hand.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Approach Julius and the two Lesser Lust Demon worshiping him. Julius will share his plans to take over the Tunnel and disappear. Defeat the two demons, then proceed through the Tunnel, defeating the demons along the way until you reach a locked door.

sections.title: Bypass Gluttony's Magic
items: Once you get close to the door, the following message will appear:
The Hungry Flames of Gluttony block your path, find a way to extinguish them...
This is a simple puzzle:

table.caption: Bypass Gluttony's Magic
rows: The two braziers in front of the door power the magical barrier.

table.caption: Bypass Gluttony's Magic
columns: Show tipTip #2: How do I get past the barrier?
rows: You need something to extinguish the flames. Take a look around.

table.caption: Bypass Gluttony's Magic
columns: Show tipTip #3: What am I looking for?
rows: There are two cascades in the Tunnel. Maybe you can use them.

table.caption: Bypass Gluttony's Magic
columns: Show tipTip #4: Give me the answer.
rows: The two braziers in front of the door power the magical barrier - you'll have to extinguish the fire to get to Maintenance Hall. North from the door are two cascades of lusty water. Bathe in on of them, and it will transform you into a form with a pink aura. In this form, will be able to interact with the braziers. Pour the lusty aura in the brazier to extinguish the fire, then repeat the process to put out the other brazier and the door will open.

sections.title: Subboss: Jesse
items: Keep fighting the demons and get to the kitchen, where you'll find Jesse and Julius talking. Then Julius teleports away, leaving you alone with Jesse.
Jesse uses Martial Arts and the Energy Tempest copies the appearance and abilities of the original mentors as his health depletes in the following order:
When below 90%, Jesse transforms into a version of Batman, using Martial Arts weapon style. From time to time, he will summon one of the two types of Sin Energy.

When below 60%, Jesse transforms into a version of Circe, using Hand Blast weapon style. From time to time, he will summon one Burning Sin Energy and one Frozen Sin Energy at once - the interval between each summoning is reduced.

When below 25%, Jesse transforms into a version of Superman, using Brawling weapon style. From time to time, he will summon two Burning Sin Energy and two Frozen Sin Energy at once - the interval between each summoning is reduced.
When below 10% Jesse returns to normal, and he will summon two Burning Sin Energy and two Frozen Sin Energy at once every few seconds.

Burning Sin Energy spawns from the ovens on the north side, while Frozen Sin Energy spawns from the freezers on the south side. They appear to have 3 and 2 maximum, respectively. They can generate a firestorm/blizzard that hits you for 5% of your health rapidly if you come too close (multiple Sin Energy can stack their damage).

sections.title: Fonts of Gluttony
items: Entering the Maze, you'll find Fonts of Gluttony surrounded by Sin Shields in each of the four rooms available. You need break the fonts to lure out Julius, but you have to destroy the shields first.

Each shield is attached to one specific Gluttonous Energy Hoarder, defeat all of the to destroy all of the shields. Once you have destroyed any 3 of 4 fonts, Julius will appear next to the one that remains an shield it again.

sections.title: Final Boss: Julius
items: It's time to face Julius. From time to time, he will "feast" on the font in the room, becoming invulnerable himself. This is the only time when the font can be attacked. He remains with a shield afterwards that can be damaged and destroyed - this will repeat unless you destroy the font, but that's not necessary. He also uses the Brawling weapon style and has a Theft of Vigor ability that stuns you while stealing some of your health and power, and it can be interrupted if you resist it, or break out of the stun, or use a crowd control ability against him. His other abilities include Pulverize (stomping), Flightsnare (a dark beam that grounds and pulls the target towards him).
The run will end when Julius is defeated and asks for the check.

sections.title: Story
items: The Gotham Wastelands is full of mayhem and madness. Imps and demons run amuck in the fiery wasteland, allowing Jacob and Jack to seductively and slowly (respectively) make their moves. Raven, annoyed as ever by her brothers, has asked for your help in putting them back in their places.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Wastelands Wonderland takes place in an instanced version of the northeastern branch of Gotham Wastelands.

After taking out demons, imps and their captain, you summon three Sentinels of Magic as instructed to you by the Disciple at the beginning of the instance: Sentinel Enchanter, Sentinel Mender, and Sentinel Raze Specialist, who create a giant shard between them. You must defend them against more demons. You can talk to Enchanter to gain a damage boost, Mender presumably heals you, and Raze Specialist calls down a meteor storm (however, it seems randomly targeted, indicating its area a few seconds before striking). This can only be used once.

If the Sentinels are all KO'ed, the demons and imps will gain massive damage and quickly KO you. While hard to see against the background, there is an orange crystal that works as a restoration barrel just a few steps southwest of where the sentinels are, and breaking it between them can heal them and yourself significantly. After defeating several waves of mobs, defeat the Demonic Drudgemaster. The ritual will succeed and the barrier will be taken down, allowing you to proceed.
You have to do the same thing in the next area, except the boss this time is Jack. Upon his defeat, the second shard connects to the first one with an impressive glowing trail of light.

Do it again a third time; this time you must also carry 3 crystals to a spot behind the final boss, Jacob, who is a lot more difficult. You can throw the crystals if you are confident about your aim. He can spawn Damage Fields even while untargetable. He has a lethal attack that disables all your abilities - your powers, weapon attacks, soders, trickets, you can't even block or dodge, and he can slow you to a crawl making you extremely vulnerable. You must go back to the crystals to destroy one to rinse this crippling effect when he applies it. Otherwise, stay near the sentinels so they can shield you. There is also an orange restoration crystal near them. Jacob can also summon an Idol of Jacob, which deals heavy damage around it until it is destroyed (and his previous attack can prevent you from hitting it or getting out of the way quickly).

title: Blackest Night
summary: Blackest Night is a Tier 3, 8-player Operation in Episode 20 released together with Wastelands Wonderland in January 2016. It requires a Combat Rating of 100+.

sections.title: Overview
items: Blackest Night is a Tier 3, 8-player Operation in Episode 20 released together with Wastelands Wonderland in January 2016. It requires a Combat Rating of 100+.
It was also available as a Tier 7 Flashback 8-player Operation RN Flashback: Blackest Night in Raging Night during chapter events.

A massive Black Lantern has erupted from the blood-soaked streets of war-torn Metropolis and Nekron has risen from this deathly soil. The embodiment of death is no easy foe to defeat and Hal Jordan, Sinestro, and the rest of the champions have been unable to even make a scratch. You must fight alongside Carol Ferris and the Lantern Corps and send Nekron back to the Land of the Unliving in this Operation.
And so ends the War of the Light saga, the epic finish to one of DCUO's most powerful storylines.

sections.title: Story
items: " The Black Lanterns believe that life itself is an aberration to the natural order and seek to end all life in the universe. Despite their differences, all the various Corps of the emotional spectrum can agree on one thing... ending all life is not in anyone's best interest. But the Corps can't do this without your help. We're all counting on you to save the spectrum, and well, all life, everywhere." — Oracle

" The Black Lanterns believe that life itself is an aberration to the natural order of the universe and seek to end all of it everywhere. Despite their differences, all the various Corps of the emotional spectrum can agree an one thing... ending all life would essentially suck. But the Corps can't do this without us. So, please save the universe. I like living there." — Calculator
The Blackest Night falls from the skies,
The darkness grows as all light dies,
We crave your hearts and your demise,
By my black hand, the dead shall rise!

Nekron has come. He has joined his herald, Black Hand, in extinguishing all light – all life – in the universe. The Metropolis Battlefield was ripe with the lingering death from the War of the Light, allowing Nekron to raise an enormous Black Lantern in the middle of the city. The area around the Lantern is scorched earth, scarred by the Corruption brought by the Black. You must fight alongside the Lantern Corps and send Nekron and his Black Lanterns back to the Land of the Unliving in the Blackest Night.
And so ends the War of the Light saga.

In this Operation, a Black Lantern has erupted from the blood-soaked streets of war-torn Metropolis and Nekron has risen from this deathly soil. The embodiment of death is no easy foe to defeat and Hal Jordan, Sinestro, and the rest of the champions have been unable to even make a scratch. But don’t worry, the Star Sapphire, Carol Ferris, has a plan. Will you aid her in stopping Nekron and the Black Lanterns from snuffing out all life in the universe?

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: As Flashback content in Raging Night, Blackest Night is significant harder than the new raid, RN: Book of the Black, even in normal difficulty.

sections.title: Diamond Mist
items: You meet Carol Ferris at the S.T.A.R. Labs Research Facility - the one from the alert of the same name the very first episode, Fight for the Light, where Brainiac built his logic battery, which you reach after fighting through some Black Lantern mobs. Carol reveals Brainiac's meddling with the emotional spectrum blew apart the emotional entities into the mist. She theorises she could use the logic battery to mix together the seven types of mist to create a white, or diamond mist to destroy the Black Lanterns, while Hal and Sinestro urges her to hurry.

You need to interact with the 7 mist containers, then carry the mist to the logic battery to infuse them into it. You can't use your abilities while infused with mist, and putting it in the logic battery takes a long channel leaving you vulnerable. At the same time, you are attacked by Corrupted Martian Manhunter and Corrupted Solomon Grundy. They will continuously heal when below ~20% health making them impossible to defeat, if the diamond mist is not yet created.

After filling the logic battery with all the mists, the diamond mist is created. Once both bosses are defeated, Munk arrives and opens a portal to take everyone to Metropolis where the Black Lantern battery is. If your group is defeated by the bosses, you will have to create the diamond mist again.

references.label: the alert of the same name

sections.title: Corrupted Superboy
items: The portal leads you to a blackened Metropolis Battlezone, with numerous Black Lanterns and Corrupted Superboy. The mobs are densely packed and it is recommended to KO them one section at the time to avoid being overrun, and deal with all of them before engaging Corrupted Superboy. However, if he defeats your team, the Black Lanterns respawn.

Corrupted Superboy can hit non-tanks from a distance very hard, easily dealing one-shot damage even in normal, particularly his Kryptonian Beam that can sweep a wide area. Black Lanterns are also spawned during the fight, but can be avoided by quickly standing on the black pools opening at the ground in the greater area of the fight.

sections.title: Nekron
items: Finally, you face Nekron and Black Hand. While Black Hand can be damaged and KO'ed, Nekron will simply revive him, while Nekron himself is immune to damage.

You have to wait for canisters of the diamond mist to appear at the Indigo Tribe portal and transport each to the Black Lantern battery. Then, a random player would be teleported inside the battery. They need to pick up the canister and carry it to the indicate spot inside the battery, turning the energy from black to white, and they are teleported back out. Once all four spots have been converted, white light shines out of the battery and Nekron can now be damaged normally.

The whole time, you'd have to contend with the attacks of Nekron, Black Hand, Black Lantern mobs - and if any of your Lantern Corps allies are KO'ed, Nekron may raise them as a Black Lantern and turn them against your team. Therefore, it is common for the tank alone to hold the enemies' attention on the opposite side of the portal, so others can use the mist without interference or needing to fight until Nekron is vulnerable.

Hazards are also a massive threat in this fight, as permanent black pools can spawn in the are, dealing massive damage over time to players within. They can even spawn mid-air at eye height making them nearly invisible disks at some angles. Black orbs also rove around the area damaging nearby players, but at least the Lethal attack icon above them makes them easier to see.

sections.title: Overview
items: " Thanks for checking out the alert signal coming from the Fortress. I'd head there myself, but I'm trying to get to the bottom of Darkseid's plans. Anyway, we can discuss that later -- the readings are coming from the Phantom Zone Projector - head over there and I will check back in." — Superman

" Welcome back to the Fortress of Solitude! With Superman gone, you should be able to get acquainted with some intriguing Kryptonian tech. But I still get first rights on whatever you might find. My sensors are showing some anomalous readings emanating near the Phantom Zone Projector....but no risk, no reward." — Lex Luthor
The Phantom Zone is a Tier 3 4-player Operation in Episode 22 released in March 2016.

sections.title: Story
items: The Fortress of Solitude's defense systems are malfunctioning just as Superman is busy investigating an incredible off world threat. The source appears to be the Phantom Zone Projector! Superman needs trusted heroes to help check out the disturbance! Meanwhile Lex Luthor, having inserted listening devices in the Fortress during the Fortress raids long ago, is calling on villains to come play while Superman's away.

sections.title: Malfunctioning Jor-El A.I.
items: At 75%, 50%, and 25% health, he becomes immune to all damage and flies to a specific spot in the area. You must pick up the 3 crystals near him (always in the same color as his immunity shield) and throw them down the nearby chasm, then use the console to deactivate his shield. At 25%, he can also ground players, making it trickier to do so. Since he continues to moves around while immune, look out for the golden X marker on the minimap if you lost track where the console is.

sections.title: Captain Zul and Ursa
items: Straightforward fight, Captain Zul would call out for help at 50% health and Ursa would arrive. You could disable the 4 consoles of the solar generator to weaken them, but it is not necessary. They can only be disabled in a dictated sequence, and the 2nd only becomes interactable some time after the 1st is disabled, and so on.

sections.title: General Zod and Non
items: General Zod and Non are also fairly simple, although they have a freeze breath attack that can freeze numerous opponents as once, which is annoying but can be broken out of. You are instructed to stop 6 of his militia from carrying supplies and escaping through portals.

When defeated, Zod, Non, and his militia would still escape even if you didn't allow any mobs with supplies to get through in the fight. However, Superman/Lex Luthor would later arrange a portal for your own escape.

sections.title: Story
items: Something went down in the Phantom Zone, and a certain prisoner has escaped, along with his followers. Lois Lane, intrepid reporter, is on the case. Her sources have described sightings of Kryptonians near Lex Luthor's Science Spire, and she believes they are after information stored there. You know, that huge, questionably oversized monument Lex Luthor erected in the Tomorrow District of Metropolis? She's taken a leave of absence from the Daily Planet and is hiring muscle to help her break in and investigate before she's the one getting scooped.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Talk to Lois Lane, which would open the first door. Defeat several waves of minions. Beware of the mines set by Kryptonian Grenadiers, as they could do significant damage.
Defeat Captain Venz. He has a special attack in which he smashes the ground dealing massive unblockable damage, which can be interrupted by throwing the kryptonite chunks dropped by Lois at him.
Go up the shaft at the east side of the room. Go east, defeat more Kryptonians and go through the portal to another upper floor.

Destroy the debris to get through the door. After going through more minions, you will arrive in a room with a glowing central column. Take the orb of energy from a visibly sparking source around the room (the interact option does not appear unless you're next to it) to the indicated energy pad. Do this several times to open the door.

Move up another floor and face Senior Officer Gohz, accompanied by two Troopers. He can use Freezing Breath to encase the player. Periodically, a LexCorp Security Device drops into the room, and if not disarmed, they create a constant lightning field at the spot that deals ~800 damage repeatedly.
Interact with the database to finish the challenge.

sections.title: Story
items: The Will of Darkseid is revealed.

While off-world seeking information about Apokolips, Superman has discovered that the forces of Darkseid are gathering an invasion force on the surface of New Genesis. Parademons are lining up in ranks to invade!

Superman asks that you help the locals defend their homes while the New Gods of New Genesis are busy elsewhere preparing a counter-attack. Lex Luthor enters the scene for the villains, curious if working with Darkseid is even worth the investment. He will quickly form an opinion.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Defeat parademons and their lieutenant on New Genesis. You hear Darkseid declaring his intention to destroy Earth, and go to Central City to stop the invasion.

You must destroy 5 Apokoliptian cannons, each guarded by 4 parademons that need to be defeated before the cannon is targetable. There are also extra patrols of parademons and The Flash is fighting endless waves of them northeast of the area, but it is not necessary to fight those.

Defeat Mantis and Kalibak. Superman (for heroes) comment that isn't much of an invasion, but spots Steppenwolf coming out of the Flash Museum. Mad Harriet carries a crate from the museum and escapes through a boom tube, and Darkseid says he has what he needs. Superman notes that she has stolen an ancient artiface from the Third World.

Defeat Steppenwolf. He can be quite difficult as he summons a New God Axe that spins around dealing heavy continuous damage around it and slowly follows you. Steppenwolf has a Lethal attack, Apokoliptian Kinetic Energy: he charges for a few seconds before releasing a massive burst of energy, dealing incredible damage in a massive area. He also has a pull that grounds you.

After defeating Steppenwolf, he also flees in a boom tube. Superman says he doesn't look how pleased the Apokoliptians are, which is always bad news; he says they must take the fight to Darkseid - leading up to the Darkseid's War Factory raid.

sections.title: Story
items: In Episode 22, General Zod and his followers escaped from the Phantom Zone! Lois Lane then tracked his Kryptonian forces to Lex Luthor's Science Spire in Metropolis, and there discovered what they were after – the secret coordinates to: Brainiac's Bottle Ship!

Zod wants those coordinates and he'll do whatever it takes to get them – including using the Science Spire's enormous laser on the city of Metropolis. Superman and Lex Luthor are sending teams to get Zod out of the Spire and back under control, and you're up.
Supergirl is on the way with her own vested interest in the location of the Bottle Ship, so she'll be by your side as you confront General Zod. Then things get really interesting.

items: Pay attention to door icons with a red background that appear multiple times in the Brainiac Bottle Ship section of this operation - interact with those consoles to shut doors that would otherwise let in an endless flood of Brainiac mobs. sections.title: Story
items: " This hellscape is Apokolips, Darkseid's domain, with danger facing us around every corner. And none of that will prepare you for Darkseid himself. He is the single greatest threat to our world. We may be fools to be here, but we would be greater fools if we left Darkseid unchallenged." — Superman

" Welcome to Apokolips. Now I see why Darkseid is so eager to rule other worlds. His mistake was coveting mine. Earth will not be under anyone's thumb. Well, any alien's thumb. But let's not get ahead of ourselves. Today is the last day of Darkseid's reign." — Lex Luthor

Darkseid and his nefarious plans must be stopped once and for all. He has finally gathered enough Artifacts of the Old Gods to construct to reshape them into a machine that will allow him to access the all-powerful Source. With a direct line to the Source, Darkseid's will could never be stopped. You must get there before he can release that divine power into the universe.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Warning: This section might contain spoilers!

Enter the Iceberg Lounge and interact with all possible spots, such as taking a photograph next to the pool, dancing among guests, buying drinks, and talking to Lex Luthor. After that, talk to the Wary Partygoer on the east side of the room, who would ask you to investigate a noise in the back.
You will find Harley Quinn and Poison Ivy, who came to rescue Catwoman. Clear out Penguin's goons in the next room, and Pengbot Maximus 2.0 would arrive.
During battle, it would upgrade twice, to 2.5 and 3.0. While upgrading, it cannot be attacked and summons two goons, which must be defeated to render it vulnerable again.
It has several special attacks:
Heat Vision: Pushes you back while doing moderate damage (~800 every hit).
Spin Attack: Area knock up and moderate damage (~700 every hit).
Rockets: They could be fired in a circle, so generally only one would hit, or all at you at once, which deals quite a bit of damage as every rocket hits ~1000.
Optic Burst: Grounds you and does minimal damage (less than 100 every hit).

Arctic Void: By far the most dangerous attack and does not give a skull warning, only used at 3.0. Pengbot Maximus teleports around the room, and dark singularities appear, dealing 5000+ damage after a few seconds. It could also pull, push or teleport you at this stage making them harder to avoid. It is recommended to turn brightness up to see them better.
Alcubierre Wave: Only used at 3.0. He projects a wave of quantum energy, dealing moderate damage.

You then need to defend Harley while she unlocks a door (this is dependent on number of mobs defeated, not time). It is unlikely for her to be KO'ed as she has a lot of health and most mobs prioritise you.

Fight through more goons until you reach Catwoman, who tells you it is a trap; the room floods with poison gas. You have 60 seconds to pick up Poison Ivy's seeds to plug the vents - failing to do so will cause the gas damage to speed up and all remaining seeds to reset. Once you have plugged the first vent, Mass-Produced Pengbots would appear and their heat vision can ground you, knock you back and cause you to drop the plants. Ignore them because they spawn endlessly and disappear when all vents are plugged and Penguin appears.

Defeat Penguin himself. Non-attackable Exploding Pengbots wander in the room - they don't target you, but if you move too close to one it would explode dealing very heavy damage. It appears they do not go into the southeast corner however, so you could fight Penguin relatively safely there.

After defeating him, go to the back room and interact with the Gemerald. Poison Ivy and Harley Quinn betray you and steal it instead, and plot to kidnap Bruce Wayne for ransom, despite Catwoman's protests. This is followed upon in the Wayne Manor Gala duo.

items: The main mechanic of this fight is the bombing that occurs on multiple red circles on the floor after brief delays. sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Drink the beverage near the entrance of the instance, then attend the fundraising gala for Brainiac's victims where Bruce Wayne is supposed to appear. However, he fails to show up and a Joker robot appears, revealing Harley's plot to kidnap Bruce Wayne for ransom (as hatched in Iceberg Lounge (Challenge)) and stating demands for plant food, the erasure of the letter "B", and catnip. After defeating them, meet up with Catwoman who explains the beverage has an antidote for the pheromone.

You then need to defeat Harley and Ivy's accomplice, Killer Croc, before confronting the duo in the sewers. After defeating them, Catwoman appears and chastise them for the ill-thought out plan. In a classic move, the kidnapped Bruce Wayne vanishes, and Harley and Ivy flees upon hearing sirens.

sections.title: Overview

Access to the Kandor Central Tower Raid requires a Combat Rating of 150.
Kandor Central Tower is part of Episode 26 together with the Wayne Manor Gala Duo.

sections.title: Story
items: Using stolen technology, General Zod has restored Kandor to its normal size! Still trapped within Brainiac’s bottle, Kandor now resides in the Arctic near the Fortress of Solitude. While its unknown whether Kandor on its own is a threat to Humanity, there is no doubt that Zod intends to raise an army of Kryptonians and rule the planet. Heroes join Superman, Superboy, and Supergirl in Kandor to convince everyone that Humans and Kryptonians can share the planet and live in peace, while Villains join Lex Luthor in Kandor to prepare to evict its people from earth.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Entering the raid, speak to Superman. He tells you that Kandor is all that remains of Krypton and he and the other kryptonians are here to ensure its safety. Supergirl says they must find her mother, Alura. On the way there, you will fight waves of enemies, and then you will confront Alura. She is actually with General Zod, and since he plans on using Kandor to take over Earth, you must defeat him in battle. Alura is labelled as hostile, but cannot be attacked. Zod attacks with Martial Arts.
Fire Field: The main mechanic for most players to avoid, Zod lays down fields of fire that rapidly damage all targets standing on them.
Kryptonian Agonizer: This attaches to a player and will continuously damage any other players that come nearby (combat messages for the damage will note which player it comes from).
Forced Genuflect: Damages and stuns all targets.

After you defeat Zod, Lex Luthor appears and states that he's here to make sure that Superman and the others never leave Kandor. Defeat Lex Luthor to proceed. During the battle, Superboy will become an enemy and fight you. Optionally, you can use the nearby crystals to force Superboy to your side. After you defeat Luthor, he states that the battle is wasting his time and summons Doomsday. He knocks Superman out of the room and goes after him. You and the others must locate Superman and help him fight Doomsday.
Eventually, you do. Defeat Doomsday to finish the raid.

After Doomsday is defeated, Supergirl states to Alura the players have bested Doomsday and should be trusted. After a conversation, Alura is convinced that Humans and Kryptonians can live in peace, and the raid ends.

title: Shadows Over Argo
summary: Shadows Over Argo is tier 8 playable content that contains the open world Sunken Argo City, the raid SoA: Sunstone Refinery and a scaled-down alert version SoA: Sunstone Refinery Alert, the challenge SoA: Kryb's Lab, plus the Flashback instances SoA Flashback: The Royal War and SoA Flashback: Spindrift Station available during related chapter events.

sections.title: Overview
items: Shadows Over Argo is tier 8 playable content that contains the open world Sunken Argo City, the raid SoA: Sunstone Refinery and a scaled-down alert version SoA: Sunstone Refinery Alert, the challenge SoA: Kryb's Lab, plus the Flashback instances SoA Flashback: The Royal War and SoA Flashback: Spindrift Station available during related chapter events.
The chapter is intended to be the first of a 4-part Story Arc, " Children of Krypton".
The casual mode version is available for player characters with level 20 or above.
This chapter also featured an event running from June 2nd through 30th, 2026 where exclusive rewards and resources can be earned by completing missions to earn progress points.
Chapter 1: Shadows Over Argo was released on June 2nd, 2026. Access to this content is available to all players for free.

sections.title: Story
items: The hunt for Kryb leads to the depths of the Atlantic within Argo City — the birthplace of Supergirl! Join the Woman of Tomorrow in the fight to bring Kryb to justice!

From the depths of the ocean and the weight of forgotten history, a new crisis rises beneath the waves. Chapter One: Shadows Over Argo begins as the hunt for Kryb leads unlikely allies into the submerged remains of Argo City, the lost Kryptonian sanctuary hidden in the Atlantic. What should have been a relic of Krypton’s past has become a battleground for control, corruption, and warped hope.

With Supergirl leading the charge and allies like Aquaman, Mera, Blue Lantern Luzia, and Krypto joining the fight, players must uncover Kryb’s twisted experiments and push back the spreading influence threatening both Atlantean and Kryptonian legacies.

sections.title: Sunken Argo City
items: Argo City rises again, this time as a fully playable open world zone submerged beneath the Atlantic. Players will explore Sunken Argo City, navigating fractured Kryptonian districts overtaken by Atlantean pressure, Red Kryptonite corruption, and Trench infestations.

sections.title: SoA: Sunstone Refinery
items: Beneath Argo City lies the Sunstone Refinery, a sealed Kryptonian facility once used to contain Red Kryptonite. It has become something far more unstable, where old systems still hum with a corrupted purpose. Hunt down Atrocitus in the Sunstone Refinery and stop his experiments with Red Kryptonite. Multiple difficulty options allow all players to experience the story, with Elite challenges pushing coordination and skill to the limit. Available in Casual, Normal, and Elite versions.

sections.title: SoA: Sunstone Refinery Alert
items: Hunt down Atrocitus in Argo's Sunstone Processing Plant and stop his experiments with Red Kryptonite. The alert offers a condensed experience of the raid that preserves the chapter’s key story beats, designed for smaller strike teams. Available in Casual, Normal, and Elite versions.

sections.title: SoA: Kryb's Lab
items: Deep within Argo’s flooded understructure, players descend into Kryb’s Lab, where some of her most twisted experiments have been taking place. With the lead on Hope's location, travel with Supergirl and Luzia to finally confront Kryb and rescue the only family Luzia has left. This story-focused solo mission is available in Story, Normal, Casual, and Elite versions.

sections.title: SoA Flashback: The Royal War
items: Revisit a past memory from under the sea. Scaled up to Tier 7, and available in Casual, Normal, and Elite versions.

Flashpoint Batman has a strategy for dealing with the Royal War: break the impasse by taking away the super-weapon of Atlantis and the super-shield of New Themyscira. If he's right, that will be enough to convince the true target to reveal himself. You and The Flash are going to help.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Continuing the pattern from the preceding Story Arc, story-wise the Kryb's Lab Challenge takes place after the Sunstone Refinery Raid/Alert. Walk-in Story versions of the On-Duty instances are encountered during first play through in missions as follows:; Sunstone Refinery Raid/Alert: Mining for Answers; Kryb's Lab Challenge: The Lab of Horrors

Once the introductory narrative missions have been completed by one player character, a Shadows Over Argo: Account Mission Skip Voucher is rewarded and can be used to have the option to skip those missions on alternative player characters on the account.
Origin Augments are now maxed out at 452.
Generic gear's maximum level is raised to 445.

From June 2-4, 2026 there was a bug in the game that prevented some players from completing the 2nd mission "Battle for Argo: Establishing a Foothold" by not allowing the player to "Speak with Aquaman". Story progression could not occur. A Hotfix on June 4 resolved the issue.
Shadows Over Argo is the second time a Kryptonian city is brought to Earth in DC Universe Online, after Kandor Central Tower, nearly ten years ago in real time.

Break-in at Zor-El's Lab, like all the regular missions, is classified under the location "Sunken Argo City", but it has a separate "Sunken Argo City" section in the journal when sorted by location, and is not considered "Current location", so you need to scroll down to find it even when you are in the open world zone. It is only considered "Current location" after you enter the lab.

title: Wrath of the Worldkillers
summary: Wrath of the Worldkillers is tier 8 playable content that contains the open world Titans Bay, the raid WotW: Total Overload and a scaled-down alert version WotW: Total Overload Alert, the duo WotW: Besieged Titans Tower, plus the Flashback instances WotW Flashback: Titans Training Sim and WotW Flashback: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn available during related chapter events.

sections.title: Overview
items: Wrath of the Worldkillers is tier 8 playable content that contains the open world Titans Bay, the raid WotW: Total Overload and a scaled-down alert version WotW: Total Overload Alert, the duo WotW: Besieged Titans Tower, plus the Flashback instances WotW Flashback: Titans Training Sim and WotW Flashback: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn available during related chapter events.
The chapter is intended to be the second of a 4-part Story Arc, " Children of Krypton".
The casual mode version is available for player characters with level 20 or above.
This chapter also featured an event running from October 6th through November 2nd, 2026 where exclusive rewards and resources can be earned by completing missions to earn progress points.
Chapter 2: Wrath of the Worldkillers was released on October 6th, 2026. Access to this content is available to all players for free.

sections.title: Story
items: The Worldkillers have descended upon Titans Bay, surrounding the city with a forcefield that prevents anyone from entering or escaping. Power is failing across the globe, civilians are trapped within the city, and Earth's defenders are running out of time. Join Supergirl and a reluctant new ally in Reign, as you enter the besieged city, reclaim S.T.A.R. Labs and Titans Tower, and put a stop to the Worldkillers' plans before Earth goes dark.

sections.title: Titans Bay
items: Explore Titans Bay, a city under siege by the Worldkillers and their Diasporan forces. Rescue civilians trapped beneath rubble, assist S.T.A.R. Labs personnel, free captured metahumans, disrupt Diasporan operations, and restore the defenses surrounding Titans Tower.

sections.title: WotW: Total Overload / WotW: Total Overload Alert
items: Power is failing across the globe, and Flower of Heaven is behind it. The Worldkiller has taken control of S.T.A.R. Labs and is using its technology to overload Earth’s energy systems. Enter the compromised facility alongside Supergirl, Reign, and Cyborg to fight through Diasporan forces.

sections.title: WotW: Besieged Titans Tower
items: Join Supergirl, Reign, and Crush inside Titans Tower as they attempt to bring down the forcefield surrounding Titans Bay. Fight through Diasporan forces and corrupted Titans technology, rescue trapped Titan trainees, and help Cyborg and Raven regain control of the Tower.

sections.title: WotW Flashback: Titans Training Sim
items: Heroes and Villains enter the Titans Training Sim alongside Damian Wayne and Terra to prove they have what it takes to join the Teen Titans. Face waves of holographic enemies drawn from the Titans’ past before testing your strength against Damian himself.

sections.title: WotW Flashback: Titans: H.I.V.E. Reborn
items: All trails lead to here, the H.I.V.E. Reborn Raid. Infiltrate the encampment and find the missing Titans. Keep your mind open to Psimon's communication and instructions.
