Source guidance: The Last Menagerie is a feat related to the Themyscira Divided alert, part of the Amazon Fury Part I episode.

Source guidance: Circe's (heroes) / Wonder Woman's (villains) companion in the last fight is decided by the players when choosing a shield and a weapon to equip the Amazon Sentry Statue in order to get access to the palace. This is how it goes:

Source guidance: There are 5 possible minor bosses in the instance: Apollonia the Enchantress(H) / High Priestess Athanasia(V), Megaira of the Pack(H) / Desma of the Pride(V), the Phoenix, the Satyr Trio, and the cyclops Ten-Ton Takis(H) / Infamous Soldier Statue(V). The game will randomly pick one of them to serve as the subboss at the Temple, and another one to guard the statues with the weapons at the Cliffside Gazebo. You'll be left with the remaining 3 to narrow down to 1 for the final boss fight.
Source guidance: Each one of the fighters mentioned above corresponds to a weapon AND a shield. The choice you make will eliminate the correspondent fighter(s).
Source guidance: Cyclops will remove Ten-Ton Takis / Infamous Soldier Statue
Source guidance: Lion will remove Megaira of the Pack / Desma of the Pride
Source guidance: Lady will remove Apollonia the Enchantress / High Priestess Athanasia
Source guidance: Club will remove Ten-Ton Takis / Infamous Soldier Statue
Source guidance: Spear will remove Megaira of the Pack / Desma of the Pride
Source guidance: Mace will remove Apollonia the Enchantress / High Priestess Athanasia

Source guidance: In practice, you can predict how your run will go as soon as you get to the first subboss' area in order to complete the feat in the most efficient way possible. Identify who the three statues are representing; if none of them are the one you need for the feat, you might want to leave your current run and start a new one. If one or more of them are what you're looking for, be sure to choose the statue that represents the one you DON'T want to see next to Circe/Wonder Woman. Think of this process as crossing items in a list: every time you pick a weapon and a shield, you're crossing them off the final fight.

Source guidance: You are in the hero version of the alert and are sent to find the missing pieces of the Amazon Sentry Statue. You choose the Cliffside path first. The first subboss is Megaira. Behind her, there are 3 statues with their shields with the emblems Wings, Cyclops, and Lady— by process of elimination, that means the Satyr Trio will be the subboss waiting at the Temple. You can choose between the Phoenix, Ten-Ton Takis, and Apollonia for the final fight.
Source guidance: You defeat Megaira and pick Wings, which will remove Phoenix from the final fight.

Source guidance: Then, you to to the Temple and defeat the Satyr Trio. One of the statues holds a Club, while the other holds Mace. You can choose between Ten-Ton Takis and Apollonia. You choose the Mace, thus removing Apollonia from the final fight.
Source guidance: This means Ten-Ton Takis will appear during the final boss fight.

sections.title: Golden Path of Destruction
items: Requirement: Complete all of the rooms in the Labyrinth of Lost Souls raid in the most efficient order
Feat reward: 50 Points
Source reward tier: 3 Stars
Difficulty estimate: 3/5 (Demanding) - Group coordination or an opposing player adds variability.
Completion plan: Before entering, agree on the feat conditions with your group and use the exact instance variant named in the requirement.
Completion plan: Confirm completion in the in-game Feats menu. This planning advice is inferred from the requirement; it is not a verified encounter walkthrough.
Source guidance: Lost in the Labyrinth? Wish you had a ball of yarn to trace your path? Look no further!

Source guidance: Navigating the Labyrinth is simple. The trick is knowing which map you're currently in. So far I have experienced and solved two of the possible maps - I anticipate there are more! I know the key to one other map, but I will not list it until I have the entire map completed.
Source guidance: There are 2 boss rooms and 4 side rooms in the Labyrinth before reaching the final boss. Below is a key to understand the room names I have created for the purpose of this guide.
Source guidance: Jenga: In this room players stack blocks to block doorways.
Source guidance: Fire: In this room players put out 4 fires using water from the river Styx.
Source guidance: Gas: In this room players must find a way to stop the gas spewing from holes in the floor.
Source guidance: End: In this room players either burn adds or solve a riddle. Upon completion of all rooms, a bridge will form to reach the final boss.
Source guidance: Spike: In this room players fight a boss while spikes pop out from the ceiling and floor.
Source guidance: Spanky: This boss is a simple tank and spank.

Source guidance: You will need to determine which map you are in based off of the right or left rooms from the beginning of the map. Once you determine which map you are in, use the Map Key to figure out how to navigate the Labyrinth. Golden Paths are listed below the map key.
Source guidance: All paths will be listed in the following format:
Source guidance: Room Using the Left Path | Room Using the Right Path
Source guidance: Jenga > Spanky > Gas > Fire > Spike > End
Source guidance: From Beginning: Left > Right > Left > Right > Left > Left
Source guidance: Golden Path: Jenga > Spanky > Fire > Spike > Gas > End
Source guidance: From Beginning: Right > Right > Right > Right > Left > Right
Source guidance: Golden Path: Spanky > Gas > Spike > Fire > Jenga > End
Source guidance: From Beginning: Left > Left > Right > Left > Right > Right

Source guidance: Lost in the Labyrinth? Wish you had a ball of yarn to trace your path? Look no further!

Source guidance: Navigating the Labyrinth is simple. The trick is knowing which map you're currently in. So far I have experienced and solved two of the possible maps - I anticipate there are more! I know the key to one other map, but I will not list it until I have the entire map completed.
Source guidance: There are 2 boss rooms and 4 side rooms in the Labyrinth before reaching the final boss. Below is a key to understand the room names I have created for the purpose of this guide.
Source guidance: Jenga: In this room players stack blocks to block doorways.
Source guidance: Fire: In this room players put out 4 fires using water from the river Styx.
Source guidance: Gas: In this room players must find a way to stop the gas spewing from holes in the floor.
Source guidance: End: In this room players either burn adds or solve a riddle. Upon completion of all rooms, a bridge will form to reach the final boss.
Source guidance: Spike: In this room players fight a boss while spikes pop out from the ceiling and floor.
Source guidance: Spanky: This boss is a simple tank and spank.

Source guidance: You will need to determine which map you are in based off of the right or left rooms from the beginning of the map. Once you determine which map you are in, use the Map Key to figure out how to navigate the Labyrinth. Golden Paths are listed below the map key.
Source guidance: All paths will be listed in the following format:
Source guidance: Room Using the Left Path | Room Using the Right Path
Source guidance: Jenga > Spanky > Gas > Fire > Spike > End
Source guidance: From Beginning: Left > Right > Left > Right > Left > Left
Source guidance: Golden Path: Jenga > Spanky > Fire > Spike > Gas > End
Source guidance: From Beginning: Right > Right > Right > Right > Left > Right
Source guidance: Golden Path: Spanky > Gas > Spike > Fire > Jenga > End
Source guidance: From Beginning: Left > Left > Right > Left > Right > Right

Source guidance: In order to complete this feat, the player must approach all 6 preoccupied iconic heroes (if they are Heroes), or all 5 preoccupied iconic villains (if they are Villains) listed in the objective section.

Source guidance: Each iconic randomly appears in one of five selected locations in Metropolis or Gotham City. It is the player's task to hunt down each iconic and approach close enough for them to start talking. After which they will leave the location, appearing again on the same or another spot after a few minutes. Their presence isn't denounced with an icon on the Mini-Map like regular NPCs, so the player must go to the exact location and see if they're there before checking the next spot.

Source guidance: Paradox Patrol is a feat related to the Origin Crisis episode.

Source guidance: During both Brothers in Arms and Family Reunion alerts, it's required of players to travel through the Speed Force Tunnel to alternate versions of Gotham City or Metropolis. If they dwell in the tunnel long enough, Doctor Sarah Charles (heroes) or Veronica Cale (villains) will inform that something--or someone--has entered the location. Heroes will encounter one out of the four Rogues, while villains will encounter one of out four Titans members. Their appearance is random, and it's impossible to predict which one will appear until they actually arrive.

Source guidance: The NPC of interest will enter the Speed Force through the portal you came and run towards the end, and will only stop if attacked by mobs or by the players, and continue on their path if they are not attacked every few seconds. Tank players, tank pets and Elite Henchmen will help prevent the NPC from escaping.

Source guidance: The Flash Museum zone, including the Speed Force Tunnel, is an in-between passage for all of players who are running the instance regardless of group, so different groups might run into each other. The mobs will re-spawn every few minutes, but the NPCs related to this feat are tied to the objectives of the instance and not to the environment, so they'll only appear if triggered by the objectives in the instance - that means only one iconic will show up in an undisturbed run.
Source guidance: Several runs may be required to complete this feat.

title: 15 Crazy Nights
summary: 15 Crazy Nights is a feat in the Season's Greedings seasonal event. It was introduced in 2011.

sections.title: Source overview
items: 15 Crazy Nights is a feat in the Season's Greedings seasonal event. It was introduced in 2011.
This feat is part of the meta feat Winter Is Coming.

sections.title: Objectives
items: 15 Crazy Nights
Complete the Season's Greedings daily mission 15 times (Greed is the Word for heroes and A Greedy Story for villains)

sections.title: Reward
items: 10 Feat Points

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: For this feat, players must complete the open world daily mission 15 times. Although the description of the feat mentions "Greed is the Word" and "A Greedy Story" as the missions, those do not exist. The mission that counts towards the feat is called Season's Greedings.

To start the Season's Greedings mission, heroes must speak to Hal Jordan and villains must speak with Sinestro. They can be found at the House of Legends' Foyer and at the mission hubs in Gotham City (near Giordano Botanical Gardens) and in Metropolis (near 8th Precinct Metropolis Science Police HQ). Alternatively, Hal can be found at Watchtower's Monitor Womb, while Sinestro can be found at Hall of Doom's Sabotage Chamber.
To complete the mission, a player must speak to Hal/Sinestro once again after completing the objectives. 15 missions have to be redeemed to trigger the feat.

title: BeeHIVE Yourself
summary: BeeHIVE Yourself is a feat for heroes and villains in the Titans Island open-world zone and part of the Teen Titans: The Judas Contract episode.

sections.title: Source overview
items: BeeHIVE Yourself is a feat for heroes and villains in the Titans Island open-world zone and part of the Teen Titans: The Judas Contract episode.

sections.title: Objective
items: BeeHIVE Yourself
Chase off the HIVE Infiltrators on Titans Island

sections.title: Reward
items: 10 Points

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: As you move across the Island, you might notice a yellow-and-burgundy colored NPC crouched around and disappearing before you can take a closer look at them - those are HIVE Infiltrators (picture). The Infiltrators have a disguise that turn them invisible (but not intangible, as you can collide with them in their invisible state), but it is not perfect - it can be busted by looking at them from a predetermined angle.

Once you spot a HIVE Infiltrator (use the map on the infobox to as a guide), look for an advantage point or a place from where you can spy on them nearby. Walk slowly around the area while looking at the ground, until you find glowing footprints. Those footprints indicate the path you must follow and the direction you must be looking towards to "catch" the Infiltrator (the footprints will not appear if the "Word Detail" option in "Settings > Video" is set as "Low"). Once you stand on the final set of footprints and your character is looking at the direction pointed by them, the Infiltrator will get startled, look around and flee.
Repeat the process 51 times to unlock the feat.

title: Bombs, Ahoy!
summary: Bombs, Ahoy! is a feat for heroes and villains in the Titans Targeted! alert and part of the Teen Titans: The Judas Contract episode.

sections.title: Source overview
items: Bombs, Ahoy! is a feat for heroes and villains in the Titans Targeted! alert and part of the Teen Titans: The Judas Contract episode.

sections.title: Objective
items: During a single run of the Titans Targeted! (Normal) Alert, disable 32 of the bombs Deathstroke left in Titans Tower without allowing any of them to explode.

sections.title: Reward
items: 50 Points
Grants title: the Demolitionist

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The "bombs" are small cubic crates, which will start to run a timer when the player character is near enough. Defuse the bomb before the timer has run out.
Bombs can be found in the side rooms and later also in the hallways. They are often near to each other such that two players are required to defuse both in time.

Sometimes adds are near and should be dealt with beforehand as any attack might interrupt the defusal with not enough time left then. A tank can be helpful in these cases to just pull the attackers away.
Some bombs are placed out of the line of sight, thus always caution should be taken at junctions and corners.

The two bombs within the zone with the moving lasers should best be approached with three player characters. Two defuse the bombs and one makes sure the next side door is open before the lasers return.

sections.title: Objective
items: Get past the server room in Birds of Prey: The Clock Tower (Normal) without missing any security sequences.

references.label: Birds of Prey: The Clock Tower

sections.title: Reward
items: 10 Points

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Once the group gets into the server room, a little puzzle has to be solved.
Do not start to fight the adds, they will keep spawning. Let the tank deal with those in a corner or at least away from any terminal. Deal with the adds once the puzzle has been solved.

In the front of the room there is a large terminal in the middle. Once used, a picture will appear and the nine terminals in the room will start a countdown. You have to find the picture matching the front terminal before the timer runs out and use that and only that terminal.
Do this six times in a row without error or time out and the feat will be achieved. You can see the progress on the six little terminals in front.

Either let someone do this who knows all terminals by heart or spread out and stand on top of the server racks so that you can watch over 2-3 terminals each. Once the picture appears on the front terminal, drop down and use the terminal matching the picture on it.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: This feat is located in the same area as General Kalliope's Olympus Descends mission, and player activity while pursuing the objectives counts towards it.

sections.title: Docks Mechanics
items: Go to the Docks in the Olympian Front (the location pinned on the Map) and talk to the Docks Captain. Steve Trevor will ask you to cover the Amazons while they resupply. A Hoplite Skirmisher ( CR 322) will carry crates to the teleporter pad by the invisible plane, and Olympians will arrive through portals to stop her. You must help the Docks Captain to protect her while she loads the plane. Once the Skirmisher has successfully delivered 5 crates, Trevor will confirm your success, the plane will take off, and the Olympian incursion will retreat. The plane will deliver a crate with Healing barrels to the currently active World Boss event (except for the Rampaging Hydra). The next plane will arrive around 30 seconds after that.

If you defeat the Olympians in this encounter, more will arrive. If the Amazon Skirmisher is not interrupted, the task will take about 1 minute. If the player lacks the firepower to defeat them quickly, it may be more efficient to focus on keeping them at bay with movement-restraining abilities such as those that cause pull, stun, and encasement effects.
If you fail to protect the Amazon, the message "Amazon Dock Worker Defeated!" will appear, and the Olympians will retreat. You can try again after 10 seconds.

sections.title: Planes and World Bosses
items: Each World Boss event lasts for up to 3 minutes, with a minimum of about 1 minute interval between events. Since full phases can take them down in a matter of seconds, it is advisable to start loading the plane as soon as the message "X Army is Preparing an Attack" appears on your screen.
You must also take into account that the bosses rotate in the following order: Murk > Ares > Hera & Athena > Steppenwolf & Kalibak > Rampaging Hydra.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Two different kind of imprisioned Bang Babies count towards this feat:
Sphere Encased
Sphere encased Bang Babies can be freed by carrying the sphere to the next safe zone. A large overhead arrow will point the way to the nearest zone.
Caged

The regular cages in the Security Bot areas do not count for this feat.

items: 25 Points

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The Crown of Thorns Golem has a special attack where he slams himself onto the ground horizontally. During the fight with him three waves of Thorn Magi will spawn, which will need to be hit by this attack.

To achieve this feat a tank should pull the adds into the direction of the attack, which is indicated by a line of arrows on the ground. Damage on the boss should stop until all adds from a wave are hit.
The best indicator for Thorn Magi having been hit is when they are clearly knocked back by the attack.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Lois Lane Reporting
Metropolis Anti-Matter Invasion Zone: Listen to each of the following Flashpoint Lois Lane's news reports:
Report 1 - The Resistance base camp outskirts, across from Big Belly Burger
Report 2 - Amazon-occupied eastern Electron building rooftop
Report 3 - Six-Horned Cerberus outskirts, south, cocktails entrance
Report 4 - Science Spire pavilion, south
Report 5 - Pegasus skyscraper, across from Deepwater Elemental
Report 6 - Science Spire pavilion, west
Report 7 - Paradox Crawler outskirts, southeast
Report 8 - Paradox Crawler outskirts, south
Report 9 - Six-Horned Cerberus outskirts, south, lounge entrance
Report 10 - Amazon-occupied eastern coastline, near the pharmacy

sections.title: Reward
items: 25 Feat Points

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: In order to complete this feat, the player must locate and interact with Flashpoint Lois Lane's terminals across Metropolis Anti-Matter Invasion Zone. They can be spotted in the mini-map as white dots. Most of them are located on ground level, except for one that was placed in a rooftop.

sections.title: Walkthrough - table 1
items: Source-listed entries. Follow the source references above for unconverted detail pages.

table.caption: Walkthrough
rows: Report 1; " First the war between New Themyscira and Atlantis, and now some cosmic being called the Anti-Monitor has dragged us into another reality. What's his plan? He has rebuffed all attempts at being interviewed."
Across the street from the destroyed Big Belly Burger near mission hub.

Report 2; " Sources from both S.T.A.R. Labs and LexCorp confirm the Anti-Monitor was released by a scientist's attempt to study the origin of the multiverse. As far as they can ascertain, Centennial Park was the site of the cosmic being's first assault on the positive matter worlds."
On the roof of the Elecron building located next to the elevated highway to the east.

Report 3; " Queen Diana has been air-dropping all sorts of mythical beasts against her enemies. These attacks are especially difficult to defend against because of how little warning her invisible planes give their targets."
At the Starrware building, next to the Cocktails sign - facing Six-Horned Cerberus.

Report 4; " Emperor Aquaman betrayed and abducted King Brion Marvok, then presumably forced his former ally to use his Earth powers to sink half of Europe into the sea. This latest assault by a water elemental has this reporter asking: is this attacking water elemental also being controlled against its will?"
Next to Science Spire's front entrance, facing east.

Report 5; " What once started as an inspirational alliance between Atlanteans and Amazons has escalated non-stop into a global war with little care for the innocents caught in the crossfire. I've seen Atlantis sink half of Europe while the Amazons captured the other half. What will take to finally end the war, or will their hate escalate indefinitely?"
By the entrance of the building with a Pegasus, across the street from the Science Spire.

Report 6; " This reporter witnessed a battle of lights between Green Lantern Abin Sur and his attacker, Sinestro. In this fight, Sinestro referred to the Prophecy of the Flashpoint. What is this Flashpoint, how did it create a paradox, and how did it merge with another reality's paradox? I'm continuing to search out answers."
Next to Science Spire's western entrance.
Report 7; " Initially presumed to be a new magical attack from either the Amazons or the Atlanteans, this flux in the newly-expanded Speed Force seems to be the cause of the problem."
At Big Belly Corporate HQ (southeast from Paradox Crawler in New Troy Central Station), upstairs the northern building.

Report 8; " Qwardians are attackers from the Antimatter universe and serve the Anti-Monitor. Based on their battle cries, they seem more singularly focused on the goal of removing positive-matter from the multiverse."
At the building south of Paradox Crawler, under the marquee.

Report 9; " I've gotten an exclusive update from Cyborg that these strange creatures attacking are called Paradox Demons... and they usually attack realities that have been twisted by Paradoxes. What does that imply about our existence and our ability to continue existing?"
At the Starrware building, next to the Lounge sign - facing west.

Report 10; " From what I've been able to tell from those I'm interviewing, the Anti-Monitor attempted to destroy Earth, but was thwarted year-after-year by a team of Speedsters who would displace the being throughout time. "
Coastline, at the building east of the Metro Transit station, facing north.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The reports were released months prior to World of Flashpoint, serving as an epilogue to the episode's story.; Report 1 explains the presence of characters that belong in the Flashpoint Timeline in the Metropolis Anti-Matter Invasion Zone.; Report 2 explains the Anti-Monitor's origin - the scientist mentioned by Lois is Krona.; Report 3 goes about Queen Diana after her last appearance in the Wonderverse episode.; Report 4 properly introduces Emperor Aquaman. He was previously mentioned in the Wonderverse episode.; Report 5 refers to Queen Diana's and Emperor Aquaman's fateful wedding and sets up the stage for the events of the The Royal War alert.; Report 6 reveals that the Green Lantern Abin Sur, Amon Sur's father, has survived the crashing of his ship in the Flashpoint Timeline, which means Flashpoint Hal Jordan never became a Green Lantern. The Prophecy of the Flashpoint was revealed to Flashpoint Sinestro by Flashpoint Atrocitus in Flashpoint: Abin Sur - The Green Lantern (2011).; Report 7 refers to the events of the Speed Force Flux raid.; Report 8 reintroduces the Qwardians, although they've appeared in Metropolis Anti-Matter Invasion Zone in the previous years. The planet Qward had previously appeared in War of the Light Part II's Spark of Parallax and Rage Impurity, then again in the Blackest Day raid.; Report 9 reintroduces the Paradox Demons and the concept of Paradoxes while also alluding to the title of 2013 animated film Justice League: The Flashpoint Paradox (which influenced the adaptation of the story in the DCUO). They've first appear in Lightning Strikes episode, then made a comeback in the Origin Crisis episode, then once again in Age of Justice.; Report 10 refers to the events of the Centennial Collapse raid.
These reports serve the same narrative purpose as Investigations and Briefings.
Prior to Game Update 135, there was no indication of where to find the terminals in the feat's description, which made it harder to achieve.

summary: Sock'em! is a feat in the Metal Pt. I: Batcave Breach alert operation, part of the Metal Part I episode.

sections.title: Objective
items: Sock'em!
Batcave Breach Alert (Normal): Defeat Sinestro without allowing his Yellow Robot Construct to win any rounds

sections.title: Reward
items: 25 points
the Heavy Hitter title

sections.title: Map
items: Source details and references for Map.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Run the Metal Pt. I: Batcave Breach operation until you reach the final boss on Oa - Sinestro. Players must pay attention to what happens during this fight in order to complete this feat.

sections.title: Method #1: Mechanics
items: A few seconds after the group engages Sinestro, the ROUND 1 will start, and two robot constructs will appear in front of Ion: the Yellow one fights for Sinestro, while the Green one fights for Hal Jordan and John Stewart. Those robots will fight each other during the confront with Sinestro for 3 rounds.

Hal and John will use their rings to empower the Green Robot, and Sinestro will try to prevent that by caging each of them - this is announced by a lethal attack icon (). Sinestro, on the other hand, will summon 2 Construct Turrets to empower the Yellow Robot. When the Yellow Robot wins a round, he deals massive damage to the entire team, possibly knocking them out.

In order to guarantee the Green Lanterns to empower their robot, Sinestro's caging ability must be interrupted, and that can be done by employing a lunge attack against him. To prevent Sinestro from empowering his robot, players must quickly take down his turrets - they can spawn anywhere around the robots. The Green Robot is naturally weaker than the Yellow Robot - if none of them is empowered, the Yellow Robot wins the round still.

Strategy: 1 tank must corner Sinestro against the robots, and the rest of the players should dispose in a way that the whole team will form a triangle with the tank on the top, 2 damage on the inferior corners (not too close to the walls), and the healer/controller/third damage on the center (having more than 2 supportive roles is not recommended, as you need as much firepower as possible to get rid of the turrets fast). The tank will be responsible for interrupting Sinestro's lethal attack, while the damage must take out the turrets as soon as they appear while maintaining their positions.

sections.title: Method #2: Burn
items: If the team has high damage stats, it's possible to defeat Sinestro before the end of the first round - therefore preventing the Yellow Robot from winning any rounds.

sections.title: Method #3: No Green, No Loss
items: The Green Robot will only appear if the Green Lanterns are present in the battlefield, and both Hal and John will follow one of the players. You can use this to trick the game: the player whom the GLs follow must stay behind on the lower level, while the others face Sinestro. The Yellow Robot won't be able to win any rounds due to the absence of his adversary, and the feat will be achieved once Sinestro is defeated.

title: Starting with the Man in the Mirror
summary: Starting with the Man in the Mirror is a feat for heroes and villains in the SoBA: The Treachery of Black Adam challenge and part of the episode The Sins of Black Adam.

sections.title: Source overview
items: Starting with the Man in the Mirror is a feat for heroes and villains in the SoBA: The Treachery of Black Adam challenge and part of the episode The Sins of Black Adam.

references.label: SoBA: The Treachery of Black Adam

sections.title: Objective
items: Defeat Neron while correctly identifying him when he duplicates himself in SoBA: The Treachery of Black Adam solo. (25 points)

sections.title: Reward
items: 25 Points

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Potentially the trickiest feat in the challenge. Normally, when Neron falls below 75%, 50%, and 25% health, he will use his True Form special attack. He teleports to a eastern-central point of the chamber, before disappearing; 4 copies of Neron then appear in a circle surrounding the central spot (any pools of lava would disappear when he uses this to allow you to approach them) and they do not attack. His true form can be identified by dark green smoke around his legs (not to be confused with the light green glow, which can appear on multiple copies). You must KO the true form before the timer expires. If you fail, the copies disappear, and Neron stuns and damages nearby targets (same happens if you KO a fake). You must do this correctly all 3 times in 1 fight for the feat to be completed.

There are a few ways it could go wrong. The duration is quite short and the green smoke may not appear immediately (may depend on device/graphics settings). Sometimes Neron would skip the special attack entirely once or twice, which prevents you from completing the feat even if you thwart the special attack every time it showed up. On rare occasions, even if you KO'ed the true form, Neron can use the special attack again immediately (causing the regular Neron and the 4 copies to exist simultaneously), making it even more difficult. If you need to wait out cooldowns to do enough damage (e.g. Allies) before you trigger the special attack, you can stay on the ceiling, since Neron cannot hit you there. Maxed Ally: Oracle-Bot is an easily accessible ally that can KO the true form quickly, even in elite (it can be summoned when Neron teleports to the center, then you can tag the true form with an attack for the ally to quickly KO). Try to position yourself in the middle before the 4 copies appear to avoid body-blocking.

items: The name of the feat is a possible reference to Michael Jackson's 1988 song, " Man in the Mirror".

title: Street Art: Bad Seeds Graffiti
summary: Street Art: Bad Seeds Graffiti is a meta feat in the Titans Bay open world zone, part of the chapter Wrath of the Worldkillers. It is part of an action to promote the Batman: Bad Seeds 2026 crossover event.

sections.title: Source overview
items: Street Art: Bad Seeds Graffiti is a meta feat in the Titans Bay open world zone, part of the chapter Wrath of the Worldkillers. It is part of an action to promote the Batman: Bad Seeds 2026 crossover event.

In the comics, Vandal Savage became the GCPD Commissioner after the Court of Owls pushed the mayor to depose the then-Commissioner Renee Montoya (who replaced Harvey Bullock after he assumed the position following James Gordon's disappearance). He instituted a surveillance state with extensive police brutality, united the Gotham City Organized Crime Families under his leadership, and declared war on the Bat Family. Poison Ivy was one of many who disapproved of Gotham's new order and decided to run for mayor on a social-democratic platform that included zeroing the city's carbon footprint to attempt to change the system from within. Ivy was seen as a hero after killing Commissioner Savage's tech czar Marie Henley, granting her a landslide victory. During her mandate, Ivy's actions spark a conflict between the Green (the plant kingdom) and the Gray (the fungi kingdom); a plant elemental from the Parliament of Trees named Bog Venus confronted Ivy and manipulated one of her allies. Once the mayor found out about the plot, she killed Bog Venus, putting herself at odds with the Parliament.

In Batman: Bad Seeds, Poison Ivy hands Gotham City to the Parliament of Trees in exchange for immunity for the killing and protection from Commissioner Savage. Batman, forced to operate in clandestinity, is told by Killer Croc that Savage has made a poison capable of killing Poison Ivy - and thousands of Gothamites -, and that the only way to stop the disaster is to convince Ivy to stop the Parliament from turning the city into a jungle.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: This feat is located in the same area as General Kalliope's Olympus Descends mission, and player activity while pursuing the objectives counts towards it.

sections.title: Docks Mechanics
items: Go to the Docks in the Olympian Front (the location pinned on the Map) and talk to the Docks Captain. Steve Trevor will ask you to cover the Amazons while they resupply. A Hoplite Skirmisher ( CR 322) will carry crates to the teleporter pad by the invisible plane, and Olympians will arrive through portals to stop her. You must help the Docks Captain to protect her while she loads the plane. Once the Skirmisher has successfully delivered 5 crates, Trevor will confirm your success, the plane will take off, and the Olympian incursion will retreat. The plane will deliver a crate with Healing barrels to the currently active World Boss event (except for the Rampaging Hydra). The next plane will arrive around 30 seconds after that.

If you defeat the Olympians in this encounter, more will arrive. If the Amazon Skirmisher is not interrupted, the task will take about 1 minute. If the player lacks the firepower to defeat them quickly, it may be more efficient to focus on keeping them at bay with movement-restraining abilities such as those that cause pull, stun, and encasement effects.
If you fail to protect the Amazon, the message "Amazon Dock Worker Defeated!" will appear, and the Olympians will retreat. You can try again after 10 seconds.
You must successfully launch 50 Invisible Planes to complete this feat.

sections.title: Trivia
items: With Super-Strength unlocked, player's character can pick up and carry the crates transported by Hoplite Skirmisher, making feat completion significantly faster and easier.
Depending on their positions and the location of the Olympians' spawning points, the Amazons are able to successfully contain the Olympian incursion by themselves.
The Docks Captain cannot be knocked out.
The name of this mission is a reference to the television series Fantasy Island (1977–1984).

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Similar to Kick D'etat (Feat): Whenever Greed uses his Gold Crush attack, he teleports to the middle of the room and holds a chain that connects to the ceiling. There are 6 piles of treasure around the room. Destroy 3 of them and he will be temporarily disabled and the special attack will not go off. After destroying at least 3 of them, you must go next to Greed and interact with him to "kick" him.

Additionally, Thrice is Not Nice requires you to do this 3 times in a fight. Greed will use Gold Crush when he falls below 75%, 50%, and 25% health, so you must accomplish this for all three times in one fight to complete this feat, as it is not accumulative.

items: In order to complete this feat, the player must craft then collect 8 pieces with the Enhanced Absolute Zero style.

sections.title: Acquiring the Plans
items: The R&D plans required to craft the pieces were released in 2017, and become available in the vendors Green Lantern Corps Present and Sinestro Corps Present (which are only available during the Season's Greedings seasonal event) to the characters that have bought the standard version of the style. Once the plans are acquired and consumed, the recipes to craft the pieces will be unlocked in all R&D Stations under the category Cold Forge.
Heads Up!

Once bought, the plans for the enhanced style disappear from the vendor, therefore they can't be bought twice by the same character. It is recommended to buy the pieces with the character that you intend to be the receiver.

sections.title: Crafting the Pieces
items: To craft Enhanced Cold Commando style pieces, it is required to have the appropriate amount of R&D Components. The main component is Winter Mote, which occasionally drops from final bosses in On Duty instances during the even, and can also be bought from the seasonal vendors mentioned above for 250 and 10 . The other item required is Winter Snowball, that commonly drops from final bosses in On Duty instances during the event. Both items can also be acquired via the broker if other players are selling them.
Heads Up!
Crafted Enhanced Cold Commando style pieces are not tradable.
Craft the pieces with the character that you intend to get the style.

title: The original game: Brainiac's invasion
summary: Arriving in an abandoned alleyway, Future Lex Luthor meets with present Lex Luthor and forms an alliance to take advantage of the coming invasion by Brainiac and the unleashing of the Exobyte technology.

sections.title: Future Batman and Lex Luthor Timeline
items: Encountering an Exobyte breaking into one of his secret labs, Lex Luthor meets and makes a pact with Brainiac to destroy Superman.

Sharing his data and resources with the galactic conqueror, Luthor waged war against the world's heroic populace, uniting the villain community under his leadership, while Brainiac secretly used his Exobytes to steal the abilities of the world’s heroes and villains.

The constant years of battle saw to the deaths of numerous heroes and villains and the destruction of Metropolis. While Superman went into exile in the sun’s core, Earth’s remaining champions launched a final campaign against Luthor’s forces in the ruins of Metropolis. With Luthor watching over the battlefield alongside Deathstroke and Circe behind a shield on top of what remained of the Daily Planet Building, Batman led the remaining heroes on the ground with Cyborg as support.
The ruins of Metropolis

With Poison Ivy and Green Arrow already dead, Green Lantern (Hal Jordan); with his arm in a sling due to a previous injury, quickly dispatches Giganta before being confronted by Black Adam as Batman launches a missile attack against Luthor's shield after telling Cyborg to concentrate fire on him. Meanwhile, Wonder Woman dispatches and decapitates Metallo before Deathstroke assails her; stealing her Golden Lasso as Circe moves to also assault her.

From atop another building, Joker (wearing the bullet-riddled vest of James Gordon) and Harley Quinn (wearing Robin's torn cape) arrive to further escalate the situation; using a missile launcher to attack the Flash (Barry Allen) as he races to aid Hal Jordan who is being dominated by Black Adam.

Noticing the incoming assistance, Adam uses his Word of Power to call down magical lightning just as Hal Jordan musters the willpower in his Power Ring and Barry Allen opens himself to the Speed Force. The resulting explosion as the three cosmic powers collide breaches Luthor's shield, kills Harley Quinn and Circe, disintegrates Hal Jordan and Barry Allen, and devastates what remains of the battlefield.

As the smoke settles, Batman emerges from the wreckage only to be lassoed by Deathstroke, using Wonder Woman's golden lasso, and hung from a piece of wreckage for the villain to beat him to death. Seeing this, the Joker falls into a tantrum and fires the rocket launcher at the both of them; exclaiming that nobody kills the Bat but him.
Death of Wonder Woman and Superman

Sifting through the rubble, Luthor finds and manhandles Wonder Woman; ordering her to call Superman before proceeding to electrocute her. Hearing her screams, Superman awakens fully charged and flies to the battlefield. Confronting Luthor and calling him a madman, Luthor summons Adam to attack, however, the Kryptonian's power was too great for the magic-powered champion and Superman overpowers him, firing his Heat Vision into the villain's face before turning to throw Luthor across the battlefield.

Superman's anger quickly turns to sorrow, however, upon seeing Wonder Woman's body lying on the ground. As Superman knelt to cradle her, Luthor had desecrated her body; hiding deposits of Kryptonite in her mouth. As Superman was quickly weakened by the radioactive rock, Luthor returned to stand over his long-time nemesis; claiming triumph as he drove a kryptonite-point spear through the hero's heart.
Immediately upon Superman’s death, Brainiac, with all opposition dispatched thanks to Luthor, commenced his invasion of Earth.

Sometime later, Luthor allies with Batman (who had survived the battle and returned as a cyborg) and forms a plan to save the world by using the Exobyte data Brainiac had taken on the powers of the hero and villain community during their war to create a new army of meta-humans to oppose Brainaic's invasion forces. Successfully testing the process of bestowing powers upon a non-powered individual on a man code-named Fracture, Luthor and Batman realized that the state of the world in their timeline was irreparable and sought to travel back in time to a point where an army could make a difference in changing their fate.
The Fortress of Solitude under attack

Sheltering within Superman’s Fortress of Solitude in the Arctic, Batman attempts to code a portal to the past as Luthor and Fracture fight off Brainiac’s Eradicators. With the portal successfully activated, Batman moves to hold off the invaders while Fracture enters the portal. However, Luthor betrays the other two; killing Fracture and taking the Exobytes for himself.
As Batman promises vengeance upon the villain, and confidently, Luthor enters the portal to the past alone leaving Batman apparently "dead".

sections.title: Game Story
items: Arriving in an abandoned alleyway, Future Lex Luthor meets with present Lex Luthor and forms an alliance to take advantage of the coming invasion by Brainiac and the unleashing of the Exobyte technology.

As before, the intergalactic conqueror Brainiac unleashes a sudden invasion on Earth in pursuit of the secret of the Multiverse. Acting quickly, the conqueror begins bottling buildings in both Metropolis and Gotham City as the Justice League of America rally their forces to prevent further destruction.

At this time, Future Lex Luthor appears before Superman, Batman and Wonder Woman with a warning of what their future could become should certain events come to pass. Unable to penetrate the "bottle" force fields and hopelessly outnumbered by Brainiac's invasion forces, the Trinity (Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman) bring Luthor to the JLA Watchtower to hear his plan on preventing these events from occurring only to bear witness to Luthor activating and dispersing Exobytes around the globe; explaining that it is part of his plan to create an army for the heroes to oppose Brainiac with.

As they were programmed, the microscopic Exobytes begin to infect countless citizens on Earth, altering their DNA and giving them extra normal abilities; bestowing them with Magical knowledge, Technological prowess or Metahuman ability similar to the super-powered beings already in existence.

sections.title: Survival of the Fittest Arc
items: Gorilla Grodd leads an invasion force towards Little Bohemia in Metropolis. They are using devolution units and neural arrays to turn citizens into apes under Grodd's command. S.T.A.R Labs, along with the help of the new metahuman heroes, assist in finding a way to revert the devolution process. Later, the Heroes, along with The Flash, manage to thwart Grodd's invasion and defeat Grodd himself in his own lab.
Later, Grodd then launches an attack on S.T.A.R. Labs to regain his lost technology, resulting in millions of dollars in damage and multiple casualties in the process.

sections.title: Avatar of Tech and Meta Arc
items: Brainiac's primary targets are soon revealed as a mass-reading of the villain's forces are detected beneath Gotham City. Oracle marshals a group of New Heroes as Calculator marshals a group of New Villains and they both move to investigate the area, quickly discovering access to the Outer Caverns of the legendary Batcave. As their respective "guides" are shut out due to the cave's digital defense systems, the groups are assailed by the cave's robotic guardians; who have been reprogrammed by an unknown entity to use lethal force.

Making their way deeper inside the caverns and into the facility, they are momentarily assisted by Nightwing, Robin, Batwoman and Huntress until the revelation that the cave had been invaded by Brother Eye, on Brainiac's orders. With the four members of the Bat Family infected with the OMAC Virus, the groups proceed into the facility as they were protected from the nanovirus by the Exobytes within themselves.
The Avatar of Tech and Brother Eye

Making their way through the cave's inner sanctum, dispatching the OMAC-controlled robots as they were encountered, the groups eventually meet and assist Batman in freeing the cave's systems from Brother Eye's control only for the hero himself to become infected and depart into a deeper part of the caverns.

With the cave freed and Brother Eye momentarily defeated, the groups follow the infected Batman into the caverns to discover that Brainiac had begun secretly assimilating the caverns in order to gain control the "Nexus of Knowledge" that was the Bat Computer. Clearing the area of Brainiac forces, the groups manage to free Batman of Brainiac's control and together they destroy Brainiac's Avatar of Tech; which was built specifically to command and control the nexus.

As the Avatar of Tech falls, Brainiac sends another force to invade the next Nexus within the Fortress of Solitude in the arctic circle. While Supergirl, Power Girl, Krypto and even Bizarro move to free the fortress, Brainiac manages to gain control of the Sunstone Crystals within the fortress and defeats each of the kryptonians.
Luthor and Superman united

Recognizing the threat should Brainiac gain control of the metahuman technology stored within the fortress, Superman and Lex Luthor unite their forces to break Brainiac's blockade to gain entrance; encountering robotic crystal creations and the now-mind-controlled kryptonian heroes along the way.

Coming upon the Phantom Zone generator, Luthor releases General Zod from captivity, despite Superman's warnings, to aid in destroying Brainiac's Avatar of Meta and together the heroes and villains confront and destroy the avatar before it could gain full control of the meta-human technology. However, the victory was short lived as Zod immediately betrayed the alliance and turned to the crystal matrix to release his forces from the Phantom Zone.
Following after him, Superman and Luthor lead their New Heroes and New Villains against Zod's army and manage to return the General and his army back into the void.

sections.title: Story
items: The demon Trigon, father of Raven, has begun the steps necessary to make his way to Earth. At first unleashing his energy through his daughter, and then through Brother Blood and his evil Cult, Hell on Earth is approaching. This story arc takes place in Metropolis and Gotham City.

sections.title: Source overview
items: Sins of the Father is a classic story arc centered around the Sentinels of Magic, the Titans, and the Cult of Blood. It is divided in four episodes.
This story leads to the Sons of Trigon episode.

sections.title: Background
items: Villains see the Brainiac incursion as an opportunity to increase their power, and Circe and Brother Blood recruit the new villains to help carry on their plans of freeing the demon lord Trigon. In response, Wonder Woman, Doctor Fate, and Zatanna enlist the new heroes to prevent their evil plans.

sections.title: Episode 1: Eye of Sin and the Ankh of Power
items: Circe sends a message to Doctor Fate in an attempt to intimidate him, while Wonder Woman leaves a message for the new villains, asking them to focus their efforts on the fight against Brainiac instead of helping Circe.
Fateful Demise

The Department of Metahuman Affairs announces that the Sentinels of Magic will be in Gotham City and Metropolis combating villainous magic. Circe reaches out to new villains of magic origin to offer a partnership: if they use their magical powers to serve her, she will allow them to rule the world alongside her. She sends them on a mission near Shen Li Po Gardens in Metropolis Chinatown to undermine the Sentinels' efforts to protect the world.
Rare Blood

The new villain is gifted a gem by a Blood Cultist to drain the essence from pure hearts near Mannheim's Chinese Theater. They steal the souls of Sentinel Vanguards, and drain essence from innocent citizens. With enough energy gathered, they use them to breach a Sentinels of Magic Base and steal the Eye of Sin for Circe.
Trigon's Blood

With the Eye of Sin in hands, Circe sends her pupil to the Chinatown Magic Festival in the South Market District to corrupt the patrons' souls and turn them into Wrath Demons. Next, they summon demons to help assaulting the Sentinels of Magic Citadel.
Reign of Blood
The new villain invades the Citadel and destroys the Ankh of Power, and is joined by Brother Blood. Together, they face Doctor Fate and rise victorious.
Blood Triumphant

With the Ankh of Power destroyed and Doctor Fate defeat, Brother Blood shares the news that Trigon's energy is now manifesting through his daughter Raven, and the Teen Titans are doing everything they can to stop it.
Fate Falls!
The door to Trigon's plane is open and Doctor Fate fears the balance has shifted...

Daily Planet News" MPD officers continue to comb the Chinatown district for any of Brother Blood's followers tonight, after a violent altercation between Blood's cultists and the Sentinels of Magic. For Daily Planet Live, this has been Lois Lane."

sections.title: Episode 2: The Battle for Raven
items: Demons start flooding the streets of the Tomorrow District, Captain Maggie Sawyer sends the MPD Science Police to contain the invasion.
Raven Unleashed

As Trigon's energy manifests in orbs around Simon Municipal Bridge, Circe sends the new villains to fight the Science Police and gather the energy to further empower his ascension. Wonder Woman calls upon the new heroes to aid the Science Police in the fight against the demons and purify the dark orbs.
Streetside Abductions & Conversion Vortices

Raven, under Trigon's influence, conjures Conversion Vortices to turn citizens into demons near Avenue of Tomorrow. The new villains attack the Science Police using the Eye of Sin to accelerate the process. The new heroes try to stop citizen from being corrupted by the vortices. Oracle informs the new heroes that she hasn't been able to contact the Titans inside the Science Police HQ, and that she'll call Zatanna to back them up.
Raven Bound

The new villains make the way to the Science Police HQ to fight the Science Police Medics and help release more demons by releasing Trigonic Vortices from Trigonic Orbs. The new villains arrive to destroy the Vortices and save the paramedics.
The Demon Inside

Circe becomes impatient and sends the new villains inside the 8th Precinct to prevent the Titans from helping Raven. They're able to defeat the Amazon Donna Troy, the alien princess Starfire, the tech whiz Cyborg, and their leader Nightwing, breaching Raven's Soul-Self and breaking her resistance to Trigon.

Zatanna confirms that Raven was utterly possessed by Trigon, and the Titans are now under his control. Wonder Woman sends the new heroes into the 8th Precinct to save her. They fight the possessed Titans and manage to break Trigon's control over them. They split up to search for Raven, with Cyborg and the new hero venturing into the HQ's holding level. They find Raven with Zatanna, who was able to restrain the girl. She sends the hero into Raven's Soul-Self and teleports everyone out of the precinct. Inside the Soul-Self, the hero is able to release Raven from her father's control.
Hail Trigon! & Trigon Loosed
Although Raven was freed from Trigon's hold, his energy still permeates the Earth. Both sides are aware that the battle isn't over, as Brother Blood's ritual to raise Trigon is nearly completed.
Soul Smashed
Trigon's energy has been released onto this plane, and Raven broods on her destiny
Soul Survivor

Daily Planet News" Captain Maggie Sawyer spoke to the MPD tonight, giving a decidedly mixed report in the aftermath of a demonic invasion of the Tomorrow District. The missing and corrupted are still being accounted for. For Daily Planet Live, this has been Lois Lane."

sections.title: Episode 3: Sin Don't Win
items: Demons keep flooding the streets of Midtown Metropolis as Brother Blood gets dangerously close to finish his ritual. Circe announces her plans to the people, asking them to give in to Trigon's power, while the Martha Wayne Foundation hires Booster Gold to spread a message encouraging people to resist, and Wonder Woman gives a speech to raise the morale of people so they can fight Brother Blood's magic.
Five Deadly Sins
Oracle and Cyborg contact the new heroes to inform about the current state of things. They must stop Trigon's Sin Demons raised by Brother Blood and stop his ritual.
Greed

Wonder Woman sends the new heroes to an area near Ellsworth Memorial Hospital taken by Minions of Greed that are corrupting citizens into greedy thieves. The heroes save the victims from the demons and recover the stolen cash.
Gluttony

While Oracle tracks the origin of the demons, Wonder Woman directs the heroes to the area near Superman Memorial Statue in Centennial Park, where Minions of Gluttony's binge-eating feeds Trigon with power. The new heroes defeats the demons and help the people who have been affected by gluttony's influence.
Wrath

Oracle identifies the mayhem's origin: Ellsworth Hospital. Outside the building, Minions of Wrath have enraged regular citizens and metahumans alike. The new heroes defeat the wrath demons and manage to calm down the civilians under their influence. Oracle informs that the Sentinels of Magic are on their way to help fight Brother Blood.
Trigon's Blood

Wonder Woman sends the new heroes to meet Doctor Fate, Zatanna, and Raven inside the hospital. They fight against hordes of demons and sin-influenced people, then confront and defeat Brother Blood, thwarting his ritual.
Fratricide
Wonder Woman and Cyborg congratulate the heroes for their triumph against Blood, but they expect that he will try to raise Trigon again.
Sin Don't Win
Brother Blood's demonic energy is contained, but can the Titans keep Trigon at bay?

JLA Watch News"Raven and the Titans withdrew with considerable less fanfarre than normally marks their departures after a stunning attack on Midtown's Ellsworth General Hospital earlier today. Sources close to the group indicate though they succeeded today, it came at a heavy cost. I'm Vicki Vale."

sections.title: Episode 4: Trigon Triumphs
items: Brother Blood moves his cult to Gotham City, in a final attempt to raise the demon Trigon. He releases Sin Demons in Robinson Park, and public states that the people of Gotham should worship Trigon. Commissioner Gordon alerts GCPD Special Crimes Units about their presence in Gotham, informing that his cult is not sanctioned, therefore it can be shut down by the police. The Sentinels of Magic, the GCPD SWAT, and Gotham Firefighters arrive to on the scene to combat the cult's activity.
Meanwhile, Circe further her manipulation tactics on her pupils, offering more power if the plan to raise Trigon succeeds, and Wonder Woman warns them of her lies.
Road to Hell
Calculator informs the new villains about Circe's new plans, and Blood Priest Lucius sends them to the Forum of the Twelve at Robinson Park, for Brother Blood has a test for them.
Testing 1,2,3

Circe directs the new villains to a portal at the Forum that leads to A Shadow of Hell. They go through Brother Blood's trial, defeating Minions of Greed and Wrath, and consuming the essence of Demons, and finally arriving where Blood is conducting his ritual. He managed to capture the weakened Titans: Donna Troy, Nightwing, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy, and Raven. For the final test, they defeat Raven, the sin of pride, and Blood sends them back to Gotham to raise more power for Trigon.

Calculator informs the new villains that each of the spawns of Trigon manifest of the seven deadly sins, and Trigon can use that sinful energy to rise. Circe instructs them to head to the Pillars of Hades to use an obelisk to temporarily transform into a Greed Demon to collect Gems of Greed from the Pillars.
Gorge Yourself
The new villains use an obelisk placed by cultists to temporally transform into Gluttony Demons and eat the souls of innocent civilians and heroes.
Wrath and Desecration
The villains use another obelisk placed by cultists to temporally transform into Wrath Demons to destroy the park's graveyard and combat first responders.
Tortured Titans!

Now filled with power, the new villains return to the ritual in Hell's Doorway. They corrupt two of the trapped Titans before the rest of Raven's friends manage to free themselves. The new villains fight against them, corrupting the heroes in the process. Brother Blood is able to complete the ritual, but Raven sets herself and the Titans free and they flee to fight another day. Calculator is appalled that the new villain went through with releasing a major demon onto their plane of existence.
Blood Money
Circe basks in her victory, and Blood Priest Lucius celebrates Trigon's rise.
Trigon Triumphs
Trigon will rise! Brother Blood eagerly anticipates his glorious future

JLA Watch News" Battered and bruised but unbroken, the Teen Titans emerged victorious today from their altercation with Brother Blood and the cult of Trigon. A spokesperson for the group announced their victory this morning at a short press conference. The world will, no doubt, sleep easier tonight knowing one less demonic threat looms on the horizon. I'm Vicki Vale."

In an attempt to cease the fighting, S.T.A.R. Labs attempts to create emotional power dampners to control the raging emotional spectrum only to have the reverse effect occur and cause destruction as the corps' infighting spreads to Coast City.

sections.title: Story
items: The battle against Brainiac peaks as the tyrant attempts to claim the Flame of Change from Themyscira, with both Circe and Wonder Woman uniting their forces to stop him.

Meanwhile, Batman notes new activity in the southern districts of Gotham City and learns of Brainiac's forces amassing within and around the bottled buildings. From there he learns of Brainiac's ultimate plan to drill into the core of the planet and access the center of the Multiverse to change it into his own design.

Both heroes and villains amass together in a final confrontation to stop the tyrant, however, as the villain falls, Future Lex Luthor enacts his own plan to access the Multiversal core and gain unlimited power. Meanwhile, Future Batman, having survived Luthor's earlier betrayal, also arrives to stop him.

sections.title: Story
items: Wonder Woman
Circe

Sons of Trigon picks up where the " Sins of the Father" storyline from the base game left off, with the demon lord Trigon ready to break free of his bonds, intent on destroying Earth. The influence of this powerful villain has already been felt across the world, and it will be up to the player to either stop it or use it to their advantage.

Circe and Brother Blood were successful in releasing Trigon from his dimension, but the Sentinels of Magic were ready. They performed a counter-hex, placing a protective barrier around our realm. The barrier trapped Trigon between his world and ours, resulting in the creation of an in-between dimension — the Gotham Wastelands — a version of Gotham City that is rapidly approaching Hell. Players will see familiar Gotham landmarks, such as the Cathedral and Knightsdome, twisted, broken and corrupted by Trigon's presence in this realm.

With Trigon at his most vulnerable, Trigon's sons have come forth to vie for his power. The six sons represent six of the seven deadly sins: Wrath ( Jared), Envy ( Jesse), Lust ( Jacob), Sloth ( Jack), Gluttony ( Julius), and Greed ( James). Trigon's sons seek the family reunion from Hell — to be joined with the seventh sin, Pride ( Raven), and their father. But like any family reunion, it's rife with sibling rivalry.

The sons vie for their father's affection, all desiring that which Raven refused: to be his vessel and gain ultimate power. To strengthen the power of sin, the sons have sent demons to the mortal plane to abduct innocent souls. These souls are dragged through portals to the Gotham Wastelands, where they are tortured in order to fill the coffers of the sin demons. Once enough sin has been gathered, Trigon can be awoken from his forced slumber.

Meanwhile, Wonder Woman and the Titans are trying desperately to keep Raven from temptation, and to keep the children of sin from releasing their father, and endangering the entire universe. Circe and Brother Blood have their own desires to release Trigon, and will not let the sons interfere.

items: In Brainiac's bid to digitize the multiverse, he created three avatars, each associated with a powerful Nexus of Technology, Meta, and Magic. It was the Avatar of Magic's creation on Themyscira outside the gates of Tartarus that has led us to this moment. Furious at the attack on Paradise Island, Hippolyta, Queen of the Amazons, began silently planning a counterstrike. Holding the mortal world responsible for letting the infestation of Brainiac reach her shores, she decides the time for peace has passed and that the time of war and death has begun.

Amazon Fury Part I starts with an all out Amazon assault on Gotham City, the entrance to the Nexus of Reality and the Seat of Brainiac's power on Earth. But the idea of war has fractured the Amazon civilization, and civil war has erupted. Wonder Woman opposes her mother's invasion. Amazons have fallen in line behind either their queen or their princess. Which side will you stand beside as the battle for Gotham City begins?

Mythical creatures take up arms as Paradise Island erupts into civil war. Cyclops, Satyrs, Harpies, and more will join the armies of the warring amazons and determine the fate of the mortal world, beginning with Gotham City. The battle lines are being drawn in Amazon Fury Part I.

sections.title: Story
items: In the core game, Green Lanterns and Sinestro Corps agents first came to Earth when their rings began to fail. They began fighting with each other, assuming their arch rivals were responsible.

During the Fight for the Light episode, it was revealed that the true threat to the emotional spectrum is Brainiac, who has drained the emotional spectrum, turning all emotion into logic. The entities themselves were trapped in huge Logic Lanterns that Brainiac constructed to contain and transform them. The corps attack, and when these Logic Lanterns are destroyed, the corps think the entities are freed, and the victory is theirs.

Sinestro and Hal Jordan are some of the first fighters in the war to realize what has happened and, that if they do not work together, the Emotional Entities themselves will cease to exist and their light will die out…forever.
The stakes are high, which is why the Star Sapphires and the Orange Lanterns enter the war. How will the leaders of each corps save their entity from oblivion?

War of the Light Part II brings the Star Sapphires to the battle as the Lantern Corps Fight to save the Emotional Spectrum. These fierce, powerful and passionate Corps fight for the entity of love, making the battle between good and evil not so black and white.

sections.title: Desecrated Cathedral
items: Brother Blood's schemes for ultimate power reach a new level as he uses Raven and the Sons of Trigon to collect even more power. In this four-player Alert, players will return to the cathedral in the Gotham Wastelands at the request of Raven, Trigon's daughter, who senses a disturbance in the levels of sinful energy there. Who is behind the disturbance? What is their purpose? The answers to these questions will unleash a new threat to the universe, and a new storyline in DC Universe Online.
This is also the first Alert with an Elite version, where players can attempt a more challenging version of the content for more powerful rewards.

sections.title: Oa Under Siege
items: The War of the Light began when Brainiac disrupted the emotional entities of the various Lantern Corps (Green, Blue, Sinestro, and Red). What began as a battle in Metropolis, quickly spread to outlying sentient planets. As the Corps – with your help – formed an uneasy alliance to combat the disruptions in the center of the emotional spectrum, the control over the influence of the edges of the spectrum weakened. Thus began the War of the Light Part II, with the arrival of Larfleeze's Orange Lanterns and Carol Ferris' Star Sapphires.

After traveling to Zamaron and restoring some balance, Hal Jordan and Sinestro explain to Carol Ferris that the greatest threat to the Corps is still coming. That threat arrived in Episode 15: Corrupted Zamaron with the emergence of the Black Lanterns. As the Black Lanterns corrupted the Star Sapphires home planet of Zamaron, Indigo-1 rallied to help purge the corruption. No one knew how severely the corruption had spread until it was revealed that even Hawkgirl had become a pawn under the control of the Black Lanterns' power.
After the Black Lanterns were defeated on Zamaron and the Power Battery was restored, it seemed like things might be under control. Until they turned to Oa.

Now, Black Lanterns have invaded Oa, Hal Jordan has fallen, and the universe once again turns to you to assist the Green Lanterns before the Corruption spreads. In order to save Ion and Hal Jordan, a new member of the Indigo Tribe, Munk, Indigo-1’s second in command, arrives to assist.

sections.title: The Demon's Plan
items: The League of Assassins continues to attempt to exert their control over the DC Universe. First in an alternate reality during Episode 15's The Bombshell Paradox, then face to face in Episode 17's The Flash Museum Burglary and most recently in Episode 18's The Demon's Pit, where their sudden interest in Central City drew the attention of Green Arrow and Deathstroke.

When heroes and villains arrived at the Lazarus Pools, they found the unconscious hanging bodies of their allies from the Justice League and the Society. Once the lifeless bodies were dropped, heroes and villains had to fight against their allies in an attempt to reverse the effects of the serums from the pools. Now we discover that Ra's al Ghul's madness is greater than it's ever been. But rather than an all-out assault on any one of the world's 'great' cities, he has captured Star City's hero, Green Arrow and Central City's nefarious rogue, Captain Cold. Fight alongside Black Canary or Heat Wave against Ra's forces in the infamous mountain fortress of Nanda Parbat. Will Ra's succeed in his attempt to recruit these powerful leaders to his cause? Find out in the final chapter of the League of Assassin's story arc.

sections.title: Deep Desires
items: During Episode 17's Unholy Matrimony, heroes and villains joined Raven in a confrontation with her father, Trigon. Raven was able to banish Trigon to his prison, locked away from the mortal world. But her brothers are in a panic, scrambling for power and turning on each other. The concept of brotherly love has utterly failed Jesse (Envy) and Julius (Gluttony), so Raven has asked you to step in. Jesse made the first move and has caused the hungriest brother to envy their brother Jacob! As a result, Julius has become insatiable in his desires for food AND power. He will no longer be confined to the hellish kitchen; he wants to gobble up the Tunnel of Lust, the Wastelands, and then the world!

sections.title: Blackest Night
items: The Blackest Night falls from the skies, The darkness grows as all light dies, We crave your hearts and your demise, By my black hand, the dead shall rise!

Nekron has come. He has joined his herald, Black Hand, in extinguishing all light – all life – in the universe. The Metropolis Battlefield was ripe with the lingering death from the War of the Light, allowing Nekron to raise an enormous Black Lantern in the middle of the city. The area around the Lantern is scorched earth, scarred by the Corruption brought by the Black. You must fight alongside the Lantern Corps and send Nekron back to the Land of the Unliving in the Blackest Night.
And so ends the War of the Light saga.

In this Operation, a Black Lantern has erupted from the blood-soaked streets of war-torn Metropolis and Nekron has risen from this deathly soil. The embodiment of death is no easy foe to defeat and Hal Jordan, Sinestro, and the rest of the champions have been unable to even make a scratch. But don’t worry, the Star Sapphire, Carol Ferris, has a plan. Will you aid her in stopping Nekron and the Black Lanterns from snuffing out all life in the universe?

sections.title: Wastelands Wonderland
items: The Gotham Wastelands is full of mayhem and madness. Imps and demons run amuck in the fiery wasteland, allowing Jacob and Jack to seductively and slowly (respectively) make their moves. Raven, annoyed as ever by her brothers, has asked for your help in putting them back in their places.

sections.title: The Phantom Zone
items: The Fortress of Solitude's defense systems are malfunctioning and Superman is busy investigating an incredible off world threat. If you’re a hero, he’s going to give you a call and ask for a little help checking out his digs. If you’re a villain, you better believe Lex Luthor put a listening device in the Fortress during the Fortress raids long ago, so while Superman is away, the villains will play.
Once inside, you quickly realize that the Phantom Zone Projector is the source of the malfunction and it’s up to you to check it out. What could possibly go wrong?

sections.title: The Science Spire
items: So, something went down in the Phantom Zone, and a certain prisoner has escaped, along with his followers. Lois Lane, intrepid reporter, is on the case. Her sources have described sightings of Kryptonians near Lex Luthor's Science Spire. You know, that huge, questionably oversized monument Lex Luthor erected in the Tomorrow District of Metropolis? She’s taken a leave of absence from the Daily Planet and is hiring muscle (read: you) to help her break in and investigate.

title: Episode 23: Brainiac's Bottle Ship & The Will of Darkseid
summary: In Episode 22, General Zod and his followers escaped from the Phantom Zone! Lois Lane then tracked his Kryptonian forces to Lex Luthor's Science Spire in Metropolis, and there discovered what they were after – the secret coordinates to: Brainiac's Bottle Ship!

sections.title: Brainiac's Bottle Ship
items: In Episode 22, General Zod and his followers escaped from the Phantom Zone! Lois Lane then tracked his Kryptonian forces to Lex Luthor's Science Spire in Metropolis, and there discovered what they were after – the secret coordinates to: Brainiac's Bottle Ship!

Zod wants those coordinates and he'll do whatever it takes to get them – including using the Science Spire's enormous laser on the city of Metropolis. Superman and Lex Luthor are sending teams to get Zod out of the Spire and back under control, and you're up.
Supergirl is on the way with her own vested interest in the location of the Bottle Ship, so she'll be by your side as you confront General Zod. Then things get really interesting.

sections.title: The Will of Darkseid
items: While off-world seeking information about Apokolips, Superman has discovered that the forces of Darkseid are gathering an invasion force on the surface of New Genesis. Parademons are lining up in ranks to invade!

Superman asks that you help the locals defend their homes while the New Gods of New Genesis are busy elsewhere preparing a counter-attack. Lex Luthor enters the scene for the villains, curious if working with Darkseid is even worth the investment. He will quickly form an opinion.

sections.title: Darkseid's War Factory
items: The journey to meet (and hopefully defeat) Darkseid began with Episode 11: Halls of Power Part I. In this episode, we first learned that Darkseid was sending his agents below the surfaces of New Genesis and Apokolips, gathering relics in an attempt to harness the power of the Old Gods by recovering ancient Third World artifacts. By Episode 14: Halls of Power Part II, they had uncovered even more artifacts. At the same time, a skirmish broke out on the surface of New Genesis as Darkseid's forces attempted to attack Celestial City. And, at her Happiness Home orphanage – aka, a deadly training facility, Granny Goodness was testing the mettle of Earth's heroes and villains in an attempt to recruit and prepare the denizens of Apokolips to serve Darkseid.

For a while, it seemed that Earth was safe from Darkseid's meddling, until Episode 23: The Will of Darkseid. The war between the New Gods once again heated up on New Genesis, and players reported to the battle site in order to help defend the area from Darkseid's invasion force. Though the players triumphed over Steppenwolf, he left with an eerie message – 'The Source will speak to Darkseid.'

Darkseid and his nefarious plans must be stopped once and for all. He has finally gathered enough Artifacts of the Old Gods to construct to reshape them into a machine that will allow him to access the all-powerful Source. With a direct line to the Source, Darkseid's will could never be stopped. You must get there before he can release that divine power into the universe.

sections.title: Harley's Heist
items: The alarms at the Regal Hotel are going off again and it looks like Harley Quinn may be hankering for a heist! Huntress has a hunch that Harley Quinn and her criminal besties, Catwoman and Poison Ivy are behind it and is calling on all Heroes for backup. Meanwhile, Villains must lend a hand to Harley and her BFFs with their mischievous plans.

sections.title: Iceberg Lounge
items: In the Episode 24 Duo, Harley's Heist, we found ourselves wrapped up in a heist thanks to the gals of Gotham! Harley Quinn, Catwoman, and Poison Ivy – who are always up to no good, it seems – hosted their inaugural heist at the Regal Hotel. That's right – inaugural. Meaning the first. Meaning they've got more up their skintight sleeves…

The Grand Opening of the Iceberg Lounge is sure to draw attention from elite across the DC Universe. In fact, both Lex Luthor and Bruce Wayne are confirmed to be guests in attendance! With all the attention being focused on the high-profile guests, it should be easy enough for Harley, Ivy, and Catwoman to sneak in. But what is it they're after this time? And is it really smart of them to try to cross Penguin at his Grand Opening soiree?

sections.title: A Rip in Time
items: In the Episode 21 Duo, The First Piece, heroes and villains fought to recover Kahndaqi relics from the control of the mysterious Abra Kadabra in the Gotham University Warehouse. Heat Wave and Hawkgirl were forced to work together in order to regain the control of the relics. A mysterious stranger thanks everyone for their assistance, and promises to be back in touch soon…

Then, in Episode 21 Operation, Prison Break, the same mysterious contact has asked you to work with the latest member of the team, the Atom! Who is this mysterious person and what are his motives? For now, he has asked his newly formed Team of Legends to break out a recently incarcerated individual from Stryker's Island. There's just one catch; he's being held in maximum security inside the Penitentiary. After hatching a plan with the Atom to break him out from the inside. which ends in a huge face-off with Doctor Light! At the end, the stranger promises he'll contact them with more information later on.

Well, that stranger is making good on his promise! In A Rip in Time, the Legends of Tomorrow adventure continues as you'll meet up with Vixen at the Mercenary Base. Remember that pieces that got away in Episode 21? She thinks she's tracked it down, and she needs your help to get it back. If our calculations are correct, when this baby starts, you're gonna see some serious stuff...

sections.title: Wayne Manor Gala
items: Well, it seems Harley Quinn, Poison Ivy, and Catwoman are at it again! The escapades with these three began back in Episode 24: Harley's Heist, when they attempted a caper at the Regal Hotel. But one little heist doesn’t pack enough punch for these three, so they showed up at the grand opening of Penguin’s new club in Episode 25: Iceberg Lounge. The girls quickly learned that crossing the Penguin at his big event may have been more than they bargained for, since Catwoman ended up kidnapped! Though she was safely rescued, this gave Harley and Ivy another idea…one that Catwoman’s not too thrilled with.

Welcome to Wayne Manor Gala. Wayne Manor is filled to the brim with Gotham’s elite, all rallied together for a charity event – raising funds for victims of the Brainiac Invasion! The soiree is hosted by one Bruce Wayne. Only Bruce doesn’t seem to be milling among the crowd. Could Harley Quinn, Poison Ivy, and Catwoman have something to do with that? It’s up to you to find out!

sections.title: Kandor Central Tower
items: Kryptonians and humans have been crossing paths recently! In Episode 22: Science Spire, Lois Lane realized that something – though she wasn’t quite sure what – had happened in Episode 22: The Phantom Zone. In her investigations, she realized the Kryptonian sightings were connected to General Zod, who was seeking information from Lex Luthor’s database! Though at first Lois – and you! – are able to keep the information from Zod, in Episode 23: Brainiac's Bottle Ship, the location of Kandor becomes known as Zod and Supergirl – and, once again – you! - are transported to Brainiac’s control room on one of his ships. Despite his promises to the contrary, Zod took off with the Bottle City of Kandor after the fight was over!

In Kandor Central Tower, General Zod has used stolen technology to return Kandor to normal size. Still trapped within Brainiac’s bottle, Kandor now resides in the Arctic near the Fortress of Solitude. While its unknown whether Kandor on its own is a threat to Humanity, there is no doubt that Zod intends to raise an army of Kryptonians and rule the planet. Join Superman, Superboy, and Supergirl in Kandor to convince everyone that Humans and Kryptonians can share the planet and live in peace.
